values.bgo.arena.1vs1_rules1:
Matches last 10 minutes

   The winner is the pilot who:
      * Defeats their opponent
      * Captures the beacon at the centre of the Arena by staying within range for 30 seconds without attacking or being attacked
      * Has dealt the most damage to their opponent when the match ends
Players may join solo (in which case they will be assigned to a team), or Squadron Leaders of three appropriate ships can join as a team
values.bgo.arena.1vs1_text2: Initial ratings are determined by Pilot Level. Winning matches increases your rating for the appropriate size class, losing matches will reduce it.
values.bgo.arena.1vs1_title: Compete in one on one matches with pilots from both factions to determine who is the 'Top Gun' in each size class.  Tier 4 ships not supported
values.bgo.arena.3vs3mixed_rules1:
Matches last 15 minutes

   A team wins by:
      * Defeating the opposing Line ship
      * Capturing the beacon at the centre of the Arena by staying in ranges for 30 seconds without attacking or being attacked
      * Having inflicted the most damage on the opposing Line ship when the match ends

Strikes respawn after 60 seconds and Escorts respawn after 90 seconds

values.bgo.bonus_event_festival_of_kobol_coming: Between July 27, 2012 and August 12, 2012 we will celebrate the Festival of %br%Kobol! values.bgo.bonus_event_festival_of_kobol.Descri: The Festival of Kobol has begun! With origins dating back to Kobol, the traditional%br%version consisted of a series of athletic competitions held in honor of the Lords of%br%Kobol. Thousands of years later, the Twelve Colonies continued to celebrate the%br%Festival, sending their best athletes to represent their people in the competitions.%br%Aboard the fleets, the Festival is observed in a different manner: a decathlon of%br%contests between pilots.%br%%br%Check the forums at http://en.board.bigpoint.com/bsgo/index.php for more specific%br%information.

values.bgo.chat.help_line_1: The following commands are available to use:
values.bgo.chat.help_line_10: /ol text or /openLocal text, send text to Open Local channel.
values.bgo.chat.help_line_11: /og text or /openGlobal text, send text to Open Global channel.

values.bgo.chat.help_line_17: /i or /invite name, invite user to a party.
values.bgo.chat.help_line_18: /d or /dismiss name, dismiss user from a party.

values.bgo.chat.help_line_23: /ml or /mutelist, displays a list of players which you are currently ignoring.
values.bgo.chat.help_line_24: note: to remove ALL players on your mutelist supply the argument 'clear' (i.e. /ml clear)
values.bgo.chat.help_line_3: /fg or /fleetGlobal, view Fleet Global channel, select current input type as Global.

values.bgo.cutscenes.cylons_find_galactica: CAVIL: At last: the Galactica! You found her! We’re preparing to jump to your location as soon as possible with a full attack force.
GALACTICA: Gaeta here. That's good news, but stay alert. Galactica, out.
STARBUCK: Looks like I was right about your potential. That was some nice flying, Nugget.
STARBUCK: Galactica, the asteroid field looks clear so far. No sign of any Cylon activity.
values.bgo.cutscenes.drone_activation.cylon.bas: NUMBER SIX: Here's hoping that's where they're hiding. Otherwise, this is a simply stellar use of my time.
values.bgo.cutscenes.drone_activation.cylon.sca: NUMBER SIX: No sign of human activity so far. Start your approach towards your assigned asteroid field.
NUMBER SIX: Well, little Sprocket, we may make a Raider out of you yet. Someday.
values.bgo.cutscenes.intro.colonial.galactica.b: GALACTICA: Copy that, Starbuck. Once you give the all-clear, we'll bring in the rest of the fleet and see if we can't get some of these repairs done. Watch yourself out there!
values.bgo.cutscenes.intro.colonial.starbuck.pa: STARBUCK: Galactica, this is Starbuck. Starting my sector patrol now, and I've got a nugget along for the ride.
values.bgo.cutscenes.intro.colonial.starbuck.sh: STARBUCK: Should be an easy ride - if this sector really is the safe haven we've been hoping for. Let's hope the gods will let us get a little shut-eye!
values.bgo.cutscenes.intro.cylon.cavil.find_the: CAVIL: Cover as much space as you can. I want the Galactica found! I can sense that she's out there somewhere.
values.bgo.cutscenes.intro.cylon.cavil.revenge: CAVIL: We won't let the destruction of our Resurrection Ship go unavenged!
values.bgo.cutscenes.intro.cylon.scar.patrol_st: CAVIL: Patrol, this is Basestar. Your jump is complete. Begin recon.
values.bgo.cutscenes.intro.cylon.six.hello: NUMBER SIX: Hello, new Raider. You may be a bit disoriented, but don’t worry.
values.bgo.cutscenes.intro.cylon.six.monitoring: NUMBER SIX: As your resurrection was so recent, I’ll be monitoring this mission from the Basestar while you’re breaking in your new chassis.
values.bgo.cutscenes.intro.sector_intro: Kito Sector%br%13 days after the destruction of the Resurrection Ship
values.bgo.cutscenes.radio_chatter.landing_base: BASESTAR: {0}, clear for approach. Check speed and enter through the starboard bay.
{0}: Approaching for landing now.
BASESTAR: Reduce speed, {0} - approach with more caution!
{0}: Slowing down and recovering. Stand by for docking.
BASESTAR: Begin entry balance.
{0}: Approaching for landing, Basestar.
BASESTAR: Affirmative, {0}. Speed is 62, starboard port. Be careful when docking – the hangar is sensitive!
{0}: Docking complete!
BASESTAR: Welcome back, {0} and Number Six. Permission to dock granted.
SIX: Thank you. Approaching now.
FIVE: Basestar, Five here aboard {0}'s ship. Mission completed.
BASESTAR: Confirmed, Number Five. Number One requests that you report back to him as soon as possible.
BASESTAR: Permission to dock granted.
{0}: Basestar? {0} here requesting permission to dock. On the approach now.
BASESTAR: Confirmed, {0}. God loves you.
{0}: Manual landing initiated.
{0}: Basestar? Requesting permission to dock.
BASESTAR: Authorized. For the glory of God!
BASESTAR: We have been awaiting your return, {0}.
{0}: Every mission is a step closer to victory over the humans! Permission to dock?
BASESTAR: Granted. Your service is appreciated.
{0}: Requesting coordinates, Basestar, and permission to dock.
BASESTAR: Acknowledged. Coordinates sent. Welcome back, {0}; initiate docking sequence.
{0}: By your command.
BASESTAR: {0}, we're waiting on your report.
{0}: Confirmed. Beginning my approach.
{0}: {1} here, Basestar. Permission to dock?
BASESTAR: Granted, {0}. Your brothers and sisters have missed you.
{0}: Initiating landing now.
{0}: Requesting immediate docking, Basestar.
BASESTAR: You're expected, {0}. Watch your landing; you scraped the entry last time.
{0}: Apologies to the docking bay. Final approach vector initiated.
values.bgo.cutscenes.radio_chatter.landing_gala: Galactica: Viper seven-niner-one, Galactica: You are cleared for approach. Speed 1-7-5, port bay. Hands-on approach. Checkers green. Call the ball.
{0}: Copy that, Galactica. I have the ball.
GALACTICA: Head directly for the target, the port bay, {0}
{0}: Copy, approaching at a speed of 65.
GALACTICA: You’re looking good, {0}. Bring her on home.
{0}: Copy, Galactica. I have the ball. Landing in {1}.
{0}: Coming in for final approach. Do you copy Galactica?
GALACTICA: Copy, {0}. You are clear for landing. Speed is 55, port bay. Checkers red, call the ball.
BOOMER: Galactica, Raptor 309 here. Boomer and {0}, requesting permission to dock.
GALACTICA: Permission granted. Landing bay. You're hands-on, and keep your speed below 60.
STARBUCK: Galactica, Starbuck here, requesting permission to dock.
GALACTICA: Gaeta here. Successful mission?
STARBUCK: {0} and I are in one piece - can't ask for more than that.
GALACTICA: Good to hear. Pretty hairy out there.
STARBUCK: Galactica, this is Starbuck. Requesting permission to land so that I can offer {0} here a cigar for a job well done. Can't wait to get out of this shuttle...
GALACTICA: Granted. Keep out of drunken punch-ups from now. Grunt work doesn't suit you.
GALACTICA: Welcome back, {0}. Permission to dock granted.
{0}: Excellent. I'll be in the wardroom if anyone's looking for me.
{0}: Galactica, {1} here. Has that game of Triad started yet?
GALACTICA: Just about to, {0}. You can make it if you get yourself docked quickly.
{0}: Roger that, final approach vector initiated. I'm winning that pool, you'll see.
GALACTICA: Permission to dock granted. Get ready to kiss those cubits goodbye.
GALACTICA: Nice work out there, {0}. You have permission to dock.
{0}: I'm just glad to be back. Final landing sequence initiated; I have the ball.
{0}: Galactica? Requesting permission to dock immediately - I got a rattle under the hood, and I don't like the sound of it.
GALACTICA: Granted. I'll let Chief Tyrol know.
{0}: Come in, Galactica. Requesting permission to dock; do you copy?
GALACTICA: Loud and clear, {0}. Initiate landing sequence. Good job out there!
{0}: Stop that, Galactica, you'll make me blush.
GALACTICA: Not with your ego, I won't. Landing bay's clear; see you shortly.
Ready to dock, {0}?
{0}: Can't wait to be home, Galactica!
values.bgo.cutscenes.tut1_extro.colonial.dualla: DUALLA: All wings, Galactica. All Vipers are to break off and come on home. Combat landings authorized. Repeat, come on home.
GAETA: Admiral, that unidentified construct our pilots found - it's shedding something.
values.bgo.cutscenes.tut1_extro.cylon.cavil.bad: CAVIL: I have no idea... but I have a bad feeling about all this.
values.bgo.cutscenes.tut1_extro.cylon.cavil.bre: CAVIL: General alert: all personnel are to break off pursuit and return to their Basestar. Repeat, return home at once.
values.bgo.cutscenes.tut1_extro.cylon.cavil.sen: CAVIL: That unidentified construct you found... something is coming off or out of it. And it's blurring our sensors.
values.bgo.cutscenes.tut1_extro.cylon.scar.mean: NUMBER SIX: What does that mean?
values.bgo.cutscenes.tut1_extro.cylon.scar.what: NUMBER SIX: What is going on over there?

values.bgo.event.easter_2014_epilogue.descripti: The drones are defeated. You can trade in the earned components in Baltar's Lab till the 4th May 2014, 23:59:59 CEST. Afterwards they will be exchanged for Titanium.
The drones are defeated. You can trade in the earned components in Simon's Lab till the 4th May 2014, 23:59:59 CEST. Afterwards they will be exchanged for Titanium.
values.bgo.event.easter_2014.description.coloni: While researching the drones that wander the Veil sector, Dr. Baltar has produced a significant technological breakthrough. Pilots have been given access to this, but Dr. Baltar requires specific materials for Chief Tyrol to enhance your equipment. Engage and destroy the drones throughout the region, and return with whatever salvage you can recover. Be on your guard, we've identified a new kind of drone. Observe and engage these targets of opportunity.
values.bgo.event.easter_2014.description.cylon: The Number Fours have made technological breakthroughs while researching the drones in this sector. The distribution of these items has been authorized to all Cylon forces present in the Veil sector. Resources are limited, and all independent Cylons are responsible for collecting construction materials for the improvements. Engage and destroy the drones throughout the region, and return with whatever salvage you can recover. Be on your guard, we've identified a new kind of drone. You are directed to engage and destroy this drone whenever it is sighted.
values.bgo.event.scavenger.radiation_info.1: Due to a malfunction, the station is leaking radiation.
values.bgo.event.scavenger.radiation_info.2: Reduce the effect of radiation by equipping the radiation control system and using the RC pack consumable. The systems are available in the item shop.
values.bgo.event.scavenger.radiation_info.3: Upgrade the radiation control system to increase radiation resistance.
values.bgo.event.scavenger.radiation_info.4: Reaching a critical level, the radiation will kill pilot and crew.
values.bgo.event.scavenger.tutorial.step_1: Fly to the station and search for drifting containers.
values.bgo.event.scavenger.tutorial.step_2: Salvage containers by getting close and docking them to your vessel.
values.bgo.event.scavenger.tutorial.step_3: Each vessel has limited container storage. Return to the fleet to unload.
values.bgo.event.scavenger.tutorial.step_4: Discharge docked containers by selecting and getting close to your fleet’s freighter.
values.bgo.event.scavenger.tutorial.step_5: Defeat enemies to capture their cargo.
values.bgo.event.scavenger.tutorial.step_6: You can identify loaded vessels by the cargo symbol.
values.bgo.event.scavenger.tutorial.step_7: If you die or leave the Scavor sector, you will drop all containers.
values.bgo.event.scavenger.tutorial.step_8: Be fast enough to grab containers from other vessels.

values.bgo.event.winter_2016_epilogue.descripti: Hey pilots,%br%you can trade in the earned Contaminated Cubits in Baltar's Lab till the 12th January 23:59:59 CET. Afterwards they will be exchanged for Titanium. You'll keep the event hulls as they will get a new re-occuring purpose soon

Hey pilots,%br%you can trade in the earned Contaminated Cubits in Simon's Lab till the 12th January 23:59:59 CET. Afterwards they will be exchanged for Titanium. You'll keep the event hulls as they will get a new re-occuring purpose soon.
values.bgo.event.winter_2016.description.coloni: Is it just a shadow of the good old days or a glimmer of hope for the future of the human race? Approaching the Scavor sector, the Pegasus is meeting an old friend. But more imperative than that is the unexpected Valkyrie Battlestar on a mission to carry nuclear bombs out of a station, hidden in a radioactive nebula. This could be a pivotal moment in fight against the continuous threat of the persecutors.
values.bgo.event.winter_2016.description.cylon: While the main basestar is still stuck in 242 Apollid, the Guardian Basestar is going to search the humans in some outer sectors. Entering the Scavor sector it gets in contact with another basestar which is trying to cater nuclear bombs from a station, hidden in a radioactive nebula. This could be the deciding factor required to strike out the human race once and for all.
values.bgo.event.winter_epilogue.main_text.colo: Hey pilots,%br%%br%you can trade in the earned shards in Baltar's Lab till the 3rd Apr. 23:59:59 CEST. Afterwards they will be exchanged for Titanium.
values.bgo.event.winter_epilogue.main_text.cylo: Hey pilots,%br%%br%you can trade in the earned shards in Simon's Lab till the 3rd Apr. 23:59:59 CEST. Afterwards they will be exchanged for Titanium.
values.bgo.event.winter.main_text: For more than a year, it seemed like our pilots had beaten back the danger emerging from the darkness, but recently prophets in both factions have once again been suffering horrifying dreams involving Typhon, a mythical wreaker of chaos and destruction in ancient Kobol lore.The legend tells us that Typhon will one day “return from the darkness, claim victory from defeat and rain heavenly judgement upon the children of God, who dared sully his name".%br%%br%Get ready for Typhon's revenge, attack white asteroids and redeem Typhon’s shards in the event shop now!
values.bgo.event.winter.name: Typhon's Revenge

values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_advancedc: You can enter your fleet's flagship, outposts, and bases by docking with them
To dock with a friendly flagship, outpost, or base, select it as your target by clicking on it
Fly towards the target by using the throttle and steering controls
Once you get close enough, the Dock button will appear - click it to enter the ship or base

You can use your ship's boosters to greatly increase your speed%BR% %BR%Click the boosters icon next to the throttle to turn your boosters on and off, or press and hold SPACE to boost%BR% %BR%While boosters are active, they burn Tylium as fuel
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_attack.ma: To attack enemies you must target them, then activate your ship's weapon systems while keeping the target in range
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_attack.st: Select enemy targets by clicking on them or their icons on the DRADIS%BR% %BR%You can also use the Target Enemy icon next to the DRADIS or the X key
Activate your weapons by clicking on their icons or pressing the indicated key%BR% %BR%If the icon is red, the weapon is not in range or pointing at the target
Collect any valuable salvage from defeated enemies via the window that will appear
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_attack.su: There are two basic types of weapon - cannons and missiles%BR% %BR%Different weapons have different ranges and firing arcs - to see which directions a weapon can fire in, move your mouse over its icon on the Heads Up Display
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_buyingcub: If you are out of resources - visit our Get Cubits service (see details below).
If your resources are low, press big Get Cubits button in the right top corner of the Shop window to visit our transaction service. Proceed following instruction.
You will be redirected to our transaction servise web page. It is fast and it is safe.
Select how many Cubits you want to purchase. Press "Buy" to purchase and return to the game.
Cubits are the most valuable resource. Ship Upgrades, high level System Upgrades, purchasing improved ammunition, Mining Ship orders require Cubits
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_buynewshi: You can buy and upgrade ships on your fleet's flagship or outposts.
Access the Ship Store by talking to the appropriate character or using the menu on on the left hand side of the screen
Click on a ship’s the icon at the top of the window to view the ship and see details of its system slots and important statistics
To purchase a new ship, select it and click Requisition%BR% %BR%To upgrade one of your ships, select it and click Upgrade

Each ship has different strengths and weaknesses. You can switch between any of the ships you own at flagships and outposts or bases%BR% %BR%Most ships are available in two different versions: a standard model and an upgraded Advanced model
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_dailyassi: Assignments are tasks that the commanders of your fleet will allocate to you on a daily basis
To get assignments, visit the appropriate character each day and speak to them, then select the [Get Assignments] option
You can view your current assignments on the Assignments tab of your Pilot Log (click the icon in the top-right or press C to open your Pilot Log)
Select an assignment in the list to view its details and the objectives you must achieve to complete it

Colonial pilots get assignments from Captain Adama on the Galactica, while Cylons get their assignments from Number Two on the Basestar%BR% %BR%Each day you will be allocated several assignments - complete them to earn Experience Points and other rewards.
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_dradiscon: Welcome to DRADIS Contact. DRADIS Contact is a game where you take control of the powerful weapons of the Battlestar Galactica or Basestar, and destroy threats to your respective fleet. When you play win special bonus items and rewards.

Click on an enemy signal on the DRADIS. You may select up to six targets at a time. Your first target per day is free, and additional targets cost Cubits. Your chances of winning better items increases if you fire more shots at once. You do not have to select multiple targets to play.
Click the "Fire" button to attack the enemy signals. As the targets are destroyed you will receive rewards and map parts.

After completing the game, click the "Reload" button to play again, select a bonus map to play, or click the close button to exit DRADIS Contact. You can play as many times as you like, but only your first shot per day is free. All additional rounds of play will cost you Cubits.

DRADIS Contact can award you with rare FTL Coordinates that grant access to special bonus maps where you will gain greater rewards and fight special enemies. You are granted one free shot per day, but you can fire on additional target by spending Cubits. Each time you fire at a target, you get a chance to earn an extra reward, or a valuable FTL Coordinate. You can save a lot of time and play multiple games of DRADIS Contact by using the Quick-Play option. Simply choose the number of targets on the screen as normal, and then use the pull down menu at the bottom of the screen to select the number of games you wish to play. When you press fire, DRADIS Contact will play the number of rounds selected.
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_duties.ma: Duties track your performance in different aspects of the war between the Colonial and Cylon fleets
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_duties.st: Click the Pilot Log icon in the upper-right of the screen or press I to open your Pilot Log
Click on the Duties tab to view the Duties you have discovered so far
Click on a Duty in the list to view its details and your current progress
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_duties.su: Duties are unlocked the first time you perform the task or action  involved, so check your Duties list often.%BR% %BR%Duties have 5 levels – completing a Duty level earns you a selectable title.
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_ftl.main_: Faster Than Light (FTL) Jumps allow you to travel between the Star Systems in the Veil Sector at the edge of the Cygnus Nebula
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_ftl.step1: Click this icon or press N to open the Sector Map
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_ftl.step2: Click on a sector within your jump range (indicated by a circle) to select it.
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_ftl.step3: Click on a jump target button to travel to the selected sector. You can always jump to the sector border, but additional options may be available if your faction’s outpost is secured or a group member has dropped a FTL transponder for you.
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_ftl.subma: To perform an FTL jump, open the Sector Map, select the System you want to jump to and click the Jump button%BR% %BR%FTL jumps consume Tylium as fuel%BR% %BR%By default, pressing "K" while a jump is in progress to cancel it. This keybind can be rebound on the options screen
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_ftl.title: FTL Navigation Tutorial
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_ftlmissio: Destroying enemies in DRADIS Contact provides the necessary FTL (Faster-Than-Light) Coordinates to locate supply lines and convoy routes used by the enemy. Collecting Coordinates to gain access to special sectors where you will find vulnerable enemy convoys. Destroying these convoys cripples the enemy and provides you with valuable recources.
Collecting FTL Coordinates: Play DRADIS Contact to earn FTL Coordinates.
Entering an Interdiction Duty Mission:  When all FTL coordinates are collected, click "Play Map" to enter the sector. If you are not ready to play the map, then you can save it for another time.

Playing an Interdiction Duty Mission: When you click "Play Map", you will be transported to the sector in your currently equipped ship. If your ship is destroyed while trying to complete the mission, you may redeploy for a fee in cubits. Each time you respawn the fee increases.

As you play DRADIS Contact, you will gain FTL Coordinates. Each FTL Coordinate is color coded and associated with a specific map. You can unlock a specific map by collecting all the required FTL Coordinates for that map. Each map contains unique PVE gameplay with special enemies and extra rewards. Each sector has seven waves of enemies that spawn. Once all seven waves are completed, you receive your rewards for playing and are transported back to your home base.
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_industria: Industrial Mining allows you to extract useful resources from Planetoids
Click on an Planetoid to select it.
Click on Asteroid Scanner icon to scan the Planetoids for resources.
Click "Yes" in the pop-up window to summon the Mining Ship and defend it until the Planetoid is depleted.

Planetoids have a Mining Ship landing site. Planetoids are highlighted with a color for the resource they contain: yellow for Tylium, blue for Water and purple for Titanium. Depleted Planetoids are colored red.
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_mining.ma: You can mine asteroids by breaking them up with cannon weapons and collecting any valuable resources they contain%BR% %BR%Mineral Analysis systems and mining cannons improve mining efficiency
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_mining.st: target an asteroid by clicking on it
Fire on the asteroid by clicking on the icons for your cannons
When the asteroid breaks up, any valuable resources will be revealed and can be collected via a window%BR%%BR%Note that not all asteroids contain resources
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_mining.su: Mineral Analysis systems allow you to scan asteroids to see if they contain any valuable resources%BR% %BR%Mining cannons are better at breaking up asteroids than normal cannons, but not as effective in combat situations
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_npcintera: On your fleet's flagship and outposts you can access different services and learn more about the Veil sector and the two opposing factions
Click on characters talk to them and access any services they offer
Most services can be accessed by using the menu on the left hand side of the screen
When you wish to leave, click the Undock button at the bottom right corner of the screen

Both flagships and outposts allow you to change, customize, equip and buy new ships as well as to exchange water for cubits. %BR% %BR%On flagships you also can start missions, get assignments, play DRADIS contact and take control of capital ships
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_repair.ma: Combat damage causes Ships and systems to deteriorate over time - this is measured by their Durability
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_repair.st: The maintenance window provides an overview of the condition of your ship and systems
Click on a system or your ship's Hull icon to restore Durability with Titanium%BR% %BR%You can also use Cubits to pay for repairs if you are out of Titanium
If your ship’s Durability drops below 20%, two Systems will temporarily be deactivated based on your ships class.
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_repair.su: When a ship falls below 20% Durability, it suffers penalties until repaired.%BR%%BR%When a System reaches 0% Durability, it cannot be used until it is repaired.%BR% %BR%You can monitor the Durability of your ship and systems on the Ship tab of your Pilot Log.
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_shipcontr: You can fly your ship with the mouse, the keyboard, or a combination of both
Left-click the throttle and drag it up or down to speed up or slow down
Pressing Q will set your throttle to minimum and bring your ship to a stop%BR% %BR%Pressing E will set your throttle to full speed
Steer your ship by right-clicking where you want it to turn to%BR% %BR%You can also use the WASD keys to steer manually
Your current speed is displayed above the DRADIS screen on the Heads Up Display %BR% %BR%Your ship's throttle control is shown to the right of the DRADIS
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_shop.main: You can purchase new systems and restock ammunition and supplies at your fleet's flagship or outposts.
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_shop.step: The Store shows your ship and its system slots on the right%BR% %BR%On the left you can see the store, your hold (inventory) or locker
Purchase items from the store list by clicking the Requisition button%BR% %BR%Systems can be installed by dragging them to slots on your ship
If you purchase more than one type of ammunition for a weapon, right-click on the weapon's icon after undocking to select the type you wish to use
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_shop.subm: There are four main system types that can be installed on your ship - Weapon, Hull, Engine and Computer%BR% %BR%Move your mouse over the icon for a system in the Store to view its details%BR% %BR%Weapon systems require Ammunition, and some other systems consume supplies when they are used
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_storymiss: You will sometimes be given the chance to perform critical missions by the commander of your fleet
Visit the commander of your fleet and speak to them to see if they have any missions available for you
Your commander will brief you on the mission's goals and objectives before offering you the chance to start the mission
Complete all these goals to succeed in the mission - if things go badly, you can Abort the mission and try again another time
Missions will become available as you progress through the ranks and prove your worth to your fleet%BR% %BR%Missions may offer unique rewards or the chance to command advanced ships
values.bgo.HelpScreens.Screens.screen_upgrading: Upgrade your weapons and systems to improve their efficiency. Upgrading is possible up to level 15, but may require you to learn the related skill first. Have a look at a weapon’s or system’s tooltip to see its skill requirements.
Open Shop through dialog options.  Right click on any system installed into your ship's slots or in your Hold or Locker to open Upgrade window.
See System description in the upper side. Click on + and - buttons on "Upgrade Level" scale. See Stats changings and upgrade cost below.
Choose available upgrade level. Click on "Upgrade" button. Or click on "Sell" to sell selected System or "Cancel" to return to Shop.

Upgrading requires Tylium and Cubits until level 10, while level 11 to 15 is only possible by using Tuning Kits. The more Tuning Kits you use, the more likely it is the upgrade is successful. If you are in need of Cubits, have a look at the “Buying Cubits” tutorial.

values.bgo.mail_carrier_migration.Body_Text: Dear pilot,%br%%br%%br%With this update, the carrier’s equipment and slot layout has been redesigned.%br%Besides new systems and a unique role ability, there will be also an advanced mode for the carrier.%br%If you’ve already bought the carrier, we want to thank you for your support.%br%%br%As part of the update process, the items you previously purchased and upgraded have been refunded so you can upgrade the new items.%br%We apologize for the inconvenience this update may have caused,%br%and we’re upgrading your existing carrier to an Advanced Carrier in appreciation for your support of Battlestar Galactica Online.%br%%br%Thank you for your support and enjoy the new carrier!%br%%br%%br%Your Battlestar Galactica Online Team
values.bgo.mail_carrier_migration.Name: Advanced Carrier Promotion
values.bgo.mail_chat_outage_apology.Body_Text: Hey everyone,%br%%br%we are still working on getting the chat issues resolved %br% and we would like to apologize for the inconvenience. %br%With a Double XP Event happening soon, %br%we would like to give everyone a free go at the Convoy Mission. %br%Thanks for being patient!%br%%br%Your BSGO Team

values.bgo.mission_colonial_mining_resources.De: The fleet's reserves are dangerously low, and all pilots are expected to contribute to their own fuel and repair requirements. Locate and mine asteroids with Tylium and Titanium deposits.

values.bgo.mission_colonial_patrol_assignment.D: Our knowledge of the systems in this sector remains incomplete, and up to date information on enemy movements and operations is vital to our success. Patrol the system assigned to you.

values.bgo.mission_colonial_scan_asteroids.Desc: Charting the locations of valuable mineral deposits is of critical importance in our efforts to repair and refuel our fleet. Use a Mineral Analysis system to scan asteroid belts.

values.bgo.mission_colonial_scan_asteroids.Phra: Here's the mineral analysis you requested, Captain. [Asteroid Recon Assignment Complete]
values.bgo.mission_colonial_searching_the_debri: Remnants of the past fighting in this sector and the wreckage of destroyed ships frequently contain urgently needed parts, systems and cargo. Investigate debris fields and recover any useful salvage.
Salvage operations successful, sir. There must have been serious fighting right across this sector some time in the past. [Salvage Recovery Assignment Complete]
Often found in the vicinity of mineral-rich asteroid belts, the automated defense drones in this sector are a constant thorn in the side of our mining operations. Seek them out and eliminate them.
I've cleared out those automated defense drones that were causing problems for our mining ships, Starbuck. [Drone Clearance Assignment Complete]
values.bgo.mission_colonial_story2.Description: Talk to Admiral Adama and select the 'Reporting for duty, sir' option to receive your first mission.%br%%br%Once you complete the mission, talk to the Admiral again to receive further orders.
values.bgo.mission_colonial_story2.Name: Report to Admiral Adama
values.bgo.mission_colonial_taking_out_the_tras: Enemy patrols and recon flights are becoming more frequent throughout the sector, and pose a growing threat to our forces. Intercept and destroy them.
I'm sad to report that the Cylons won't be hearing back from several of their patrols and recon missions, Starbuck. [Intercept Enemy Patrols Assignment Complete]

values.bgo.mission_colonial_top_gun.Phrase__e48: You can consider Cylon operations well and truly disrupted, Starbuck. [Disrupt Enemy Operations Assignment Complete]

values.bgo.mission_event_colonial_foodstuffs.De: The fleet's food stores are in short supply. Destroy Cylons to recover the supplies.
values.bgo.mission_event_colonial_halloween_201: Over the past few days we've been getting reports of bizarre activity.  Pilots are reporting 'phantom' ships in some sectors, and we've lost contact with a number of vessels. Admiral Adama believes they could be some new Cylon tactic. values.bgo.mission_event_colonial_precious_meta: After humanity found the 12 colonies, they forged holy ciborium to honor Poseidon. The precious metals used for making ciborium are in short supply and they have uses outside of the construction of holy artifacts. The Cylons are aware of our efforts and have been claiming these resources for themselves. Destroy Cylons to recover the supplies.
The fleet is in desperate need of new supplies of water. Surveys have shown deposits of ice in the region. This ice is cleaner and requires less processing than most water found in the region. While the fleet secures new resources the people of the fleet are on water rations. The Cylons are aware of our efforts and have been claiming these resources for themselves. Destroy Cylons to recover the supplies.
The Sacred Scrolls say that after humanity had fasted, they found the stars which would guide them to the 12 Colonies. During Poseidon's Light, colonial families burn lamps filled with holy oil to mark the occasion. The oil made from the herbs also had medicinal qualities that are useful to the fleet. The Cylons are aware of our efforts and have been claiming these resources for themselves. Destroy Cylons to recover the supplies.
values.bgo.mission_event_cylon_foodstuffs.Descr: Our agents inform us the humans are performing a religious fast to conserve food. Shatter their supply lines and resolve by claiming the foodstuffs they are gathering. Destroy Colonial vessels to recover the supplies.
values.bgo.mission_event_cylon_foodstuffs.Name: Poseidon's Fast
values.bgo.mission_event_cylon_halloween_2013.D: Reports are coming in among the fleet of 'phantom' ships. We have lost contact with a number of long range reconnaissance units. We believe the humans have developed some new tactics, and need to determine level of the threat.%br%%br%Investigate reports in the following sectors: Tannhauser, Beta Pleiadis, 169 Aretis, 68 Lepporis, Marsamxett, Fenris, Epsilon Krau%br%Report then to Number 2

values.bgo.mission_event_cylon_pristine_ice.Des: The humans' supply lines are stretched thin and near the breaking point. In order to disrupt their supply lines, you are ordered to disrupt their attempts to secure supplies gathered under the auspices of religious ceremonies. This will have the additional effective of destroying the humans' resolve. Destroy Colonial vessels to recover the supplies.
values.bgo.mission_event_cylon_sacred_herbs.Des: Our agents tell us the humans' medical supplies are running short. They are trying to gather medical products. This can not be allowed to happen. Destroy Colonial vessels to recover the supplies.

values.bgo.npc_actingchief.Phrase__03a56dc5-495: I need to access the Fleet Stores. [Buy, Sell, Install and Upgrade items]
Can you assign me a maintenance crew? [Restore Ship and System Durability]
I want to change my ship assignment. [Select ship to command]
I'd like to requisition a new ship. [Buy and Upgrade ships]
values.bgo.npc_actingchief.Phrase__677e9dc5-919: Anything else I can help with, sir?
values.bgo.npc_actingchief.Phrase__6e93200c-0b9: You'll need to speak to Chief Tyrol at the abandoned base in Delta Canopis to requisition or upgrade ships, sir. There's a supply convoy leaving shortly if you'd like to join them?
values.bgo.npc_actingchief.Phrase__9a6d4c22-d23: The Chief has been assigned to the abandoned base we discovered in Delta Canopis, sir. He's taking charge of the salvage and reclaimation operations there, so if you'd like to requisition a new ship or have any other questions, you should pay him a visit.
values.bgo.npc_actingchief.Phrase__af8b852e-9a8: Yes, I'll join the convoy [Travel to Delta Canopis]
No thanks, I'll make my own way there. [Stay on Galactica]
values.bgo.npc_actingchief.Phrase__c8789abd-a86: Are you sure, sir? You'll have to make your own way back.
values.bgo.npc_actingchief.Phrase__ed14ff16-60f: Yes, I'm sure. [Travel to Delta Canopis]
I've changed my mind. [Stay on Galactica]
values.bgo.npc_actingchief.Phrase__f9ec82ed-713: I need to access the Fleet Stores. [Buy, Sell, Install and Upgrade items]
Can you assign me a maintenance crew? [Restore Ship and System Durability]
I want to change my ship assignment. [Select ship to command]
