values.bgo.npc_adama.Name: Admiral Adama
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__09dc7715-77c2-4a84: We've identified some planetoids in a nearby system that may contain valuable resources, Your job is to scan the planetoids, call in a mining ship if you find anything, and defend it if the Cylons come calling.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__0c942eec-f576-44a4: You have two primary goals. You are to find and secure the resources we need to get the fleet fully operational, and to disrupt or destroy all Cylon operations you encounter. We have nowhere to run, so we have to fight for what we need to survive. Now more than ever, the future of the fleet - of mankind itself - rests on the shoulders of you and your fellow pilots.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__0e646bf6-6216-4ea4: Yes. His theory is that the device may have been designed to destroy ships by overloading their FTL drives. If he's right, we were lucky to survive.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__1c33591a-bbda-4eae: We're not sure what about that device you and Starbuck discovered during the battle. What we do know is that the FTL overload it triggered has thrown us far off course and into an uncharted sector of space.%br%%br%You handled yourself well out there, so I hope you're ready for more work.

Welcome back. While you were on patrol we completed our damage assessment.%br%%br%Unfortunately, the situation is worse than we feared. Nearly half of the fleet is in no state to jump safely, and the Galactica's drives will require a complete overhaul before she'll be able to leave this system.

Nice work, %rank%. Those mining systems will help us with our resource problems. We've got a bigger one to handle now though. This sector is cut off from the rest of the galaxy by a vast nebula.%br%%br%We need to find a way through or past it, or we're trapped here... with the Cylons.

I have some good news. Chief Tyrol's team discovered several mothballed strike craft at the abandoned base in the Delta Canopis system. They've been working around the clock and have managed to get one of them flight-ready.
Very well. I have a mission for you... up for some recon?

It's vital that we learn more about the passage into the nebula that you discovered. If it leads right through, we may have found a way out of this sector.%br%%br%Heavy Cylon patrols have been preventing us from getting close enough for extensive scans, but now we may have an edge.

We've been keeping an eye on the Cylon activity around the entrance to the nebula passage. According to our latest recon flights, it looks like the cylons are preparing to construct a permanent base in the area.

Mining vessels and their escorts are under attack in the Akhlys Arm region of the Veil. We've lost two mining vessels to Cylon ambushes already. We can’t afford any more losses if we ever hope to escape this nebula and find Earth.
We're evaluating our latest intel, %name%. For now, I need you to focus on your daily assignments and defending the fleet.
You've performed well, %rank%, but you still have a lot to learn. Report back to me when you've gained more experience in the field.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__1ef3d7b2-997a-4a2f: Our priorities are clear. We have to get the fleet fully operational. We have to find a way past the nebula and back to known space. And we have to hold off the Cylons for long enough to achieve those goals.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__238041dd-ca7d-410e: Begin Rhino active duty test flight [Start Mission]
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__291db8f2-d260-4308: They have. There's heavy Cylon activity in one specific area. I want you to take a Raptor and see what they're up to - or what they've found.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__2bdf6d4a-0782-4959: What if there's no way past?
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__31f74673-7646-407b: What can I do to help, Admiral?
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__35a28c51-21f0-4ade: Requesting temporary command of the Pegasus, sir. [Command Battlestar]
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__3fda1f93-211b-4cfe: What else do you want to know, %rank%?
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__49d37b34-7b39-43cc: Even if we can get the fleet operational again, though, we face another problem.  We're in dire need of resources.  Without them, we can't make the repairs we need to leave. That's where you come in, %name%.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__4ad2821e-0bc3-48c0: Lieutenant Gaeta has been trying, but this sector seems to be cut off from the rest of the galaxy by a large nebula. Until we can find a way around or through it, we won't be able to plot a course back to known space.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__4ea79a42-a810-409b: Recon reports indicate that the Cylons may be taking a similar approach, so we'll also keep you up to date with our best estimates of any enemy outpost locations via your sector map. Taking them out or forcing their withdrawal from a system will seriously hamper Cylon operations, so consider them high priority targets.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__5374cdac-01ce-4b15: We're not sure. Doctor Baltar thinks that the device you and Starbuck discovered just before the Cylon attack may have been some form of experimental weapon, perhaps a relic from the First Cylon War.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__553e6205-9e78-4bfa: Yes. Firstly, there's the question of operational support. While the Galactica's drive systems undergo repairs we've decided to use smaller supply vessels as outposts where you and your fellow pilots will be able to repair and rearm. Unfortunately, we don't have many ships that are up to the task and still have FTL capability.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__5b124391-129f-495b: Exactly. If the Cylons can repair their ships before we repair ours, we'll be sitting ducks. It's critical that we do not allow that to happen.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__5b93c2ee-db5c-48bc: This sector may be small, but it still contains several dozen unexplored star systems. Any one of them could contain vital resources or elements of the Cylon fleet.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__5bd0401e-131f-4626: I'll tell you what we know.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__5e01634d-777a-4ffd: Yes, sir. Have the scouts found something?
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__5ea89fe4-e0d9-41f7: Yes, but they're not combat vessels, so they'll be under orders to jump out if they come under sustained attack. You'll need to defend them if you want them to maintain position in a contested system.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__61070b84-35a8-4e48: What's really going to determine whether we make it out of this sector alive, though, are our mining ships. It's vital that we find and control as many mineral-rich planetoids as possible. As with outposts, your sector map will update to show the positions of both friendly and enemy mining ships in operation. You'll also see an estimate of the total resources being extracted by both sides across all systems in the sector.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__692f8396-c464-4fd2: To an extent. Captain Adama will have assignments for you on a daily basis, and I'll occasionally need you for critical missions. Beyond that, however, you'll largely be free to act as you see fit.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__6a0ea785-54dc-41a9: There's a way. As your recon mission and others have discovered, we're not the first people to find this place. If they found a way in, we can find a way out.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__6a4e6af8-4353-43e4: Doctor Baltar is still researching the information you brought back. In the meantime, we will conduct a recon mission and search for supplies. We've detected potential resources nearby and you will assist Captain Adama with all operations.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__720c3a3f-a0b6-4533: That'll make it a lot harder for us to find out more about the passage, sir.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__73a4316b-1f21-486e: I know I can, which is why I've decided to put you on detached duty status.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__776583cb-31fb-4ffa: Not good. All our ships made it here in one piece, but the whole fleet has suffered system failures and other damage from the stress of the uncontrolled jump. At least half of our ships - including the Galactica - will need extensive repairs before they can bring their FTL drives back on line, and we burned through almost all our Tylium reserves.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__7981dbf4-c483-4172: Thank you, sir. Coming from you, that means a lot.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__8356f68f-8eb5-4e5e: I understand, sir. [Pegasus currently in use]
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__84b106a1-5d27-4efb: There's a lot of ground to cover.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__88825394-7b15-4b70: I'll be acting independently of the chain of command?
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__898460c0-fa20-42d7: Yes, the ship checked out fine in the initial test flights. It's not very fast or agile compared to a Viper, but its hull is extremely tough and resilient. The chief calls it a 'Rhino'.%br%%br%Now I need you to put it through its paces on a real mission, %rank%.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__9662e3b6-cf6c-4955: We've been thrown way off course and into unknown space. We've arrived in a cluster of star systems on the very edge of one of the spiral arms, but our exact location is unclear.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__966dafe6-ca22-4b97: Are there any strategic considerations I should be aware of?
Can you brief me on our situation?
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__96f51e02-008c-4dd9: As far as we know we're the first people ever to visit this sector, %rank%. Still, keep your wits about you. We don't yet know what happened to the Cylons, but my gut tells me they're out there.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__97dd1a99-3318-40ce: They're here. And they'll be coming after us. It seems likely that they'll have suffered similar damage from the uncontrolled jump, but they'll be doing everything they can to repair and rearm for an attack. We're in a race against time.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__9d0c0c28-b339-4574: I'm on my way, sir! Start Mission]
Can you tell me more about the Akhlys Arm?
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__9d48fefb-e3af-4378: The Akhlys Arm is a dense part of the Veil nebula. The electromagnetic storms will wreak havoc on your DRADIS. Wireless contact will be spotty at best. Watch out for Cylons in this region – they’ve already taken out two mining ships and their escorts.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__a46b1c65-feb0-4931: And we need to make sure we're getting more than the toasters?
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__a5159792-9638-42e8: The Chief has refit a Raptor with some interesting Mining systems. I want you to put them through their paces and see how they perform in the field.%br%%br%We've identified a suitable test location, and Apollo will talk you through their operation when you arrive.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__a5d4cc23-3544-4cfc: I understand, sir. I wish to take command immediately. [Command Pegasus for 1 hour: %CapShipCost% Merits]
Thank you, sir. I'll return when I am ready to take command. [Cancel request]
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__a720d468-38c6-44f6: I've read Starbuck's report on your performance during the battle. She says you performed above and beyond the call of duty, %name%.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__ac043882-f184-4036: I understand, sir. [Not enough Merits: %CapShipCost% Merits required]
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__ad6953ae-b479-492e: For the time being. But while your discoveries in the Delta Canopis system raise many questions, they've also offered us an unexpected source of aid.%br%%br%The Chief's initial reports from the abandoned base are very promising. They've already found industrial machinery that can be scavenged for parts, and are continuing to explore the complex.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__adf80a09-40dc-4842: You can count on me, sir.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__b299daab-b37c-49d0: We’re increasing patrols in the Akhlys Arm. I'm assigning you temporary command of the Stiletto, a Scythe-Class escort. You’ll lead the patrol and engage any Cylons you find.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__b4575054-1ab8-4ffe: What's the status of the fleet?
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__b5170f17-818f-45f3: We're still not sure where we are, but we think that device you discovered during the battle may have overloaded our FTL drive.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__b6f267cc-31f6-4366: The whole fleet suffered a massive FTL drive malfunction, throwing us far beyond the red line and into this unexplored sector.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__b9877849-54af-4549: What would you like to know?
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__c31327bd-762c-4ef8: Exactly. With the Galactica's FTL drive out of action and emissions from the nebula making communications unreliable, coordinating our operations across so many systems is going to be impossible. I've decided to give promising pilots like yourself more freedom to make your own decisions in the field.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__c367a093-ca00-43e1: How did we even get here?
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__c807e321-2e6b-45ee: Anything else you want to know?
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__ca82426b-cba3-4cd4: Sensor data from just before the misjump shows the Cylon FTL drives overloading at the same time as ours. It looks like whatever happened to us happened to them, too.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__cc0d3112-1e80-4db8: With the Galactica's FTL drives out of action, the Pegasus is our only combat-ready Battlestar at this time. I can only justify its use in operations under the command of my finest officers, and unfortunately you have yet to prove yourself ready, %Rank%.
Your service to this fleet has been outstanding, %Rank%, but unfortunately the Pegasus is currently on another combat assignment under the temporary command of one of your fellow officers.

Very well, %Rank%, based on your exemplary record I am willing to authorize the deployment of the Pegasus under your temporary command.%br%%br%I can only give you one hour to complete your objectives, however. We can't afford to leave the reclaimed base in Delta Canopis vulnerable for any longer.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__cf2f7eda-c2fe-4983: You can count on me, Admiral.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__d0024daa-5b11-492f: I'm ready to do my part, sir.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__d4572553-7134-4835: Yes sir! Just tell me what to do.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__d47e96f5-f0c9-4bb7: I understand, Admiral. I won't let you down.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__d8bae8d8-f405-44e9: Exactly, %rank%. We can't allow the Cylons to get dug in. We've been tracking a Cylon supply convoy heading to the nebula. I need you to take it out before it arrives.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__d9fb7c97-c05b-41d2: Yes. Chief Tyrol's team has been working on some the derelict Escort class hulls we've recovered, and reports that the first of them is ready for active duty.%br%%br%You're to take command, %rank%, and use its range and firepower to break through the Cylon patrols so a Raptor can perform the scans we need.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__daa32c81-1e27-497e: We've outfitted a Raptor with specialized sensors. You are to escort it while the crew performs scans at the edge of the nebula to determine whether the fleet will be able to jump through. %br%%br%It's vital that we get these readings, %rank%, so make sure you keep the Raptor safe at all costs.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__db4719c2-7537-401a: Be ready for anything out there, %name%. The Cylons may have came to same conclusions we have. If they have, they'll do what they can to stop us. Don't let that happen.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__e4035096-1822-4a9f: Understood, sir. What do you need me to do?
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__e46996d3-d327-4be7: Almost. We have enough for limited reconnaissance and patrol operations, but it's vital that we find and secure any Tylium deposits in this sector.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__e736b66e-171c-456b: We'll be sending them to the systems where they're needed most, according to the amount of resources being gathered and the number of enemy ships defeated. Your sector map will automatically update to display their current positions and provide details on each system's activity levels.
values.bgo.npc_adama.Phrase__fa6867c3-c112-4c21: Glad to hear it. While we evaluate the damage suffered by the fleet, we've started recon flights to the nearby star systems to gather more information about our position.%br%%br%You've been assigned to investigate a system a few light years away. Continue recon operations under Captain Adama's supervision.
values.bgo.npc_apollo.Name: Apollo
values.bgo.npc_apollo.Phrase__10f27104-3e6e-450: You can turn in completed assignments directly in your pilot's log.
values.bgo.npc_apollo.Phrase__128a6d72-467b-43c: Assignments are important tasks we need our pilots to complete. They play a vital role in our efforts to protect and repair the fleet.
values.bgo.npc_apollo.Phrase__54cc5aec-b142-457: Can you tell me more about assignments?
values.bgo.npc_apollo.Phrase__747b1da0-c1fa-453: Good, I'll update your status on the board. Here are today's assignments - check your log for the details.
values.bgo.npc_apollo.Phrase__82ecac97-96a4-471: What can I do for you, %Rank%?
values.bgo.npc_apollo.Phrase__9f854927-4f25-47f: How do I keep track of my assignments?
values.bgo.npc_apollo.Phrase__a0073a8a-89ae-44f: I allocate assignments to all our pilots according to the decisions made in the daily command briefings, so be sure to report for duty each day so I can update your orders.
values.bgo.npc_apollo.Phrase__d4dbfa94-fbf0-467: You can find full details of all your current assignments and any progress you've made towards completing them in the assignments section of your pilot's log.
values.bgo.npc_apollo.Phrase__e4896283-ffab-4f7: Excuse me, Captain. Do you have a moment?
values.bgo.npc_apollo.Phrase__f9779f3f-0cb4-485: How often will I receive assignments?
values.bgo.npc_basestar.Name: Basestar
values.bgo.npc_centurion.Name: Overlord Commander
values.bgo.npc_cylon_datastream.Name: Datastream
values.bgo.npc_galactica.Name: Galactica
values.bgo.npc_generic.Name: Fey
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__00e8bfae-1716-42: Starbuck keeps track of combat tasks like Disrupt Enemy Operations, Intercept Enemy Patrols, Disable Weapon Platforms and Drone Clearances, so let her know when you finish one of those.
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__042b9ff7-2e71-4f: I'll do that. Thank you, sir.
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__10f27104-3e6e-45: For operational objectives like System Patrols, Asteroid Recons, Resource Extractions and Salvage Recoveries, report back to me.
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__128a6d72-467b-43: Assignments are important tasks we need our pilots to complete. They play a vital role in our efforts to protect and repair the fleet.
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__3dee8ecb-68a9-41: For Fleet Support and your daily Supply Allocation, you should report to the acting chief on the Galactica's hangar deck.
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__42ad9491-bd7f-4e: Can you tell me more about assignments?
Can you brief me on our current situation?
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__54cc5aec-b142-45: Can you tell me more about assignments?
Can you brief me on our current situation?
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__747b1da0-c1fa-45: Good, I'll update your status on the board. Here are today's assignments - check your log for the details.
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__82ecac97-96a4-47: What can I do for you, %Rank%?
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__9f854927-4f25-47: How do I keep track of my assignments?
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__a0073a8a-89ae-44: I allocate assignments to all our pilots according to the decisions made in the daily command briefings, so be sure to report for duty each day so I can update your orders.
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__a6ac02a7-8b24-4b: You should report to the Admiral in the CIC. He wants to brief all our pilots personally.
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__d4dbfa94-fbf0-46: You can find full details of all your current assignments and any progress you've made towards completing them in the assignments section of your pilot's log.
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__e4896283-ffab-4f: Excuse me, Captain. Do you have a moment?
values.bgo.npc_generic.Phrase__f9779f3f-0cb4-48: How often will I receive assignments?
values.bgo.npc_humanoutpost.Name: Outpost Quartermaster
values.bgo.npc_humanoutpost.Phrase__03a56dc5-49: Can you assign me a maintenance crew? [Restore Ship and System Durability]
I want to support the fleet with a contribution of water. [Exchange Water for Cubits]
values.bgo.npc_humanoutpost.Phrase__04b7c667-33: Take good care of her, sir. If you need my guys to fix anything else, just let me know.
values.bgo.npc_humanoutpost.Phrase__4397dd12-e7: You have donated %WaterAmountExchange% water to the fleet reserves. The Admiral has authorized me to give you %CubitAmountExchange% Cubits. Thanks for your service to the fleet.
values.bgo.npc_humanoutpost.Phrase__6847cdbf-5d: I've got a couple of talented artists in my team, sir. Bear in mind, though, that regulations prevent us from altering the appearance of standard ships. I can only let them work on advanced ships that have been permanently assigned to a particular pilot or captain.
values.bgo.npc_humanoutpost.Phrase__a834b490-11: We'll have her ready for you when you leave, sir.
values.bgo.npc_humanoutpost.Phrase__adbc737a-52: I'm happy to be of help.
values.bgo.npc_humanoutpost.Phrase__d0ce0e14-99: Yes, I would like to donate %WaterAmountExchange% Water to the fleet reserves for %CubitAmountExchange% Cubits.
No, I will contribute water at a later time.
values.bgo.npc_humanoutpost.Phrase__e4c32bc4-4d: Anything else I can help with?
values.bgo.npc_humanoutpost.Phrase__e8a0b80c-51: You can currently donate %MaxWaterAmountExchange% water to the fleet stores. You have %WaterInHold% water in your hold. The current exchange rate is 1 Cubit per %WaterCubitExchangeRate% Water. Would you like to donate water to the fleet reserves?
Sorry, you cannot donate water at the moment, our water tanks are full. Come back later.
I'm sorry, it seems you don't have enough water for donation in your hold. Come back later.
values.bgo.npc_humanoutpost.Phrase__ea8b9bd3-36: I'd like to requisition a new ship. [Buy, Upgrade and Change ships]
I need to access the Fleet Stores. [Buy, Sell, Install and Upgrade items]
I think my ship could do with something special. [Rename ship and customize appearance]
values.bgo.npc_humanoutpost.Phrase__f1256e30-98: Sure, what do you need, sir?
values.bgo.npc_no1.Name: Number One
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__1735beda-3ce7-47fa-b: Data gathering an retrieval is the objective here, %rank%. Your priority is to gather the information we need.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__17772a8a-7a05-44c4-a: Access denied, %Rank%. While this Basestar's FTL drives are being repaired, only the secondary Basestar is fully operational, and I will only allow its deployment under the command of our most dedicated pilots. You must prove yourself worthy, %Rank%.
Your skills and dedication are impressive, %Rank%, but the secondary Basestar is currently deployed in combat operations under the temporary command of one of your brothers.

You have proved yourself in service to the Cylon, %Rank%, so I am willing to grant your request for temporary command of the secondary Basestar.%br%%br%Be advised that your command access will be limited to one hour. I will not allow the reclaimed base at 47 Tartalon to go unguarded for any longer.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__1bd80b18-6c68-490c-b: What else do you want to know?
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__1d9e159e-4d41-4ab5-9: The Eights investigating the abandoned base you discovered have come across mining systems of considerable ingenuity and believe that they can be adapted for use by our ships.%br%%br%They have integrated the systems on a Heavy Raider, and you are to evaluate their performance.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__22ee3e58-245e-457a-b: We’re increasing patrols in the Akhlys Arm. I'm assigning you temporary command of the Fantasm, a Banshee Class escort. You’ll lead the patrol and engage any humans you find. Try not to screw it up!
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__26f5a668-1033-4e4d-a: Investigate your designated star system. Continue to assist Six with the survey program. Obey her directives and gather as much data as possible.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__330578f3-50f4-48a1-8: What's on your recently-expanded mind, my metal friend?
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__411289b5-3ccd-4384-b: Even more important, though, is that we find and gain control of any planetoids containing large mineral deposits. As with the outposts, you should protect our mining ships and treat any human ones as high priority targets. Your sector map routines will provide you with an estimate of the current resource income being provided by the mining ships of both sides, and their positions.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__43f97db6-e86a-4f8f-8: The Basestar is in poor condition and we will have to conduct repairs. Six is waiting to oversee resource survey operations. You will assist her in this task.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__468f200c-90a3-459d-b: We're working on that. In the meantime, I suggest you do what you do best, and leave the deep thinking to us, %rank%.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__4d35d6cb-0f29-4bfc-b: We think it was designed to destroy ships by triggering a massive overload in their FTL drives. Ingenious, but clearly flawed... we're still here, after all.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__4db6867b-3dcd-43c6-a: Uncomfortably low. We have enough for limited patrols and fleet operations, but we'll need to collect any Tylium we can find, and soon... or we're marooned here.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__4e94e668-1dce-4ba3-9: It should go without saying that if you encounter any human ships performing a similar role, they should be destroyed or driven off. We must do everything we can to impede their repair efforts while we continue our own.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__50100902-f5dc-41d3-8: We have been able to start bringing some of the larger derelict ships discovered in 47 Tartalon back into active service. Number Eight reports that the first of the Escort class hulls is now combat ready.%br%%br%Take command of the ship and use its range and firepower to engage the human patrols while a Heavy Raider gathers sensor data.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__5a657a88-5f06-44fc-b: Ever eager to rid creation of humanity, eh?  Good.  Sadly, we're not sure exactly where the humans are. Your primary objective is unchanged - find and destroy them.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__62e56cd0-0470-46a9-9: There are a number of theories. Six believes it may have been a weapon system, a relic of the first war with the Colonials.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__6465e3b0-5bb3-4cfd-a: We're still not sure exactly what happened to get us here. When the humans jumped away from our attack, some kind of pulse effect triggered a massive overload in the FTL drives of both fleets and flung us far beyond normal jump range.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__66496944-cc00-4e05-a: We've been presented with both a problem and an opportunity. Much of our fleet is crippled, but it seems unlikely that the human ships will have fared any better than ours. If we can bring our ships back to active status quickly enough, we'll be able to destroy them easily.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__6f765220-f9d7-4d75-9: I don't like it, but the others have convinced me that our only option is to give our pilots the ability to operate independently of centralised control. So I've authorized the reconfiguration of several of our pilots, including yourself.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__704336c6-5306-4065-8: Until this Basestar is fully operational, though, fully coordinating our operations across an entire sector is going to be impossible. Which is where you and your 'brothers' come in.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__72399ad7-414b-4235-a: This cannot be allowed. We have identified a human convoy carrying the supplies the humans need. You are to intercept and destroy it.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__7867232d-6a11-4881-a: Much of the fleet has suffered severe system failures from the stress of the uncontrolled jump, including this Basestar. %br%%br%While we assess the extent of the damage, we are initiating surveys of all nearby star systems. You are to take part in this effort.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__820a5de6-3ec8-4c76-a: Should any humans interrupt your mission, feel free to deal with them... harshly.%br%%br%However, your primary objective is clear. Ensure that the Heavy Raider completes its mission and returns safely - with that data!
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__8344e763-fa36-4f77-a: We have managed to bring several Strike craft discovered at the base into full operational status. Initial analysis indicates that these 'Marauders', while not as fast or agile as our Raiders and Heavy Raiders, are extremely durable.%br%%br%You are to pilot one of these ships on a resource extraction mission, so we can continue to analyse its performance.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__86d7cff0-67c0-494f-b: That being said, we may need more of your fancy flying. That device you discovered seems to have overloaded our FTL drive.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__8952fa66-9bfd-4e68-b: Yes, yes, I was getting to that. You are to seek out the humans and prevent them from gathering the resources they no doubt require, while harvesting what we need for ourselves. The Twos will have assignments for you on a regular basis, and I will occasionally require you for critical missions, but otherwise you'll be largely free to act for the good of the Cylon.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__8b58d1e5-09a1-481b-a: An Eight will relay specific objectives to you once you arrive in the target area.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__980e04f2-4b05-4d58-b: Our remaining hybrid seems convinced that they're in this sector. We'll know soon enough - if they're here, they'll likely be in need of resources. That means human scouts, and if we're detected, human attacks.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__9af366c5-1f9f-40bf-b: Well don't just stand there, then. Get on with it.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__9c443e97-391c-46cb-b: We have detected a great deal of human activity in an area right at the edge of the nebula. You are to investigate and find out what they're doing there, %rank%.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__9ffba54d-9529-48a1-8: Query: Possible location of Colonial Fleet.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__ae26452b-e8f8-4fea-b: What do you want to know?
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__b1ca040c-c1f0-4881-8: There are two elements of our strategy that are important for you to understand. The first concerns operational support. With one of our Basestars crippled and the other assigned to protect the strange base we discovered, we'll be using light support ships as mobile outposts where you'll be able to repair and rearm.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__b493200b-ef7c-4f17-8: We don't have a lot of these ships available, so we'll assign them to high activity systems - those where we're currently harvesting large quantities of resources or defeating many human ships. Your sector map routines will update with their locations and the activity status of each system. Be sure to protect the outposts, though, as they'll be forced to jump out if the humans mount a determined assault.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__b59f4df9-842d-4ce4-b: Yes, you are, but don't go getting any bright ideas. It's strictly a temporary measure until the fleet is fully operational and we can finally rid ourselves of the human pests.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__b5b4096c-f645-45ca-a: The Akhlys Arm is a dense part of the Veil nebula. The electromagnetic storms will wreak havoc on your DRADIS. Wireless contact will be spotty at best. Watch out for humans in this region – they’ve already taken out two mining ships and their escorts.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__b6dc2f9b-0555-4ecc-b: I believe the nebula is impassable by FTL jumps. As the humans lack both the range and supplies to jump around it, they cannot escape us. But we need to be certain about this, my metal friend. We've thought we had them trapped before.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__bfbe651f-c339-423f-b: Yes, yes, I was getting to that. I'm sending a team in a Heavy Raider to scan and analyze the nebula... to confirm that it does, in fact, cut this sector off from the rest of the galaxy. You are to escort them and provide protection while they collect data.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__c5f4a8f9-6777-4688-9: Sadly, there's a nebula interfering with our systems and preventing contact with the Colony. Until we find a way out of here, we're cut off from the rest of our brothers and sisters.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__ce9f55e1-573a-4168-b: Despite our recent losses, you performed within acceptable thresholds during the battle, %rank%. Very promising.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__cff1792b-820e-44ca-9: We've got our best minds working on that little problem, believe me. I have no intention of spending eternity floating inside a damned nebula.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__d13dcd65-8866-4480-b: We've arrived in an unexplored region of space, apparently at the very edge of the galaxy.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__d7670af4-a430-4062-a: Be vigilant, %rank%. Our analysis of the misjump indicates a high probability that the human fleet will have also emerged in this sector.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__dd81b06f-58f8-4517-8: Requesting more information on the Akhlys Arm.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__e4896283-ffab-4f79-8: Ah, there you are, %Rank%. I assume you have some questions?
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__e4f8fe0d-4851-44b0-9: An Eight will instruct you further in the use of the systems once you arrive at the designated evaluation coordinates. If the simulations are correct, they should greatly improve the rate at which we can harvest resources from the systems in this sector.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__ea96bd28-35c9-4f72-8: Initiate command access. [Command Basestar for 1 hour: %CapShipCost% Merits]
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__eb7e080b-7a3a-4d85-8: However, we have more pressing concerns right now. Our systems analysis has shown that much of the fleet will require extensive repairs to restore operational capacity.%br%%br%Those repairs require resources, well beyond what we have within the fleet.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__ebd157de-e43a-4a33-b: You must ensure that the Heavy Raider gathers the data we require, %rank%. Protect it at all costs.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__ee0a629d-2d45-4e4a-9: Grim, at the moment. The uncontrolled jump has caused significant damage to many of our ships and almost completely drained our tylium reserves. The FTL systems of this Basestar have been crippled, and the trauma of the uncontrolled jump has sent its hybrid into a catatonic state.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__f0d8fcea-41bb-4e8c-8: Until now, heavy human patrols have prevented us from gaining additional data. But now we may have the means to do so.
values.bgo.npc_no1.Phrase__f920a518-b08a-4270-9: Yes, I have a task for you, %rank%. Information. The FTL overload that interrupted our attack on the humans has thrown us far into unexplored space. %br%%br%We must have more data on our surroundings if we are to formulate an appropriate strategy.

This is most curious. Clearly this sector has not only been explored but also occupied and, it seems, fought over at some point in the past. %br%%br%Yet our archives contain no relevant data of any kind about this place or the Cylons who appear to have preceded us.

Welcome back... %name%, is it?  Interesting choice. I've an update for you. The humans were thrown into this sector as well, just as I suspected.%br%%br%It's likely they suffered systems failures similar to our own, but their inefficiency makes it unlikely that they'll restore operational status before us.
Number Eight has reported significant success in our efforts to make use of the resources discovered in the abandoned base at 47 Tartalon. As a result, I have a task for you, %name%.
The humans efforts to elude us continue, %name%. They seem to be focussed on finding a way past or through the nebula that cuts this sector off from the rest of the galaxy.
It's critical that we learn more about the passage that the humans have found into the nebula, %name%. If it extends far enough, it may provide them a way to escape us, and this cannot be allowed.
Our scouts report that the humans are attempting to fortify their position at the entrance to the nebula passage.

Mining vessels and their escorts are under attack in the Akhlys Arm region of the Veil. We've lost two mining vessels to human ambushes already. We can’t afford any more losses – get out there and make yourself useful!
The hybrid is processing the latest intel, %name%. For now, I need you to focus on your daily assignments and defending the Cylon from Colonial aggression. Understood?
Your dedication pleases me, %name%, but you will need more experience for the tasks ahead. Return when your programming has advanced further.
values.bgo.npc_no2.Name: Number Two
values.bgo.npc_no2.Phrase__000fdd76-195c-47f4-a: Your willingness to serve is commendable. I've transferred updated assignment data to your pilot log routines. You will find the relevant details enclosed.
values.bgo.npc_no2.Phrase__4276f62a-dafe-4dd2-9: We analyze our tactical and strategic situation, generate objectives and allocate them to our pilots as assignments on a daily basis. Return tomorrow for your next updates.
values.bgo.npc_no2.Phrase__6d94b990-780a-42c2-8: You can turn in completed assignments directly in your pilot's log.
values.bgo.npc_no2.Phrase__9e7bd62e-3dbc-4d7b-b: Assignments are tactical and strategic objectives judged important to our repair operations and efforts to keep the humans weak until we can destroy them.
values.bgo.npc_no2.Phrase__e4896283-ffab-4f79-8: Welcome, %Rank%. Are you here to offer service?
values.bgo.npc_no2.Phrase__f26cfd2e-1bb8-473f-8: Current assignment data is held in your pilot log routines, which will automatically update to reflect any progress you make towards achieving your objectives.
values.bgo.npc_no6.Name: Number Six
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__065f0bdd-3c41-4e40-8: And what, exactly, is on that evolving mind of yours, %name%?
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__231a3227-b35b-4718-a: Tall, shiny and direct. I think I like you already. What can I do for you?
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__3b81c594-d703-48ba-9: Be wary of the humans, %name%. They have a remarkable capacity for violence, and I'd hate to lose you before you can reach your full potential.
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__3c23df73-aa60-4fce-a: Very well. Do you have the proper protocals to operate the DRADIS array, %name%?
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__46d3c537-4f19-49bb-9: The DRADIS is used to detect long range anomalies. Any hostile signals detected are destroyed with the Basestar's main weapon array. Raiders then recover any wreckage for intelligence purposes.
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__57517814-5c42-4463-b: You can currently contribute %MaxWaterAmountExchange% water to the Basestar reserves. You have %WaterInHold% water in your hold. The current exchange rate is 1 Cubit per %WaterCubitExchangeRate% Water. Would you like to donate water to the Basestar reserves?
Basestar water reserves are full. Come back later.
Seems like you don't have enough water for donation in your hold. Come back later.
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__5aba71a8-f446-4462-a: Cavil has made it abundantly clear that he wishes to provide an overview of our situation to all our reconfigured pilots personally, so you should go ask him about that.
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__5d6898ee-4907-40e3-9: Operation of the DRADIS array is resource intensive, and I can permit you to operate it once per day. Any additional uses of the array require a sacrifice of the Basestar's limited resources. Do you wish to operate the DRADIS array?
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__63677f55-5a1f-4b21-a: There are three escort designs we've managed to recover so far, each with a different role specialization, but all are well-suited to their primary purpose of protecting larger vessels against agile strike craft.
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__6d3fdda9-f623-42e0-8: Yes, it figures that a mind designed for flying would be interested in the new 'bodies' we've managed to recover from that abandoned base. There are several types - a remarkably durable strike ship and even a few escort and line ship designs.
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__7526ca88-3f0d-4f27-8: Optimal efficiency is best achieved by a combined force of strike, escort and line ships working in unison. And we all know how much the Ones value efficiency, don't we?
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__8ad25cd0-2273-477c-a: Affirmative, Contribution: %WaterAmountExchange% Water to Basestar reserves for %CubitAmountExchange% Cubits.
Negative. Water stores are insufficient. Contribution will take place at a later time.
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__a1a91f52-08b6-4b53-b: Excellent. Basestar reserves have been increased by %WaterAmountExchange% water. We are authorized to provide %CubitAmountExchange% Cubits for your contribution. Your extraordinary service has been noted. You may continue your operational protocols.
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__a31c8d09-ffc8-448f-a: Water stores at maximum. Transfer to Basestar requested [Exchange water for cubits]
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__bfca6c79-1215-478b-8: I believe the humans are calling it the Marauder. It's proving to be extremely resilient, making it particularly effective against larger targets when equipped with high yield missile systems. It does, however, lack the speed of the Raider or the electronic warfare and support abilities of the Heavy Raider.
values.bgo.npc_no6.Phrase__d6b04ed3-ce1e-4c91-9: We've also come across three variations of these massive ships. They all pose a deadly threat to escort ships, but they are vulnerable to strike craft as their heavy weapon systems have difficulties effectively tracking them.
values.bgo.npc_no8.Name: Number Eight
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__06d99d0d-f103-483f-9: There are ship systems, components and even entire hulls. We've already been able to adapt some of them to control routines suitable for you and your brothers, and we should be able to bring some of the larger and more powerful hulls online as well. If you can find enough resources in this sector, you'll have several types of new body to use against the humans.
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__0e2807da-69c8-4e88-a: Access equipment archive. [Buy, Sell, Install and Upgrade items]
Request additional hull. [Buy, Upgrade and Change ships]
Revise hull designators. [Rename ship and customize appearance]
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__1f28b69b-781a-4e8c-a: You can harvest resources by breaking up asteroids with mineral deposits - fortunately many of the systems in this sector appear to contain asteroids rich in the materials we require - or by locating large planetoids with significant resource content and requesting a mining ship to extract them. A mineral analysis system will allow you to scan both asteroids and planetoids and identify useful ones.
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__35611029-6746-4055-a: Assign maintenance systems. [Repair ship and modules]
Access hull options. [Select, buy, upgrade and customize ships]
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__4b7da9a5-f119-40ad-8: Fascinating, isn't it? In many ways it resembles one of our own processing and manufacturing complexes, yet we have no records of ever having explored this area of the galaxy. Some of the others suspect it may have been some kind of secret installation from the first war with the humans, but I don't know. It seems older than that... Although it couldn't be.
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__4b99a3bc-43dc-4023-8: We need tylium, titanium and water the most. The uncontrolled jump that the humans somehow triggered consumed nearly all our fuel, so tylium is in short supply. Titanium is required for structural repairs of the Basestars and other ships, and water is needed to replenish control pathways and related systems.
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__624a26dc-fc0f-4162-a: It must be incredible, feeling the vacuum against your 'skin'... What do you need?
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__63e4eecc-d7b3-4624-8: Sometimes I think I envy you, having these beautiful bodies to choose from...  Anyway, hull allocation completed.
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__72ff570c-5992-4654-b: Query: Limited equipment and hull access.
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__857ad316-b9e6-4dd8-9: They were clearly Cylon, but we don't know who they were, what they were doing here or even why they left. All the systems have had their data completely eradicated - only the physical hardware remains - but some of that hardware is going to be very useful.
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__9886155c-8199-4ca6-8: Would you like to know anything else?
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__ac099b7c-9fdc-4094-a: You may also find useful resources and other materials in the wreckage of human ships you destroy, or in the debris fields scattered throughout many of the systems in this sector. Neither are particularly reliable sources, but right now everything you can find will be useful.
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__ae90eea6-549a-493c-8: What would you like to know?
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__b786cc75-ad64-4920-b: Be aware that you can only revise visual designators on advanced hulls that have been permanently assigned to you, pilot.
values.bgo.npc_no8.Phrase__d9003afb-dc65-45af-8: Unfortunately our supply situation is so critical that we cannot allow you and your brothers free access and have been forced to introduce a resource exchange policy. Access to hulls and equipment is dependant on the resources you can harvest for the fleet - the more resources you bring us, the more you will be able to access.
values.bgo.npc_no8hangar.Name: Number Eight
values.bgo.npc_no8hangar.Phrase__35611029-6746-: Access equipment archive. [Buy, Sell, Install and Upgrade items]
Assign maintenance systems. [Restore ship and system Durability]
Initiate hull transfer. [Select ship to command]
Request additional hull. [Buy and Upgrade ships]
values.bgo.npc_no8hangar.Phrase__37cc0a9d-3644-: Please confirm, pilot. You will need to make your own way back from the base.
values.bgo.npc_no8hangar.Phrase__44216eac-92c2-: My sister assigned to the abandoned base the fleet discovered in 47 Tartalon has the most up to date information, pilot. You should ask her if you have any questions.
values.bgo.npc_no8hangar.Phrase__c5ab1953-54b0-: Hull allocations are under the authority of my sister at the abandoned base discovered in 47 Tartalon, pilot. There is a supply convoy leaving soon if you wish to join them?
values.bgo.npc_no8hangar.Phrase__d18d036d-135d-: Access equipment archive. [Buy, Sell, Install and Upgrade items]
Assign maintenance systems. [Restore ship and system Durability]
Initiate hull transfer. [Select ship to command]
Request additional hull. [Buy and Upgrade ships]
values.bgo.npc_no8outpost.Name: Number Eight
values.bgo.npc_no8outpost.Phrase__0e2807da-69c8: Access equipment archive. [Buy, Sell, Install and Upgrade items]
Request additional hull. [Buy, Upgrade and Change ships]
Revise hull designators. [Rename ship and customize appearance]
values.bgo.npc_no8outpost.Phrase__35611029-6746: Assign maintenance systems. [Repair ship and modules]
Access hull options. [Select, buy, upgrade and customize ships]
Water stores at maximum. Transfer to Basestar requested [Exchange water for cubits]
values.bgo.npc_no8outpost.Phrase__624a26dc-fc0f: It must be incredible, feeling the vacuum against your 'skin'... What do you need?
values.bgo.npc_no8outpost.Phrase__63e4eecc-d7b3: Sometimes I think I envy you, having these beautiful bodies to choose from...  Anyway, hull allocation completed.
values.bgo.npc_no8outpost.Phrase__63ea0e17-65b0: Affirmative, Contribution: %WaterAmountExchange% Water to Basestar reserves for %CubitAmountExchange% Cubits.
Negative. Water stores are insufficient. Contribution will take place at a later time.
values.bgo.npc_no8outpost.Phrase__6e7d86ec-a2c3: Excellent. Basestar reserves have been increased by %WaterAmountExchange% water. We are authorized to provide %CubitAmountExchange% Cubits for your contribution. Your extraordinary service has been noted. You may continue your operational protocols.
values.bgo.npc_no8outpost.Phrase__b786cc75-ad64: Be aware that you can only revise visual designators on advanced hulls that have been permanently assigned to you, pilot.
values.bgo.npc_no8outpost.Phrase__f3344f17-0f77: You can currently contribute %MaxWaterAmountExchange% water to the Basestar reserves. You have %WaterInHold% water in your hold. The current exchange rate is 1 Cubit per %WaterCubitExchangeRate% Water. Would you like to donate water to the Basestar reserves?
Basestar water reserves are full. Come back later.
Seems like you don't have enough water for donation in your hold. Come back later.
values.bgo.npc_player.Name: %name%
values.bgo.npc_scar.Name: Scar
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Name: Starbuck
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__04a77746-d78a-4: I want to access the DRADIS.
I want to support the fleet with a contribution of water [Exchange Water for Cubits]
You have time for some questions, Starbuck?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__19cfaa63-534b-4: Yeah, some medium escorts and even some big line ships. You keep on climbing the ranks and the Admiral will probably let you command them. Assuming you can collect the resources we need to bring them back into service, that is.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__1a80a613-bd1e-4: As you might expect from the name, escorts are designed for protecting larger, less maneuverable ships, so they tend to be particularly effective against strike craft like the Raider and Heavy Raider. The big line ships, on the other hand, tend to be great at pounding on escorts, but their guns and missiles are so big they don't deal too well with agile strike ships.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__1b1fb2e3-9e16-4: Do you know how to track signals on the DRADIS?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__1ce546b0-9568-4: Yes, I would like to donate %WaterAmountExchange% Water to the fleet reserves for %CubitAmountExchange% Cubits.
No, I will contribute water at a later time.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__3c54dae6-401c-4: Okay, I'll go speak to him. Thanks, Starbuck.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__44934163-100b-4: Pretty much, although a lot depends on how the ship is equipped and, of course, how skilled their pilots and captains are. The best idea is for groups of all three types to work as a team, covering each other's weaknesses.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__46a657fa-070f-4: I hear there are larger ships as well?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__53fc8161-62e4-4: I'm ready to support the fleet. [Play DRADIS Contact]
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__56af42d4-6ea1-4: So if I'm in an escort, I should watch out for line ships, and if I'm in a line ship, I should watch out for strike craft?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__83423810-33e7-4: It ain't good, even by our usual standards. You'll find him in the CIC.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__8a196302-a8f8-4: What are the strengths and weaknesses of the escort and line ships?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__8beb2606-26ea-4: I'm new to the system. Can you explain it's operation?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__99148c50-fd25-4: You can currently donate %MaxWaterAmountExchange% water to the fleet stores. You have %WaterInHold% water in your hold. The current exchange rate is 1 Cubit per %WaterCubitExchangeRate% Water. Would you like to donate water to the fleet reserves?
Sorry, you cannot donate water at the moment, our water tanks are full. Come back later.
I'm sorry, it seems you don't have enough water for donation in your hold. Come back later.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__a1d76fa5-4285-4: I'm happy to be of help.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__bbbe22c5-005b-4: The DRADIS is used to identify and destroy long range signals. You can operate it for free once per day, but the system becomes resource intensive after that. It will require more resources to operate. After signals are destroyed, we recover whatever intel and supplies left behind in the wreckage. Do you want to operate the DRADIS?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__d41151d7-ff06-4: You have donated %WaterAmountExchange% water to the fleet reserves. The Admiral has authorized me to give you %CubitAmountExchange% Cubits. Thanks for your service to the fleet.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__e33fd059-8598-4: The short version is we're in big trouble. But you should go see the Old Man - he wants to brief all our pilots himself, so we're all clear on what needs to be done.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__e4896283-ffab-4: Well, if it isn't one of my former nuggets. Helpya with something, %Name%?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__e7085487-46cf-4: What can you tell me about the new ships the Chief has managed to recover from the abandoned base we found?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck.Phrase__f23bb8fb-351e-4: The smallest is a strike ship we're calling the Rhino. It's not as fast as the Viper and doesn't have all the flashy electronics of the Raptor, but it's a tough beast.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Name: Captain Thrace
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__04a77746-d78a-: No thanks, just wanted to say hi to my former instructor.
You have time for some questions, Starbuck?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__17eb4bc9-870c-: What can you tell me about the new ships the Chief has managed to recover from the abandoned base we found?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__19cfaa63-534b-: Yeah, some medium escorts and even some big line ships. You keep on climbing the ranks and the Admiral will probably let you command them. Assuming you can collect the resources we need to bring them back into service, that is.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__1a80a613-bd1e-: As you might expect from the name, escorts are designed for protecting larger, less maneuverable ships, so they tend to be particularly effective against strike craft like the Raider and Heavy Raider. The big line ships, on the other hand, tend to be great at pounding on escorts, but their guns and missiles are so big they don't deal too well with agile strike ships.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__3c54dae6-401c-: Okay, I'll go speak to him. Thanks, Starbuck.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__3dfa3c1b-63fc-: I think I have you to thank for that - I thought you were tough on us in training, but now I know why.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__44934163-100b-: Pretty much, although a lot depends on how the ship is equipped and, of course, how skilled their pilots and captains are. The best idea is for groups of all three types to work as a team, covering each other's weaknesses.

values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__83423810-33e7-: It ain't good, even by our usual standards. You'll find him in the CIC.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__8a196302-a8f8-: What are the strengths and weaknesses of the escort and line ships?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__b5c2eda7-a4d5-: No problem. Anything else you were wondering about?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__db35d70f-edeb-: All part of the service. Good hunting, %Name%.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__e33fd059-8598-: The short version is we're in big trouble. But you should go see the Old Man - he wants to brief all our pilots himself, so we're all clear on what needs to be done.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__e4896283-ffab-: Well, if it isn't one of my former nuggets. Helpya with something, %Name%?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__e4ad4d2c-ee25-: Glad to see you've managed to keep yourself in one piece.
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__e7085487-46cf-: What can you tell me about the new ships the Chief has managed to recover from the abandoned base we found?
values.bgo.npc_starbuck1.Phrase__f23bb8fb-351e-: The smallest is a strike ship we're calling the Rhino. It's not as fast as the Viper and doesn't have all the flashy electronics of the Raptor, but it's a tough beast.
values.bgo.npc_static.Name: Unknown
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__0e7a0b2b-2850-4b1: Of course, sir. What's on your mind?
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__0f2e8dc1-177d-4c1: Some systems also contain planetoids - massive asteroids that can contain significant mineral deposits. They're too big to break up effectively, so if you find one with useful deposits you'll need to call in one of our mining ships to extract the resources for you.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__1776998e-3d2b-41d: Okay, I'll do that. Thanks, Chief.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__1adf3764-e459-491: Sorry about that, sir, but even with what we've found here we're critically low on supplies. In order to ensure that what we have is being put to the best use, a resource exchange system has been introduced.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__1d12f369-6db4-424: Understood, Chief. Still, they'll come in very handy until we can get out of here.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__257f55b5-09f7-449: Let's talk about ships. [Select, Repair, Buy, Upgrade and Customize ships]
Do you have time to answer some questions?
That's all for now. I'll let you get back to work, Chief.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__2b462e5d-662b-479: I've got a couple of talented artists in my team, sir. Bear in mind, though, that regulations prevent us from altering the appearance of standard ships. I can only let them work on advanced ships that have been permanently assigned to a particular pilot or captain.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__367d7e89-6b19-46d: Understood, Chief. Let me see what your guys can come up with.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__3dd47cee-44ec-4a2: Why do I have to exchange resources for the gear and ships I requisition?
What resources does the fleet need?
Can you tell me about our current situation?
How can our Vipers jump? I didn't think the Viper had an FTL drive.
Nothing at the moment. Thanks, Chief.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__3e60a309-ffde-464: Can you assign me a maintenance crew? [Restore Ship and System Durability]
I want to change my ships equipment. [Buy, Sell, Install and Upgrade items]
I'd like to requisition a new ship. [Buy, Upgrade and Change ships]
I think my ship could do with something special. [Rename ship and customize appearance]
Nothing at the moment. Thanks, Chief.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__5dc0cb46-d07c-41e: We'll have her ready for you when you leave, sir.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__6ee42504-540f-408: So the more resources I bring back for the fleet, the more gear you can release to me?
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__7dda78f1-a923-4c2: Hello, sir. How can I help?
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__81d6cd46-d19c-479: We've got serious problems, sir, but you should speak to the Admiral on the Galactica. I hear he wants to brief all his pilots in person.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__84cfb6b4-33af-470: Exactly, sir. In addition, we've started using Cubits as tokens to control access to some of the more advanced equipment and ships that are in short supply.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__96e0ff56-ee0d-4e9: The standard design doesn't, sir, but with the Galactica's drive crippled and the Pegasus assigned to guard this base, we needed more FTL-capable ships to explore this sector. We learned a lot from the Raider that Starbuck captured a while back and even more from building the Blackbird, so we've been able to rig several Vipers with small FTL drives and control systems.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__9b5c8ee8-01d1-452: We're short of almost everything, sir, but the three most important are tylium, titanium and water. The crazy jump that brought us here burned through nearly all the fuel in the fleet, so we need tylium to rebuild our stocks. Titanium is needed for structural repairs to many ships, and we've been short of water ever since the Galactica's tanks were sabotaged shortly after we set out.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__aa24ecc1-c663-442: Where can I get them from?
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__b85eaa4e-ee63-49a: Anything else I can help with?
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__c817ffd5-102e-4e7: Those don't sound like reliable sources, Chief.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__cbf346b9-001d-44f: How do I find asteroids and planetoids with useful resources?
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__cd1e2004-57af-402: The best idea is to requisition a mineral analysis system, sir. With one of those you can scan asteroids and planetoids to see if they contain anything useful.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__cee90b40-d947-432: They're not, sir, but it's always worth checking. We need everything we can lay our hands on. Fortunately, many of the asteroid belts and fields in this sector are rich in minerals. It might be why the previous occupants came here in the first place. You can mine them by breaking up the asteroids and collecting any resources they contain.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__d031f175-3b4b-4cb: Hope you're happy with the results, sir. Just let me know if you'd like to make any changes.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__d5cef1d6-f570-470: My favorite subject, sir. What do you need?
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__d6e33348-97d0-4fd: Thank you, sir, but I'm afraid the results haven't been very efficient.  We're very lucky that this sector is relatively abundant in tylium, so our pilots can mine asteroids to keep themselves topped up on fuel. I doubt we'll be able to make use of the drives once we finally get out of here, as we won't know when we'll find more tylium deposits and we'll need to reserve what we have for the main fleet.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__dd04bfa0-278b-4da: Take good care of her, sir. If you need my guys to fix anything else, just let me know.
values.bgo.npc_static.Phrase__ede5e2d6-e7bf-4e3: There are three main ways you can collect resources for the fleet. The first is from the wreckage of enemy ships you defeat or the debris fields left over from the battles that seem to have occurred here in the past.

values.bgo.ship_avenger.Description_1: More advanced than the other two abandoned escort classes reclaimed by the Colonial Fleet, the Glaive is a compact, powerful design incorporating extensive electronic suites and computer hardware. Only a small number have been discovered, drifting derelict in space near the wreckage of a small asteroid base.%br% %br%As a Command ship, the Glaive can be equipped with more computer systems than other escorts, increasing its electronic warfare and support capabilities.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: -50 to power cost for FTL Transponders.
values.bgo.ship_avenger.Description_2: A standard Glaive that has been stripped, rebuilt and highly tuned under the supervision of Chief Tyrol. Lightweight modern composites strengthen the hull, while customized electronics management and fire control components push performance to the limit.%br% %br%The Advanced Glaive's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional hull systems.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: -100 to power cost for FTL Transponders.
values.bgo.ship_banshee.Description_1: Angular and bulky, the recovered Wraith hulls appear to have been influenced by human design principles in what may have been some form of experimental project. High density hull plating and structural reinforcements make it extremely effective in close escort and guard duties.%br% %br%As an Assault ship, the Wraith can be equipped with more hull systems than other escorts, further increasing its toughness and defensive capabilities.
values.bgo.ship_banshee.Description_2: A recovered Wraith that has undergone more extensive reconfiguration and reconstruction to incorporate the latest updates to Cylon ship manufacture and engineering techniques, resulting in a more powerful and effective combination of old and new.%br% %br%The Advanced Wraith's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and hull systems.
values.bgo.ship_basestar_guardian.Name: Guardian Basestar
values.bgo.ship_berserker.Description_1: The smallest of the three classes of abandoned escorts that the ground crews of the Galactica and Pegasus have so far managed to salvage, repair and bring back into service, over half of the Scythe's hull is taken up by its tylium reactors and drive assembly. The resulting high thrust-to-mass ratio allows rapid response to incoming threats and lightning strikes against the enemy.%br% %br%As an Interceptor, the Scythe can be equipped with more engine systems than other escorts, increasing its already impressive performance.
values.bgo.ship_berserker.Description_2: A reclaimed Scythe that has undergone additional repairs and a more comprehensive refit, replacing older components and fully integrating modern colonial fire control and engine management systems. Such work requires extensive resources, but results in a tougher, more powerful ship.%br% %br%The Advanced Scythe's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and engine systems.
values.bgo.ship_brimir.Description_1: Discovery of the derelict shipyards near Delta Canopis has allowed the construction of the Brimr class carrier. The carrier is a support and logistics vessel that allows strike ships to coordinate attacks and quickly repair and refit away from an outpost.
values.bgo.ship_brimir.Description_2: Discovery of the derelict shipyards near Delta Canopis has allowed the construction of the Brimr class carrier. The carrier is a support and logistics vessel that allows strike ships to coordinate attacks and quickly repair and refit away from an outpost.
values.bgo.ship_colonial_capital_dm_freighter.D: A ship from the Colonial fleet
values.bgo.ship_colonial_strike_stealth.Descrip: The Raven MK VI-R, designed towards the end of the 1st Cylon War as a recon fighter, is a modification of the standard Viper MK VI. The ship has a low signature profile due to a composite hull material and the ability to retract its weapons. The ship saw little action during the war, and its weapon complement never really allowed performance in a standard combat role. After the 1st Cylon War, the Raven was quickly relegated to the role of reconnaissance, because the Colonial military saw little need for a stealth fighter in the Post-Cylon War combat doctrine.

After the 1st Cylon War, scavengers and pirates were a constant problem for the Colonial Armed Forces. Engaging these criminals was difficult because they kept their jump drives primed if any police or military forces arrived. When Colonial forces arrived on the scene the criminals would jump away. To counter these tactics, the Admirals deployed the Raven as a deep-strike stealth fighter that could identify and engage the pirates. Hoping to improve the firepower of the Raven, the pilots aboard the Battlestar Agamemnon had their deck crew field modify the Raven with an additional launcher hard point. The effectiveness of this modification was picked up by Coronis Dynamics, and the Raven Mk VI-R/A field modification kit created to upgrade the Raven for anti-piracy operations.
values.bgo.ship_commandtoken_basestar.Descripti: A potent symbol of Cylon might, Basestars represent the pinnacle of current Cylon technology. Armed with massively powerful missile batteries and multiple point defence batteries, a Basestar can easily engage and destroy fleets of small ships.
values.bgo.ship_commandtoken_basestar.Name: Basestar
values.bgo.ship_commandtoken_pegasus.Descriptio: The backbone of the Colonial fleet, Battlestars combine the roles of battleship and carrier. Pegasus is an example of the modern Mercury Class, the largest and most powerful Battlestars ever constructed.
values.bgo.ship_commandtoken_pegasus.Name: Pegasus
values.bgo.ship_cruiser.Description_1: The distinctive twin-hull design of the Vanir incorporates multiple sensor and emitter grids in a paired configuration that, when restored to working order by the ground crews of the Galactica and Pegasus, have proved to be extremely powerful and effective.%br% %br%As a Heavy Command vessel, the Vanir can be equipped with more computer systems than other line ships, increasing its electronic warfare and support capabilities.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: -150 to power cost for FTL Transponders.
values.bgo.ship_cruiser.Description_2: A reclaimed Vanir that has undergone additional repairs and a more comprehensive refit, replacing older components and fully integrating modern colonial fire control and electronic management systems. Such work requires extensive resources, but results in a tougher, more powerful ship.%br% %br%The Advanced Vanir's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and computer systems.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: -200 to power cost for FTL Transponders.

values.bgo.ship_cylon_strike_stealth.Descriptio: Following the signing of the Armistice, the Cylons determined the need for a reconnaissance craft that could go undetected on Colonial DRADIS. They began experimenting with various designs, but settled on modifying the standard raider with a hull constructed with DRADIS absorbing materials and concealed the weapons below hatches. When the attack on the Colonies began, the Malefactor saw heavy use acting as a deep strike ship to disrupt Colonial operations in the initial stages of the attack.

The Type-2 Malefactor is a second generation stealth fighter. While the initial combat performance of the Malefactor showed promise, the harassment of the Cylon fleet by Admiral Cain and the Pegasus prompted the Cylons to expand on the combat capabilities of the Malefactor. The Type-2 Malefactor builds on the Type-1's capabilities adding a missile launcher hard point and improved engines for speed and maneuverability.
values.bgo.ship_dominator.Description_1: Sturdy and solidly built, the Maul is the largest of the three classes of abandoned escorts that the Colonial Fleet has managed to recover and retrofit for service. Its reinforced hull and heavy armor plating make it ideally suited to close escort and guard duties.%br% %br%As an Assault ship, the Maul can be equipped with more hull systems than other escorts, further increasing its toughness and defensive capabilities.
values.bgo.ship_dominator.Description_2: A reclaimed Maul that has undergone additional repairs and a more comprehensive refit, replacing older components and fully integrating modern colonial fire control and defensive systems. Such work requires extensive resources, but results in a tougher, more powerful ship.%br% %br%The Advanced Maul's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and hull systems.
values.bgo.ship_dreadnought.Description_1: The largest abandoned ship class that the Colonial Fleet has so far managed to recover and return to service, the Jotunn's massive construction and capability to advance under the most withering fire has already earned it a reputation as a 'baby battlestar'.%br% %br%As a Heavy Assault vessel, the Jotunn can be equipped with more hull systems than other line ships, further increasing its toughness and defensive capabilities.
values.bgo.ship_dreadnought.Description_2: A reclaimed Jotunn that has undergone additional repairs and a more comprehensive refit, replacing older components and fully integrating modern colonial fire control and defensive systems. Such work requires extensive resources, but results in an even tougher, more powerful ship.%br% %br%The Advanced Jotunn's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and hull systems.
