values.bgo.ship_ghost_dreadnought.Description_1: The largest abandoned ship class that the Colonial Fleet has so far managed to recover and return to service, the Jotunn's massive construction and capability to advance under the most withering fire has already earned it a reputation as a 'baby battlestar'.%br% %br%As a Heavy Assault vessel, the Jotunn can be equipped with more hull systems than other line ships, further increasing its toughness and defensive capabilities.
values.bgo.ship_ghost_dreadnought.Description_2: A reclaimed Jotunn that has undergone additional repairs and a more comprehensive refit, replacing older components and fully integrating modern colonial fire control and defensive systems. Such work requires extensive resources, but results in an even tougher, more powerful ship.%br% %br%The Advanced Jotunn's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and hull systems.
values.bgo.ship_ghost_phantom.Description_1: Obviously intended for use as a battlefield command and control platform, the recovered Hel class hulls are honeycombed with data processing, sensor and emitter plexuses that rival the capabilities of a Basestar hybrid.%br% %br%As a Heavy Command vessel, the Hel can be equipped with more computer systems than other line ships, increasing its electronic warfare and support capabilities.
values.bgo.ship_ghost_phantom.Description_2: A recovered Hel that has undergone more extensive recoding and interface configuration to make full use of their advanced processing and emitter plexuses, along with additional reconstruction to incorporate the latest updates to Cylon ship manufacture and engineering techniques.%br% %br%The Advanced Hel's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and computer systems.
values.bgo.ship_ghost_spectre.Description_1: Only a small number of Spectre escort hulls have been recovered by the Cylon Fleet, and bringing them back into active service requires complex recoding and interface configuration to make full use of their advanced processing and emitter nexuses. The result, however, is a powerful electronic warfare and support platform.%br% %br%As a Command ship, the Spectre can be equipped with more computer systems than other escorts, increasing its electronic warfare and support capabilities.
values.bgo.ship_ghost_spectre.Description_2: A Cylon Spectre that has undergone extensive reconfiguration and reconstruction to incorporate advances in Cylon ship manufacture and engineering techniques. Hull strength is improved.
values.bgo.ship_gungnir.Description_1: Only a handful of Gungnir class line ships have been recovered by Colonial forces, and all have suffered heavy damage from what appears to have been the last major battle fought in the sector before it was abandoned. Although they require massive investment to bring back into service, these formidable warships are capable of being configured for a variety of tactical applications and have few weaknesses.%br%%br%As a Multi-role heavy attack vessel, the Gungnir can be equipped with a more balanced selection of Hull, Engine and Computer systems than other line ships.
values.bgo.ship_gungnir.Description_2: A reclaimed Gungnir that has undergone additional repairs and a more comprehensive refit. Fully integrating modern colonial fire control and reactor management systems allows the Advanced Gungnir to support more forward weapon batteries than other line ships, and hull integrity is improved.%br%%br%Due to the expense of customizing and maintaining an Advanced Gungir, it is only made available to the most dedicated and experienced Captains.
values.bgo.ship_gunstar.Description_1: Among the most advanced line ship designs so far recovered by the Colonial Fleet, the Aesir features high output reactors and drive assemblies that, when repaired and re-aligned, produce incredible thrust for a ship of its size. Returning them to active service requires a major investment of time and resources, but the Aesir's combination of speed and firepower is highly effective.%br% %br%As a Heavy Interceptor, the Aesir can be equipped with more engine systems than other line ships, increasing its already impressive performance.
values.bgo.ship_gunstar.Description_2: A standard Aesir that has been stripped, rebuilt and highly tuned under the supervision of Chief Tyrol. Hull and computer systems are improved.
values.bgo.ship_halberd.Description_1: Recently discovered in a sealed hangar in the Delta Canopis base, the Halberd appears to have been a further evolution of the design principles of the Glaive. Instead of focusing on electronic support and warfare, however, this fast and powerful ship is capable of being configured for a variety of tactical applications.%br%%br%As a Multi-role attack ship, the Halberd can be equipped with a more balanced selection of Hull, Engine and Computer systems than other escorts.
values.bgo.ship_halberd.Description_2: A reclaimed Halberd that has undergone additional repairs and a more comprehensive refit. Fully integrating modern colonial fire control and reactor management systems allows the Advanced Halberd to support more forward weapon batteries than other escorts, and hull integrity is improved.%br%%br%Due to the expense of customizing and maintaining an Advanced Halberd, it is only made available to the most dedicated and experienced combat pilots.
values.bgo.ship_heavy_raider_recon.Description: Continuing interface with recovered technology from the Veil Sector has led to the Fleet Reconnaissance variant of the Heavy Raider. Denser positioning of sensory input clusters and a higher bandwidth access of navigational data gives the Heavy Raider FR improved DRADIS, FTL Jump, and engine capability with acceptable loss in hull strength and offensive weapon deployment.%br%%br%The Heavy Raider FRu2019s propulsion profile broadens the thrust variation parameters and a streamlined navigational system connection increases the efficiency of FTL Transponder systems.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: Jump transponder power costs are reduced by 75 when used by this vehicle.
values.bgo.ship_heavy_raider_recon.Name: Heavy Raider FR
values.bgo.ship_heavy_raider.Description_1: A support and communications craft capable of processing vast quantities of tactical data and disrupting enemy systems with combinations of viral attack and jamming, the Heavy Raider's oversized hull can also transport several Centurions or humanoid Cylons.%br% %br%As a Command ship, the Heavy Raider can be equipped with more computer systems than other strike craft, increasing its electronic warfare and support capabilities.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: Jump transponder power costs are reduced by 25 when used by this vehicle.
values.bgo.ship_heavy_raider.Description_2: Incorporating similar refinements and upgrades to the Advanced Raider, the Advanced Heavy Raider hull also features additional data processing and emitter clusters to further enhance the abilities of pilot minds with extensive electronic warfare experience.%br% %br%The Advanced Heavy Raider's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and computer systems.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: Jump transponder power costs are reduced by 50 when used by this vehicle.
values.bgo.ship_liche.Description_1: Recently discovered in a code-locked section of the 47 Tartalon base, the Liche appears to have been a further evolution of the design principles of the Spectre. Instead of focusing on electronic support and warfare, however, this fast and powerful ship is capable of being configured for a variety of tactical applications.%br%%br%As a Multi-role attack ship, the Liche can be equipped with a more balanced selection of Hull, Engine and Computer systems than other escorts.
values.bgo.ship_liche.Description_2: A recovered Liche that has undergone more extensive reconfiguration and reconstruction. Fully incorporating the latest updates to Cylon ship manufacture and engineering techniques allows the Advanced Liche to support more forward weapon batteries than other escorts, and hull integrity is improved.%br%%br%Due to the expense of customizing and maintaining an Advanced Liche, it is only made available to the most dedicated and experienced combat pilots.
values.bgo.ship_nidhogg.Description_1: The few Nidhogg class hulls so far recovered have all suffered extensive damage in what appears to have been the last major engagement in this sector before it was abandoned.  Although they require massive investment to bring back into service, these formidable warships are capable of being configured for a variety of tactical applications and have few weaknesses.%br%%br%As a Multi-role heavy attack vessel, the Nidhogg can be equipped with a more balanced selection of Hull, Engine and Computer systems than other line ships.
values.bgo.ship_nidhogg.Description_2: A recovered Nidhogg that has undergone more extensive reconfiguration and reconstruction. Fully incorporating the latest updates to Cylon ship manufacture and engineering techniques allows the Advanced Nidhogg to support more forward weapon batteries than other line ships, and hull integrity is improved.%br%%br%Due to the expense of customizing and maintaining an Advanced Nidhogg, it is only made available to the most dedicated and experienced Tribunes.
values.bgo.ship_nova.Description_1: Incredibly swift for a ship of its size, the recovered Fenrir hulls have proved to be among the most complex and advanced designs left behind by the mysterious Cylons who abandoned this sector at some point in the past. Returning them to active service requires a major investment of time and resources, but the Fenrir's combination of speed and firepower is highly effective.%br% %br%As a Heavy Interceptor, the Fenrir can be equipped with more engine systems than other line ships, increasing its already impressive performance.
values.bgo.ship_nova.Description_2: A Cylon Fenrir that has undergone extensive reconfiguration and reconstruction to incorporate advances in Cylon ship manufacture and engineering techniques. Hull strength and computers are improved.
values.bgo.ship_phantom.Description_1: Obviously intended for use as a battlefield command and control platform, the recovered Hel class hulls are honeycombed with data processing, sensor and emitter plexuses that rival the capabilities of a Basestar hybrid.%br% %br%As a Heavy Command vessel, the Hel can be equipped with more computer systems than other line ships, increasing its electronic warfare and support capabilities.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: -150 to power cost for FTL Transponders.
values.bgo.ship_phantom.Description_2: A recovered Hel that has undergone more extensive recoding and interface configuration to make full use of their advanced processing and emitter plexuses, along with additional reconstruction to incorporate the latest updates to Cylon ship manufacture and engineering techniques.%br% %br%The Advanced Hel's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and computer systems.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: -200 to power cost for FTL Transponders.
values.bgo.ship_raider_1b.Description_1: With the Cylon fleet cut off from its usual supply lines, the Cylon War Raiders in storage aboard the Basestars have been reactivated. Although the predecessor to the modern Raider is less efficient and more expensive to maintain, it also offers more tactical flexibility and its performance remains impressive.%br%%br%As a Multi-role fighter, the Cylon War Raider can be equipped with a more balanced selection of Hull, Engine and Computer systems than other strike craft.
values.bgo.ship_raider_1b.Description_2: A Cylon War Raider that has undergone extensive reconfiguration and reconstruction to incorporate advances in Cylon ship manufacture and engineering techniques. Hull strength and reactor performance are improved, allowing the Advanced War Raider to support more weapons than other strike craft.%br%%br%Due to the expense of customizing and maintaining an Advanced War Raider, it is only made available to the most dedicated and experienced combat pilots.
values.bgo.ship_raider.Description_1: Sleek and deadly, the Raider is the primary Interceptor of the Cylon fleet, designed to use its speed and agility to perform rapid strikes and chase down slower, less maneuverable targets. Like all Cylon vessels, it is a biomechanical construct commanded by a 'pilot mind' that literally becomes the ship.%br% %br%As an Interceptor, the Raider can be equipped with more engine systems than other strike craft, increasing its already impressive performance.
values.bgo.ship_raider.Description_2: A specially engineered and precision-tuned Raider hull that incorporates the latest upgrades and refinements based on comprehensive analysis of combat performance since the attack on the Colonies. The Advanced Raider is normally reserved for use by the most experienced and effective pilot minds.%br% %br%The Advanced Raider's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and engine systems.
values.bgo.ship_raptor_recon.Description: A specialized variant of the Advanced Raptor, the Fleet Reconnaissance Raptor serves as the primary situational awareness and squadron mobility ship in the Colonial Fleet. Chief Tyrol has traded some of the weapon and hull capacity of this Raptor for a marked increase in DRADIS, engine, and FTL jump performance.%br%%br%The Raptor FR's engine mounting grants a much broader range of modification, and its navigational systems have been specially adapted to increase the efficiency of FTL Transponder systems.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: Jump transponder power costs are reduced by 75 when used by this vehicle.
values.bgo.ship_raptor_recon.Name: Raptor FR
values.bgo.ship_raptor.Description_1: The eyes and ears of the Colonial Fleet, the Raptor is designed for rapid reconnaissance and combat support and coordination via its impressive sensor and communications suite.  It can also be equipped with a variety of light autocannon and missile pods for both defensive and offensive operations.%br% %br%As a Command ship, the Raptor can be equipped with more computer systems than other strike craft, increasing its electronic warfare and support capabilities.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: Jump transponder power costs are reduced by 25 when used by this vehicle.
values.bgo.ship_raptor.Description_2: A standard Raptor that has been stripped, rebuilt and highly tuned under the supervision of Chief Tyrol. Lightweight modern composites strengthen the hull, while customized electronics management and fire control components push performance to the limit.%br% %br%The Advanced Raptor's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and computer systems.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: Jump transponder power costs are reduced by 50 when used by this vehicle.
values.bgo.ship_rhino.Description_1: An extremely rugged and heavily armored strike craft, only a small number of Rhinos have so far been discovered by the Colonial Fleet, and bringing them back into service requires a significant investment of time and resources. However, their ability to withstand incredible punishment has already made them highly valued.%br% %br%As an Assault ship, the Rhino can be equipped with more hull systems than other strike craft, further increasing its toughness and defensive capabilities.
values.bgo.ship_rhino.Description_2: A reclaimed Rhino that has undergone additional repairs and a more comprehensive refit, replacing older components and fully integrating modern colonial fire control systems. A rear firing tail gun has been added to the armament.
values.bgo.ship_scout.Description_1: A heavy strike craft hull recovered from the base of the mysterious Cylons who abandoned this sector at some point in the past. Although some delicate reconfiguration is required for full compatibility, the Marauder's high density hull materials provide far greater protection than standard Cylon strike craft.%br% %br%As an Assault ship, the Marauder can be equipped with more hull systems than other strike craft, further increasing its toughness and defensive capabilities.
values.bgo.ship_scout.Description_2: A Cylon Marauder that has undergone extensive reconfiguration and reconstruction to incorporate advances in Cylon ship manufacture and engineering techniques. A rear firing tail gun has been added to the armament.
values.bgo.ship_sentinel.Description_1: The largest ship class so far recovered by the Cylon Fleet, the Jormung's massive wedge-shaped hull is thickly armored and heavily braced, offering superior protection from enemy fire and allowing the ship to act as a mobile fortress on both offensive and defensive operations.%br% %br%As a Heavy Assault vessel, the Jormung can be equipped with more hull systems than other line ships, further increasing its toughness and defensive capabilities.
values.bgo.ship_sentinel.Description_2: A recovered Jormung that has undergone more extensive reconfiguration and reconstruction to incorporate the latest updates to Cylon ship manufacture and engineering techniques, resulting in an even more powerful assault platform.%br% %br%The Advanced Jormung's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and hull systems.
values.bgo.ship_spectre.Description_1: Only a small number of Spectre escort hulls have been recovered by the Cylon Fleet, and bringing them back into active service requires complex recoding and interface configuration to make full use of their advanced processing and emitter nexuses. The result, however, is a powerful electronic warfare and support platform.%br% %br%As a Command ship, the Spectre can be equipped with more computer systems than other escorts, increasing its electronic warfare and support capabilities.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: -50 to power cost for FTL Transponders.
values.bgo.ship_spectre.Description_2: A Cylon Spectre that has undergone extensive reconfiguration and reconstruction to incorporate advances in Cylon ship manufacture and engineering techniques. Hull strength is improved.%BR%%BR%Role Bonus - Command: -100 to power cost for FTL Transponders.
values.bgo.ship_story_berserker.Description_1: The smallest of the three classes of abandoned escorts that the ground crews of the Galactica and Pegasus have so far managed to salvage, repair and bring back into service, over half of the Scythe's hull is taken up by its tylium reactors and drive assembly. The resulting high thrust-to-mass ratio allows rapid response to incoming threats and lightning strikes against the enemy.%br% %br%As an Interceptor, the Scythe can be equipped with more engine systems than other escorts, increasing its already impressive performance.
values.bgo.ship_story_berserker.Description_2: A reclaimed Scythe that has undergone additional repairs and a more comprehensive refit, replacing older components and fully integrating modern colonial fire control and engine management systems. Such work requires extensive resources, but results in a tougher, more powerful ship.%br% %br%The Advanced Scythe's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and engine systems.
values.bgo.ship_story_wrath.Description_1: The first of three abandoned escort designs that the Cylon fleet has so far managed to recover and return to active status, the Banshee is a fast attack ship built for speed and maneuverability, capable of supporting friendly strike craft or rapid response to enemy attacks.%br% %br%As an Interceptor, the Banshee can be equipped with more engine systems than other escorts, increasing its already impressive performance.
values.bgo.ship_story_wrath.Description_2: A recovered Banshee that has undergone more extensive reconfiguration and reconstruction to incorporate the latest updates to Cylon ship manufacture and engineering techniques, resulting in a more powerful and effective combination of old and new.%br% %br%The Advanced Banshee's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and engine systems.
values.bgo.ship_surtur.Description_1: Discovery of the derelict shipyards near 47 Tartalon has allowed the construction of the Surtur class carrier. The carrier is a support and logistics vessel that allows strike ships to coordinate attacks and quickly repair and refit away from an outpost.
values.bgo.ship_surtur.Description_2: Discovery of the derelict shipyards near 47 Tartalon has allowed the construction of the Surtur class carrier. The carrier is a support and logistics vessel that allows strike ships to coordinate attacks and quickly repair and refit away from an outpost.
values.bgo.ship_valkyrie.Name: Valkyrie
values.bgo.ship_viper_mk3.Description_1: Seeing action during the First Cylon War, few Viper Mk III's survived the initial Cylon attack on the colonies. The design was an upgrade to the Viper Mk II's structural systems, and it was intended to act as a multi-role fighter. It filled that role effectively for its time, but was quickly replaced by the next generation of Viper designs after the First Cylon War. It's design would inspire the development of further multi-role Viper designs, and culminated in the design of the Viper Mk VII.%br% %br%The design rested within the data bases of the Pegasus, but until the discovery of the abandoned base at Delta Canopis there was little call for bringing the few Viper Mk III's into active service. With the ability to manufacture parts and resupply the Pegasus the Viper Mk III has been redeployed to active duty.
values.bgo.ship_viper_mk3.Description_2: Seeing action during the First Cylon War, few Viper Mk III's survived the initial Cylon attack on the colonies. The design was an upgrade to the Viper Mk II's structural systems, and it was intended to act as a multi-role fighter. It filled that role effectively for its time, but was quickly replaced by the next generation of Viper designs after the First Cylon War. It's design would inspire the development of further multi-role Viper designs, and culminated in the design of the Viper Mk VII.%br% %br%The design rested within the data bases of the Pegasus, but until the discovery of the abandoned base at Delta Canopis there was little call for bringing the few Viper Mk III's into active service. With the ability to manufacture parts and resupply the Pegasus the Viper Mk III has been redeployed to active duty.
values.bgo.ship_viper_mk7.Description_1: The modern version of the Viper is a sleek and deadly space superiority fighter that easily matches the performance of previous designs, while offering greater tactical flexibility. However, the Mk VII's reliance on the latest technology makes it more vulnerable to electronic warfare than the older Mk II, and more expensive to maintain and run.%br%%br%As a Multi-role fighter, the Viper Mk VII can be equipped with a more balanced selection of Hull, Engine and Computer systems than other strike craft.
values.bgo.ship_viper_mk7.Description_2: A specially customized and highly tuned Mk VII that incorporates many adjustments and upgrades to the basic design based on the experience gained since the Cylon attack on the Colonies. Hull strength and power distribution are improved, allowing the Advanced Mk VII to support more weapons than other strike craft.%br%%br%Due to the expense of customizing and maintaining an Advanced Viper Mk VII, it is only made available to the most dedicated and experienced combat pilots.
values.bgo.ship_viper.Description_1: Although designed over 40 years ago, the Viper Mk II remains an outstanding interceptor and space superiority fighter that's proved more than capable of matching the Cylon Raider in speed, agility and firepower. Recently, several of the fleet's Vipers have been rigged with small FTL drives to allow long-range operations.%br% %br%As an Interceptor, the Viper Mk II can be equipped with more engine systems than other strike craft, increasing its already impressive performance.
values.bgo.ship_viper.Description_2: A standard Viper Mk II that has been stripped, rebuilt and highly tuned under the supervision of Chief Tyrol. Lightweight modern composites strengthen the hull, while customized engine management and fire control components push performance to the limit.%br% %br%The Advanced Viper's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and engine systems.
values.bgo.ship_war_raider_mk2.Description_1: The 'Cylon War' Raider Mk II has not been seen since the First Cylon War, but recent events have seen its return into action. The Raider Mk II is the progenitor of modern Cylon Raider, deviating from the original War Raider design. More agile than the original War Raider, and slightly more durable than a Cylon Raider, the Raider Mk II would prove itself in battle against the humans time and time again. These in-combat tests proved the design concept as an interceptor, rather than a multi-role fighter, was the most effective evolutionary direction for the Raiders.
values.bgo.ship_war_raider_mk2.Description_2: The 'Cylon War' Raider Mk II has not been seen since the First Cylon War, but recent events have seen its return into action. The Raider Mk II is the progenitor of modern Cylon Raider, deviating from the original War Raider design. More agile than the original War Raider, and slightly more durable than a Cylon Raider, the Raider Mk II would prove itself in battle against the humans time and time again. These in-combat tests proved the design concept as an interceptor, rather than a multi-role fighter, was the most effective evolutionary direction for the Raiders.

Specialized training in the manipulation of DRADIS and other detection systems. This allows the user to filter background noise ranging from cosmic background noise to enemy ECM effects, and improve the effectiveness of the vessel's detection systems.%BR%%BR% Effect: Increases DRADIS power by 1% per level.%B%%%BR%Allows: Training in Signature Management and Situational Awareness.
