values.bgo.story_cylon_1.Name: Colonial Tutorial Phase 1
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_arm_cannons: Arm your cannons. Click the flashing icons or Press [G] to arm your cannons
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_boost_trigger: Pick up the pace, Nugget! Activate your boosters!
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_controls_tutor: Use the [A] key to yaw the nose of your ship to the left.
Looks good. Now pull your Viper's yaw left.
Click the Booster icon or hold [SPACEBAR] to activate your boosters.
Use the [D] key to yaw the nose of your ship to the right.%br%
Excellent, Nugget. Finally, roll your Viper right.
Use the [E] key to roll the ship to the right.
Just a bit more. Rotate your Viper left.
Use the [Q] key to roll the ship to the left.
Good. Now pitch your nose up.
Use the [S] key to pitch the nose of your ship up.
Good, Nugget! Let's test your controls before we head out.%br%%br%Pitch your Viper down.
Use the [W] key to pitch the nose of your ship down.%br%%br%
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_cut_throttle: Stop your Viper. Drag the slider down or scroll down with the mouse wheel.
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_cut_throttle.1: Now breath, Nugget. Cut your throttle. Let's make sure your controls are working properly.
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_emergency_mess: Attention all vipers. This is Galactica Actual. The fleet is making the jump to FTL. All Vipers break off and come home. Repeat come on home.
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_fight_destroy_: Don't get too excited Nugget. I am picking up something on my D.R.A.D.I.S. Form up, we're checking it out.
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_fight_platform: I'm detecting an energy spike in that thing. Frak, it just launched some kind of drones. Look sharp, Nugget!
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_fight_raiders: Destroy the Cylon Raider%br%%br%- Use W, S, A, D, Q, and E to maneuver your Viper.%br%- All Weapons have a fire arc. Get a target within it to fire your weapons. They will fire automatically%br%- Press [2] fire your missiles.
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_follow_tutoria: Follow Starbuck%br%- Click the flashing icon to follow an ally.
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_match_speed_tu: Follow Starbuck%br%- Click the flashing icon to match the target's speed.
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_move_to_fight: You're still with me, Nugget? Good, let's finish this patrol.
Follow Starbuck to the next Nav Point
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_shut_off_autoc: Adjust Your Throttle. Drag the flashing slider up or scroll up with the mouse wheel.
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_starbuck_messa: Ok Nugget, you heard the Admiral. Let's get back to the Galactica.
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_starbuck_story: There it is, Nugget. Not sure what that is, but it's definately old.
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_target_friendl: Alright Nugget! Everything looks fine. Let's finish this patrol. Stay on my six.
Follow Starbuck%br%- Click the Flashing icon to target an ally.
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_targeting_tuto: Press the flashing icon or press
values.bgo.story_cylon_1.trigger_tutorial_spawn: Hey Nugget! Get this frakkin' toaster off of me!
values.bgo.story_cylon_10.Name: Story Mission 10
values.bgo.story_cylon_10.trigger_killall: [Player is informed that he did great]
values.bgo.story_cylon_10.trigger_location: Take out the enemy Outpost and all the guards
values.bgo.story_cylon_10.trigger_proceed: [Player is ordered to lead the army and defeat the Outpost]
values.bgo.story_cylon_10.trigger_proceedb: Lead the army to the enemy Outpost
values.bgo.story_cylon_10.trigger_start: [Player is briefed about the enemy Outpost]
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_editor.Name: Cylon Tutorial #1
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old_editor.Name: Cylon Tutorial #1
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old.Description: The Humans initiated a surprise attack on our fleet. They have destroyed the Resurrection Ship, and we will destroy them before they have the chance to flee.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old.Name: Resurrection Ship
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old.trigger_arm_cann: Press [G] to Arm your cannons. They will fire automatically when the target is under the crosshair.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old.trigger_boost_tr: Remember to activate your boosters or you will be left behind.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old.trigger_emergenc: The humans have destroyed the Resurrection Ship and are making the jump to FTL. All raiders return to the Basestar to pursue the fleet.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old.trigger_end_tuto: Docking procedures intiated. Preparing to jump to FTL.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old.trigger_fight_de: Excellent. You are functioning within operational parameters.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old.trigger_move_to_: I have detected an unknown signal. Move to the coordinates I have provided.
Go to the Waypoint pictured below, or turn your ship towards the arrow at the edge of your screen.
Investigate the signal at the Waypoint
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old.trigger_near_peg: Warning! You are within range of the enemy flak field. Fall back or you will be destroyed.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old.trigger_scar_mes: Recall procedures initiated. Return to the Basestar.
Recall procedures initiated. Return to the Basestar. Activate Booster for fast travel.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old.trigger_scar_sto: There's the signal I was picking up. Not sure what that is, but it's definitely old.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old.trigger_tutorial: Optio! Are you functional? Get Moving!
Hold Right Mouse to control your flight direction. Press [W], [S], [A], or [D] to slide your ship.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100_old.trigger_use_thro: Scroll your <highlight>[Mouse Wheel]</highlight> up to increase your speed.
Excellent. Your systems are fully functional. Accelerate!
Scroll up with the [Mouse Wheel] to control the throttle
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.Name: Cylon Tutorial #1
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_avoidance_ex: Well fought, Sprocket.%br%%br%Remember: though flying at low speeds makes it easier to aim at your targets, it also makes it much more likely that their return fire will hit you back. When you’re in combat, always fly as fast as you can without sacrificing accuracy.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_basestar_jum: Alert, all channels! The humans have been found.%br%All craft, all personnel, destroy the Galactica immediately! Avenge those lost on our Resurrection Ship!
Get closer to the Basestar and join the fight.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_commander_or: Patrol, this is Basestar. It would appear this sector is occupied, and not by the humans we were expecting. Continue your recon mission. We'll send a full team to analyze that construct later.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_commander_th: Well flown, Sprocket. Scar could have been in some real trouble back there without you.
Head to the Basestar's FTL coordinates.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_enemy_factio: We've got incoming! Looks like a Colonial wing.%br%%br%Little Sprocket, this one's not for you. Get moving to our jump coordinates; we should be arriving any minute now. Scar will attack the humans and cover your retreat.
Head to the Basestar's FTL position.%br%Hint: Hold the SPACE bar to activate your booster.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_follow_scarb: All right, looks like you won't embarrass yourself, or us. Now follow Scar through those waypoints.
Follow Scar through the orange waypoints.%br%%br%Accelerate by dragging the flashing slider up, or by scrolling your mouse wheel up.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_gun_activati: Patrol, this is Basestar. We are registering a ship directly ahead of you... but it's neither Cylon nor Human.%br%%br%You'd best get your guns online, just in case.
Activate your guns by clicking the highlighted gun slots.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_guns_activat: Keep close to Scar, my Sprocket, and go take a look at that signal. And remember: the faster you fly, the harder it is for anyone to target you accurately.
Increase your speed and follow Scar to the target.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_investigate_: Your DRADIS is no longer displaying hostiles. Looks like that's all of them. Scar will deploy an extra sensor array - hmm. What in God’s name...? An unrecognized signal just appeared out of nowhere. No, scratch that: something in that asteroid field is emitting it. Go quickly!
Head into the asteroid field to find the source of the unidentified signal.%br%%br%Hint: Hold the SPACE bar to activate your booster.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_lookat_waypo: Navigation check. I’ve set a waypoint for you. Align your ship to it.

Turn your ship until the orange diamond-shaped waypoint is in the center of your screen.%br%%br%If you can’t see the waypoint, look for an arrow at the screen’s edge and follow the direction it indicates.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_maneuvering_: First things first; let's do a quick check of your chassis. See, sometimes a Raider isn't the right fit for a resurrected consciousness.%br%%br%Move around a little for me.
Click and hold your right mouse button anywhere in open space to turn your ship.
Not bad. Try to roll, now.
Roll your Raider using the 'Q' and 'E' keys.
Good. Now let's field-test your thrusters.
Move or strafe sideways using the 'W', 'A', 'S', and 'D' keys.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_post_fight_t: You've got some unexpectedly slippery moves, there. When a spot opens up on Scar’s wing, we may just consider you for it.

That was the last of them - for now, anyway.%br%But what were they? They share too many design details with us for it to be pure coincidence, but they're also definitely not Cylons. Perhaps God made them, too? They're certainly nothing like human ships. This is... concerning.
Hint: While fighting, try and keep an eye on your health and energy display in the upper left-hand corner.%br%%br%Click OK.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_saved_scarbu: You seem to have some trouble obeying orders. You wouldn't be developing a personality, there, would you?%br%...Because it might suit you. Within reason.%br%%br%You should get to our jump coordinates now. Human Vipers and Raptors are probably already heading this way.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_saving_scarb: Sprocket, I told you to get your sorry excuse for a chassis to the Basestar's FTL coordinates. NOW!
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_scarbuck_con: That's that, then, Sprocket. Get out of there.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_scarbuck_ord: It’s opened fire! How dare it! Take it down!
Click on the marked enemy to select it. %br%%br%Your weapons will fire at it automatically, as long as your target is within their firing arc and within range.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_scarbuck_rep: Basestar, we've found some sort of construct. Its energy signal came up on my DRADIS all of a sudden, and is growing steadily stronger. It... may be powering up.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_scarbuck_wel: This is just a standard reconnaissance mission, Sprocket, so try and keep up with Scar.%br%%br%No: that's what you’re getting called, at least until you're a fully trained and experienced Raider. Nothing personal, but also not up for debate.%br%Now focus... and keep looking for the humans.
values.bgo.story_cylon_100.trigger_spawn_drone_: Be careful! There are more unidentified ships incoming from the rear.
Destroy the incoming enemy ships.%br%Hint: Press 'X' to automatically target the closest enemy.
More of those ships incoming. Ready to go, Sprocket? Be careful: these look like they're in better shape than the others.
My DRADIS is showing another one. Looks like its avoidance capabilities are off the charts, so guns won’t do much damage. Take it out using your missiles, instead!
Destroy the enemy ship. Press '2' to fire a missile once you’ve been notified that the enemy is in range [50-1100m] and within your launcher’s firing arc.
values.bgo.story_cylon_101.Description: After jumping to an unknown sector, the Basestar is heavily damaged and the Cylon fleet is in need of repairs. You have been assigned the task of locating vital resources to repair the fleet and destroy the humans once and for all.
values.bgo.story_cylon_101.Name: Introduction to Battlespace
values.bgo.story_cylon_101.trigger_arrive_in_ba: Until the Basestar is fully operational, we are in desperate need of resources. We have detected a large planetoid in this area. Approach it and determine it's composition.
values.bgo.story_cylon_101.trigger_call_mining_: Mining ships gather resources such as water, tylium, and titanium that can be used to purchase upgrades and repair your ship.  Asteroids may also contain resources but you'll have to acquire them yourself by targeting them with your weapons.
values.bgo.story_cylon_101.trigger_defend_plane: Our mining ship is under attack from the weapon platforms. Eliminate the threat or we'll lose that ship!
values.bgo.story_cylon_101.trigger_event_on_min: Scan the Planetoid and Order a Mining Ship
Scan the planetoid again to order a mining ship.
You must order a mining ship to complete the mission.
values.bgo.story_cylon_101.trigger_mission_fail: The mining ship has been destroyed. Return to the Basestar.
values.bgo.story_cylon_101.trigger_mission_succ: The mining ship's cargo hold is full. Return to the Basestar.
values.bgo.story_cylon_101.trigger_platforms_de: The mining ship is safe. Patrol the area until the mining ship has filled its hold.
Stay close to the Mining Ship
values.bgo.story_cylon_101.trigger_scout_planet: Target the planetoid, and use the mineral scanner to determine its composition.
Select the Planetoid by clicking on it with your mouse pointer, then click the flashing icon.
Select and Scan the Planetoid with the Mineral Analysis Cluster.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.Description: Fourth Tutorial Mission, teaching Surplus and System Map features to the player.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.Name: Story Mission 103
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_about_moon: Additional power signatures have activated in the planet's orbit, and there appears to be a structure on the surface. Proceed and investigate.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_debris: A derelict ship...? Processing...definitely not of Colonial registry. Hold station and wait for further instructions.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_debris_compl: It would appear we are not the first Cylons to visit this sector after all. This is an unexpected development.%br%%br%More data must be acquired. Continue your mission, %rank%.
Fly to the nearby Nav Marker.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_debris3: Automated defense drones. Analysis suggests they're of Cylon origin. Assume you are in hostile territory, %rank%... Cylon or not, those drones did not respond to your IFF signals.%br%%br%IFF stands for Identification, Friend or Foe.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_debris4: Curious. We have analysed the images of the wreck. It also appears Cylon in design, but we are unable to locate additional information in our primary data archives.%br%%br%Recover samples for analysis upon your return.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_debris4.1: Click on the nearby containers. You must be within Range 750 of a container to open it.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_drones_at_wa: This much is clear - whoever these Cylons were, it appears they were at war.  Proceed with caution.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_drones_detec: Power spikes detected in the asteroid field ahead, %rank%.  Enemy drones inbound to your position!
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_enter: Data acquisition is your primary objective in this mission, %rank%. Assign a high priority to your visual feeds...
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_info_dradis: Icons on your DRADIS show the positions of nearby ships and objects.  Use your System Map for a wider view of the area.
For a wider view, click the System Map icon.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_info_drones1: I'm reading power spikes in the wreckage...something's targeting you!  Prepare for combat, %rank%!
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_info_flyup: Move to the nav marker on the other side of the asteroid.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_info_map2: The System Map displays your location, along with the location of enemy units, asteroids, planetoids and other objects of note in the area.%br%
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_info_map2.1: Close the System Map by clicking on the Exit button.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_info_map3: I've noticed some unusual readings in your data feed, %rank%. They're just beyond that nearby asteroid. Further investigation is required.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_info_map3.1: Move to the nearby Nav Marker.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_info_proceed: Advance to the nav marker in the asteroid field
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_open_debris1: Well done, %rank%. You've found some valuable salvage material. Collect it and continue your search.
Click on each object you want in the Items Window to take it into storage. You can collect all items at once by clicking 'Take All'.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_prep_map_tut: ...and monitor your DRADIS sensor clusters on a regular basis. %br%%br%DRADIS stands for Direction, Range, And Distance In Space.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_small_moon: The secondary Basestar has been routed to the 47 Tartalon system and will deal with any remaining defense systems before initiating a thorough investigation. %br%%br%Your mission is complete, %rank%. Return to the fleet and report to Number One.
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_stationary_a: The planet is defended by an orbital array of fortified asteroids. You will need to neutralize one in order to investigate further. Processing sensor data...
The power levels on the nearest platform are weaker than the others. Relaying target selection and assigning additional Raider support to your location.%br%
values.bgo.story_cylon_103.trigger_stationary_d: Target neutralized. Sensor data confirms the presence of an industrial facility on the surface of the planet. It appears abandoned, but analysis reveals many inactive power sources.%br%%br%This base may prove to be critical in our efforts to return the fleet to operational status. Well done, %rank%.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.Description: Fifth Tutorial Mission, teaching Mining to the Player.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.Name: Story Mission 104
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_all_mined: Both Mining systems are operating beyond simulation parameters. I forecast a significant increase in resource collection.  Truly, a good omen.%br%%br%Your performance has been exemplary, %rank%. Return to the Basestar.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_asteroid_min: Mined Resources will be automatically booked to your 'hold'.
The Gouger system performs well. My data indicates a higher efficiency than weapons fire. The use of rock fragments as ammo makes the Gouger a self-sustaining tool.  Excellent.
Continue your evaluation and gather additional performance data, %rank%. I've detected another field near your position.  Its larger asteroids may yield a proportionately large quantity of resources.
Move to the second asteroid field and continue mining operations.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_briefing: These recovered industrial systems appear quite ingenious. Simulations suggest that they will allow all pilots to contribute to our efforts to repair and rearm the fleet by finding and harvesting useful resources.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_briefing.1: Advance to the asteroid field ahead.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_disable_hint: Before proceeding, check if your Gouger Mining Cannon is deactivated. Pulverising asteroids at random would be inefficient.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_drones: Initiate combat routines, %rank%. Data evaluation subroutines have flagged power spikes in the asteroid field. %br%%br%The Gouger was not designed for combat.  Engage the enemy with your Missile systems.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_drones_defea: Curious. The data on these drones suggests they are as old as those you encountered at 47 Tartalon. However, they are not of Cylon design... they are Colonial in origin.  Human.
Data flagged for additional analysis. Continue evaluation routines to gather additional performance data.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_drones.1: Use Missiles to destroy the drones.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_goto_next_as: Move to the second asteroid field and continue mining operations.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_info_advance: Mine <highlight>Water</highlight>, <highlight>Tylium</highlight>, and <highlight>Titanium</highlight> at the Nav Point
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_info_asteroi: Hold position, %rank%. We'll begin Mineral Cluster analysis operations shortly.
Bring your Heavy Raider to a stop.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_info_mining1: Simulations accurate. Cluster function optimal, visual feed routing effective. Calibration data:%br%%br%Yellow - Tylium deposits. Blue - Water or Ice. Purple - Titanium Ore. Red - no useful resources.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_info_mining2: On discovery of useful resources, initiate Gouger Mining Cannon evaluation. Approach an asteroid and activate the Gouger. Use it to pulverise the target, allowing resources to be harvested.
Use your Mining Cannon on asteroids and collect the resources.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_info_scan1: Initiate Mineral Analysis evaluation. Select an asteroid and activate the cluster, which should route basic results to your visual feeds in addition to providing accurate resource appraisal.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_info_scan1.1: Click on an asteroid to target it, then click the Mineral Analysis icon.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_info_scan1.2: Click on an asteroid to target it, then click the Mineral Analysis icon.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_missile_rang: Remember - Missiles cannot launch below Range 200, so keep your distance!
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_titanium_min: Titanium is used to repair hull and system Durability.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_tylium_mined: Tylium is used as fuel by both Colonial and Cylon ships, making it a vital resource.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_use_mining_c: Use the Gouger Mining Cannon Mine Resources.
values.bgo.story_cylon_104.trigger_water_mined: Water is in short supply in the fleet, making it very valuable.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.Name: Story Mission 105
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_briefing: Acknowledged. Start your sensor sweep.%br%%br%%name%, begin your escort patrol.  Remain vigilant!
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_briefing.1: Target and follow the Heavy Raider.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_continue_esc: Continue to escort the Heavy Raider.
Continue to escort the Heavy Raider.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_continue_mis: Acknowledged.  You may continue with the operation.%br%%br%%name%, we're relying on you to keep the Heavy Raider safe until the scans are complete.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_first_attack: Hostile target detected... it's Colonial, Viper class.  Intercept it, %rank%.
Command, be advised - we have encountered a Colonial Viper.  It was a lone patrol; we should be safe for now.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_follow_frien: Click the <highlight>Follow Friendly Target icon</highlight> to follow the Heavy Raider.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_info_kill2: Protect the Heavy Raider from Colonial attack.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_info_kill3: Protect the Heavy Raider while it prepares to jump to safety.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_match_target: Click the <highlight>Match Target Speed icon</highlight> to match speed with your target.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_scans: Understood.  Beginning scans now.  Let's hope we've seen all the humans in this sector today.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_scans_comple: Scan sequence complete. As we suspected, conditions inside the nebula make it impassable for the humans, trapping them in this sector. Number One will be pleased.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_scans.1: Continue to escort the Heavy Raider.%br%
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_scans2: Acknowledged.  Unfortunately, the particle density and radiation levels are too high for our fleet to jump safely inside the nebula.%br%%br%We'll continue the analysis, but you've got us what we needed. Return to the Basestar.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_second_attac: That didn't take long...Colonial forces detected. Prepare for combat.%br%
The humans must be aware of our presence by now, %rank%. We're not leaving until the scan sequence is complete... and that leaves us vulnerable to attack.  Stay sharp.
Continue to escort the Heavy Raider.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_start: Jump successful. We have arrived at the designated coordinates and are preparing sensor routines.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_target_frien: Click on the <highlight>Target Friendly icon</highlight> to target the Heavy Raider.
values.bgo.story_cylon_105.trigger_third_attack: We're done here, %rank%. Initiate FTL routines for return to the Basestar. Interference from the nebula will increase our time to jump...%br%%br%Multiple hostiles detected! Vipers inbound!  Engage!
Nice work, %rank%. FTL drives fully charged.  Let's leave before the entire Colonial fleet decides to visit.  Initiate jump sequence - now.
Protect the Heavy Raider while they prepare to jump to safety.
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.Name: Story Mission 2
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_debris: A derelict ship? Processing visual data...
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_debris_tip: You must be within 750 range of a container to open it
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_debris2: Come to a stop and turn towards the wreck
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_debris3: Automated defense drones. They appear Cylon, but are of an unfamiliar design, and did not respond to your IFF signals, %rank%.%br%%br%IFF stands for Identification, Friend or Foe.
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_debris4: Curious. We have analysed the images of the wreck. It also appears Cylon in design, but we are unable to locate additional information in our primary data archives.%br%%br%Recover samples for analysis upon your return.
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_enter: Data acquisition is your primary objective in this mission, %rank%. Assign a high priority to your visual feeds...
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_find_debris: Data evaluation subroutines have flagged unusual sensor returns on the other side of the asteroid ahead. Investigate.
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_galactica: Additional power spikes detected in the asteroid field ahead, %rank%!
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_galactica2: Additional defense drones. Whoever these Cylons were, it appears they were at war.
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_galactica3: Additional power signatures have activated in the planet's orbit, and there appears to be a structure on the surface. Investigate, but be wary.
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_info_debris: Return to the wreck and click on all three blue cargo containers nearby to collect salvage
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_info_dradis: Icons on your DRADIS show the positions of nearby ships and objects.%br%%br%DRADIS stands for Direction, Range, and Distance in space.
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_info_drones1: Prepare for combat, %rank%! Data evaluation subroutines have flagged power spikes in the wreckage.
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_info_drones2: Engage and destroy the unknown targets
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_info_flyup: Move to the nav marker on the other side of the asteroid
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_info_map: For a wider view, click the System Map icon
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_info_map2: The System Map displays an overview of the current star system
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_info_map3: Close the System Map by clicking on the Exit button
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_info_proceed: Advance to the nav marker in the asteroid field
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_info_usemouse: Left-click and drag the mouse to look around your ship
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_info_zoom: Use [SHIFT] + mouse wheel to zoom in and out
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_open_debris: It would appear we are not the first Cylon to visit this sector after all. This is an unexpected development.%br%%br%More data must be acquired. Continue your mission, %rank%.
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_small_moon: The secondary Basestar has been routed to the 47 Tartalon system and will deal with any remaining defense systems before initiating a thorough investigation. %br%%br%Your mission is complete, %rank%. Return to the fleet and report to Number One.%br%%br%[Mission Complete]
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_speed_tip2: Keep moving - if you slow down or stop, you'll be easier to hit
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_stationary_anc: The planet is defended by an orbital array of fortified asteroids. You will need to neutralize one in order to investigate further. Processing sensor data...
The power levels on the nearest platform are weaker than the others. Relaying target selection and assigning additional Raider support to your location.
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_stationary_def: Target neutralized. Sensor data confirms the presence of an industrial facility on the surface of the planet. It appears abandoned, but analysis reveals many inactive power sources.%br%%br%This base may prove to be critical in our efforts to return the fleet to operational status. Well done, %rank%
values.bgo.story_cylon_2.trigger_system_map: ...and monitor your sensor clusters on a regular basis.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200_editor.Name: Akhlys's Fury
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.Name: Akhlys's Fury
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_miningship_h: What are you doing? The ship has sustained critical damage - we can't take much more!
We need backup now - we're getting hammered!
If you don't step in now, we're goners!
Number 2: Anybody out there? Our ship is under heavy fire!
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s1_1_dialogu: Cronus Lead to Stygian, jump complete. Requesting situation report.
This is Stygian. Jump complete. Cronus two through eight report jump complete.
Initiating patrol. All Cronus, initiate formation.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s1_2_dialogu: Stygian: Stygian to Cronus Lead. Confirming radio signatures! Wireless signals are weak due to electromagnetic disturbances in the nebula.
Plouton: Mayday, mayday – this is the Plouton. Contact with escort lost and enemy attacks are increasing. All units respond!
Cronus Lead to Plouton. Rendering assistance at Zero-Nine-Five carom Two-Three-Five.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s1_4_dialogu: Number 2: Thanks for your assistance! Our escort got dragged away - sending you the coordinates where we lost contact.
Prepare for immediate departure - saving the resources has highest priority.

Number 2: Well, I'm happy to hear that you put our precious cargo above our worthless lives, Cronus Lead, but I have to deny - our mining drill is stuck. We need to fix that before we can take off this rock.
Acknowledged. Cronus 1 and 2 initiate strike formation; all other units guard the mining ship. Initiating search for missing data cores.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s1_4_new_obj: Move to position where contact with the mining ships escort broke down.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s2_1_dialogu: Stygian: Stygian to Cronus Lead, detecting DRADIS readings in this sector that are believed to be data cores.
Cronus Lead to Stygian. Requesting waypoint on signatures.
Stygian: Affirmative, Cronus Lead. Initiating sweep to find them – visibility is low and DRADIS is malfunctioning.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s2_1_new_obj: Check the signals for possible survivors.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s2_2_dialog1: All signals have been checked. Returning to the mining ship.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s2_2_start: s2_2 started - ALL SIGNALS HAVE BEEN CHECKED
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s2_waypoint1: Stygian: Scanner is showing strong readings...
Argus 1: Argus 1 reporting for duty. Cronus Lead, there are 6 signals closing in on our position.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s2_waypoint2: Stygian, any signs of a working data core?
Ok, moving on to the next signal.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s2_waypoint3: This is Cronus Lead, report for duty, centurion.
I repeat, this is Cronus Lead, requesting status report.
Stygian: Systems indicate heavy damage, but the data core seems to be intact.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s2_waypoint4: Stygian: Contact, 3 colonial strikes. No signs of being detected.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s2_waypoint5: Cronus Lead here, can you hear me centurion?
Stygian: Strike craft took severe combat damage. Receiving weak signals that suggest that its data core is still working.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s2_waypoint6: Stygian: One Raider, its systems are powered down.
Cronus Lead here, do you copy?
Argus 6: Copy Cronus Lead, this is Argus 6.
Argus 6, you are now under my command. Fall in formation.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s2_waypoint7: Cronus Lead here, do you copy?
Stygian: Strike crafts combat effectiveness below 23%. Suggesting data core recovery.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s3_1_dialogu: Watcher: Inbound signal detected. Initiating defensive routines.
We are en route to your position. Plouton, status report.
Number 2: Drill Extraction completed, taking off in 3... 2... 1!
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s4_1_dialogu: Number 2: Setting course to the jump coordinates, ETA 2 minutes!
Fend off the attackers until the Plouton jumps out of the system.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s5_1_dialogu: Watcher: Capital ship size signature detected. Scanners indicating carrier class vessel.
Affirmative. To all units: strikes have highest target priority, ignore the capital ship unless ordered otherwise.
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s5_1_setup_w: Terminus: Detecting new signals, multiple threats incoming.
Watcher: Carrier is launching another wave!
values.bgo.story_cylon_200.trigger_s5_2_dialogu: Number 2: Initiating jump sequence, jumping in 10 seconds!
Mission goals accomplished. All units cease fire and initiate jump sequence.
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.Name: Story Mission 3
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_first_attack_d: Well done, %rank%. We are initiating the scan sequence now.
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_heavy_raider: Scan sequence complete. As we suspected, conditions inside the nebula make it impassable for the humans, trapping them in this sector. Number One will be pleased.
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_info_follow: Click the Target Friendly icon to target the Heavy Raider
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_info_follow2: Click the Match Target Speed icon to match speed with your target
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_info_follow3: Click the Follow Friendly Target icon to follow the Heavy Raider
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_info_kill: Engage the hostile target and protect the Heavy Raider
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_info_kill2: Engage the Colonials and protect the Heavy Raider
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_info_kill3: Engage the Colonials and protect the Heavy Raider
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_info_proceed: Continue to escort the Heavy Raider
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_info_proceed2: Continue to escort the Heavy Raider
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_second_attack_: Be wary, %rank%. The humans must be aware of our presence by now and the scan sequence is still running.
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_start: Jump successful. We have arrived at the designated coordinates and are preparing sensor routines.%br%%br%Stay close, %rank%. The humans are no doubt investigating the nebula as well.
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_third_attack: We have achieved our objectives. Initiate FTL routines for return to the Basestar. Be aware that interference from the nebula will reduce drive charge rates...%br%%br%Multiple hostiles detected! The humans are persistent!
values.bgo.story_cylon_3.trigger_third_attack_d: You have brought glory to the Cylon, %rank%. FTL drives fully charged. Jump sequence initiating.%br%%br%[Mission Complete]
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.Name: Story Mission 4
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_all_mined: Evaluation routines complete. Both systems operating beyond simulation parameters. Projected increase in resource income from distribution to all pilots is significant.%br%%br%Your performance has been exemplary, %rank%. Return to Basestar.%br%%br%[Mission Complete]
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_asteroid_mined: Simulations accurate. Gouger system function optimal. Data indicates asteroid disintegration efficiency significantly higher than combat cannon fire. Extrapolation suggests that self-sustaining use of rock fragment projectiles will result in significant reduction in combat ammunition expenditure.

Continue evaluation routines to gather additional performance data. Sensors indicate presence of larger asteroids in secondary field proximate to current position. High probability of correlation between asteroid size and quantity of resource deposits.
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_asteroids: Hold position and prepare for Mineral Analysis Cluster evaluation.
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_disable: Before proceeding, deactivate the Gouger mining system. Pulverising asteroids at random would be inefficient.
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_drones: Initiate combat routines, %rank%. Data evaluation subroutines have flagged power spikes in the asteroid field. Simulations suggest Gouger system combat efficiency low. Missile system activation recommended.
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_drones_defeate: Curious. Combat feed analysis indicates automated defense systems of similar age to those encountered defending abandoned base in 47 Tartalon star system. However, design schematics do not match and suggest human manufacture.
Data flagged for additional analysis. Continue evaluation routines to gather additional performance data.
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_info_advance: Move to the second asteroid field and continue mining operations
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_info_advance2: Move to the second asteroid field and continue mining operations
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_info_disable: Click on the mining cannon to deactivate it
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_info_drones: Engage the drones with your missiles
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_info_mine: Use the Gouger mining cannon to break up asteroids containing resources
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_info_scan: Click on an asteroid to target it, then click the Mineral Analysis icon
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_info_stop: Come to a stop close to the asteroid field
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_missile_range: Missiles cannot launch below Range 200, so keep your distance
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_open_mining: Simulations accurate. Cluster function optimal, visual feed routing effective. Calibration data:%br%%br%Yellow - Tylium deposits. Blue - Water ice. Purple - Titanium ore. Red - no useful resources.
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_open_mining2: On discovery of useful resources, initiate Gouger mining system evaluation. Approach asteroid and activate Gouger system to pulverise the target, allowing resources to be harvested.
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_scan: Initiate Mineral Analysis evaluation. Select an asteroid and activate the cluster, which should route basic results to your visual feeds in addition to providing accurate resource appraisal.
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_start: These recovered industrial systems appear quite ingenious. Simulations suggest that they will allow all pilots to contribute to our efforts to repair and rearm the fleet by finding and harvesting useful resources.%br%%br%Advance to the asteroid field ahead in order to begin evaluation sequences.
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_titanium_mined: Titanium is used to repair hull and system Durability
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_tylium_mined: Tylium is used as fuel by both Colonial and Cylon ships, making it a vital resource
values.bgo.story_cylon_4.trigger_water_mined: Water is in short supply in the fleet, making it very valuable
values.bgo.story_cylon_5.Name: Story Mission 5
values.bgo.story_cylon_5.trigger_finished: Sensors indicate no additional human ships in the area, %rank%. Mission complete.%br%
values.bgo.story_cylon_5.trigger_info_map: Mining ships can be called in to extract resources from planetoids. These huge asteroids are too large to break up with mining cannons, but can contain very large quantities of resources.
values.bgo.story_cylon_5.trigger_map: Planetoids are indicated by grey hexagons on the System Map.
values.bgo.story_cylon_5.trigger_move: Advance towards the cluster of Planetoids.
values.bgo.story_cylon_5.trigger_scan: Locate a resource-rich Planetoid and call in a Mining Ship.
values.bgo.story_cylon_5.trigger_ship_enter: Mining ships are unarmed and must be protected from enemy forces while they extract resources.
values.bgo.story_cylon_5.trigger_ship_enter2: Guard the Mining Ship while it extracts resources.
values.bgo.story_cylon_5.trigger_start: The Marauder's reinforced, high density hull makes it well suited to defending slow or unarmed vessels, such as mining ships.
values.bgo.story_cylon_5.trigger_trigger_planet: Planetoids can be scanned for resources using a Mineral Analysis system. The Marauder has been equipped with such a system. Use it now.
Scan planetoids with the Mineral Anaylsis Module.
values.bgo.story_cylon_5.trigger_victory_1: The human ship may have signalled the mining ship's location, %rank%. Be on alert for additional attackers.
values.bgo.story_cylon_5.trigger_victory_2: Your integration with the Marauder's command and control interfaces is impressive, %rank%.%br%
values.bgo.story_cylon_5.trigger_victory_3: Those ships were not among the standard types used by the colonial fleet. It appears that the humans have also found abandoned ships in this sector that they can use.%br%%br%This is a disturbing development.
values.bgo.story_cylon_6.Name: Story Mission 6
values.bgo.story_cylon_6.trigger_enemy_movement: Drone power signatures detected. Prepare for combat, %rank%!
values.bgo.story_cylon_6.trigger_escape: Avoid the enemy while your FTL drive spins up.
values.bgo.story_cylon_6.trigger_recon: The high levels of human activity make it unlikely that you will be able to avoid contact, so your Heavy Raider has been equipped with a Damage Control system.%br%%br%Activating Damage Control will repair hull damage your ship, consuming a DC Pack of spare parts and materials. Be aware that the Power requirements of Damage Control systems are significant.
values.bgo.story_cylon_6.trigger_start: The humans appear to be very interested in this area, and we must discover why. Our data on this sector and the nebula are still fragmentary, and we cannot allow the humans to gain an advantage.
values.bgo.story_cylon_6.trigger_wave1_defeated: Interesting. Human activity levels do not match our previous data. Proceed with caution, %rank%.
values.bgo.story_cylon_6.trigger_wave2_defeated: To defeat the humans, there must have been a very large drone swarm here. But what was it's purpose, so close to the edge of the nebula?%br%
values.bgo.story_cylon_6.trigger_wave3_defeated: Hmm. A new variety of automated drone, much larger and more powerful than those we have encountered until now. Be wary, %rank%.
values.bgo.story_cylon_6.trigger_waypoint_reach: There has obviously been a significant engagement here, but what were the humans fighting?
values.bgo.story_cylon_6.trigger_waypoint2_reac: Ah... Your sensor data indicates a large break in the nebula ahead of your position, %rank%.
No wonder the humans are so interested. Such a passage may offer them a means of escape from this sector. This cannot be allowed. More data is required.
values.bgo.story_cylon_6.trigger_waypoint3_reac: Large human fleet detected! Abort your sensor sweep and initiate jump sequence, %rank%.%br%%br%Interference from the nebula will degrade your FTL drives. Avoid the human fleet until your drives can engage.
Stay intact until you can jump to safety.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.Name: Story Mission 7
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_halt: Sensors indicate heavy human activity at the entrance point, %rank%. The scout group will hold position while you neutralize the humans.%br%%br%Be aware that we are detecting an unknown human vessel of Escort size.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_halt.1: Clear the route entrance of enemy patrols.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_kill_patrols: Clear the route entrance of enemy patrols.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_lore_chat: Escort ships are large enough to mount weapon batteries with longer range and wider firing arcs than Strikes, and their side-mounted weapons allow them to fire at targets almost anywhere around them.%br%%br%The combination makes them very effective at protecting other ships from enemy Strikes.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_proceed1: Escort the scout group to the entrance point.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_proceed2: Escort the scout group to the entrance point.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_proceed3: Escort the scout group to the entrance point.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_proceed4: Escort the scout group to the entrance point.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_report: Scout Group reporting. We have entered the break in the nebula. It appears to extend a considerable distance. Proceeding.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_report2: Unknown power signatures detected... Massive energy spikes! Abort mi...
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_report3: %rank%, communications and sensor data from the scout group have been lost, they are presumed destroyed. Human reinforcements are en route to your position. Abort mission and return to the Basestar immediately.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_start: Defend the scout group and break through the human patrols so that they can enter the passage into the nebula, %rank%.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_tier2: Once inside the nebula passage, the scout group's communications range will be degraded. Remain at the entrance point in order to relay their sensor data to the Basestar.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_tier2.1: Escort the scout group to the passage.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_wait: Objectives achieved. Hold position while the scout group enters the break in the nebula. Prepare to relay communication and sensor data.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_wait.1: Hold position at the entrance point.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_wait2: Hold position at the entrance point.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_wave1_defeated: Heavier resistance is likely as you proceed, %rank%. Remain alert.
Continue to escort the scout group.
values.bgo.story_cylon_7.trigger_zone_enter: Route entered, orders ignored, mission failed!
values.bgo.story_cylon_8.Name: Story Mission 8
values.bgo.story_cylon_8.trigger_ambush: A human patrol! Quickly, %rank% - eliminate them before they can escape and warn the convoy!
values.bgo.story_cylon_8.trigger_ambush_defeate: Hold position and wait for the enemy convoy to arrive.
values.bgo.story_cylon_8.trigger_freighter_dest: Enemy freighter destroyed. Well done, %rank%. Without those supplies, the human position at the entrance to the nebula passage will be weakened. Mission complete.
values.bgo.story_cylon_8.trigger_hold_position: Hold position and wait for the enemy convoy to arrive.
values.bgo.story_cylon_8.trigger_start: According to our analysis of the human activity around the entrance to the nebula passage, the supply convoy should arrive in this area shortly. Be prepared to initiate your attack as soon as it appears.
values.bgo.story_cylon_8.trigger_start.1: Hold position and wait for the enemy convoy.
values.bgo.story_cylon_8.trigger_time_nearly_up: Destroy the convoy before it escapes!
values.bgo.story_cylon_8.trigger_timeup: The convoy has reached its jump coordinates and escaped, %rank%! Mission failed.
values.bgo.story_cylon_9.Name: Story Mission 9
values.bgo.story_cylon_9.trigger_recon: Proceed with caution to the first waypoint
values.bgo.story_cylon_9.trigger_start: [The player is informed about the scouting mission]
values.bgo.story_cylon_9.trigger_waypoint1b: [The player is told that everything seems quiet so far]
values.bgo.story_cylon_9.trigger_waypoint3b: [The player is informed that reinforcements will arrive]
values.bgo.story_cylon_9.trigger_waypoint4: [The player is made aware that something huge is up ahead]
values.bgo.story_human_1.Name: Story Mission 1001
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_begin_dogfight: Press the X key to target the closest enemy unit.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_cannon5: Armed cannons automatically fire on selected targets when in range and firing arc.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_dock_point: %name%, Galactica.  You are clear to land.  Welcome home.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_dogfight_intro: Not bad.  Too bad the Cylons don't sit still and wait to get shot.  Let's see how you handle a moving target.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_drone1: I'm gonna activate three training drones, and I want you to take them out one by one.%br%%br%> Destroy the training drones.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_enter: Time for one of my favorite training missions... gunnery practice.  You up for a little destruction, nugget?
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_fire_missile: This drone is out of cannon range - left-click the Missile icon to launch a missile at it.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_fire_missile2: Missile Launchers must cool down between launches. They won't fire until that happens.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_fire_missile3: Continue firing missiles to destroy the drone.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_first_fight: That moving target is me, by the way.  Show me what you've got, nugget!%br%%br%> Engage Starbuck in a training dogfight.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_first_victory: Not too shabby, %name%. The Admiral might let you fly a Viper in his fleet after all!
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_found_somethin: Galactica, Starbuck. Picking up some strange signals out here... pretty faint, but... huh. They're gone now.  Think we better look into this, and soon.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_get_back: I think you've 'killed' me enough for one day, though.  Let's get back to Galactica before your head doesn't fit in your cockpit.%br%%br%> Return to the Galactica.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_go_home: Head back to the Galactica by right-clicking on it.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_help_advanced_: Activate boosters by left-clicking the Booster icon and head back to the Galactica.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_kill_drone1: Left-click on the training drone ahead to target and destroy it.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_kill_drone2: Right-click on the drone to bring it into the firing arc of your cannons.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_kill_drone3: Turn to face the last drone by right-clicking on it.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_missile_tip: Missiles cannot launch below Range 200, so keep your distance if you wish to use them in battle.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_target_enemy: Left-click the Target Enemy icon below the DRADIS to target the next drone.%br%%br%DRADIS stands for Direction, Range, And Distance In Space.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_target_last_en: Left-click the Target Enemy icon to target the last drone.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_target_tip: Right-click and hold on a moving target to keep turning towards it.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_target_trainer: Engage Starbuck with your cannons and missiles.
values.bgo.story_human_1.trigger_use_boost: Don't forget about your boosters, %name%. I wouldn't want to delay you from bragging about your mighty victory to the other nuggets.%br%%br%> Use your Viper's boosters.
values.bgo.story_human_10.Name: Story Mission 10
values.bgo.story_human_10.trigger_killall: [Player is informed that he did great]
values.bgo.story_human_10.trigger_location: Take out the enemy Outpost and all the guards
values.bgo.story_human_10.trigger_proceed: [Player is ordered to lead the army and defeat the Outpost]
values.bgo.story_human_10.trigger_proceedb: Lead the army to the enemy Outpost
values.bgo.story_human_10.trigger_start: [Player is briefed about the enemy Outpost]
values.bgo.story_human_100_editor.Name: Human Tutorial #1
values.bgo.story_human_100_old_editor.Name: Human Tutorial #1
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.Name: Human Tutorial #1
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_approach: Stay close, Nugget. Time to find out where this signature’s coming from.%br%Remember: the faster you fly, the harder you are to take down.
Increase your speed and follow Starbuck to the target.
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_basestar: This is Admiral Adama. %br%%br%The Cylons have found us.%br%All pilots, return to Galactica immediately. We need to retract all flight pods and jump out.
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_commande: Starbuck. This is Admiral Adama. Return to the Galactica immediately. Looks like this sector isn't the unoccupied refuge we were hoping for.
Thank you. Starbuck was in some real trouble there. Great work.
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_deactiva: Destroy the enemy ship. %br%%br%Press '2' or the highlighted slot to launch a missile.%br%Note: Missile range is 200-1000 m.
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_enemy_fa: Holy frak! We've got incoming!%br%%br%Cylon scouts. They found us.%br%Nugget, punch your booster and return to Galactica, NOW! You're no match for them; I'll try and hold 'em off as long as I can.
Return to the Galactica.%br%Hint: Hold the SPACE bar to activate your booster.
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_follow_s: All right! Let's get these bad boys moving and start with our patrol. Punch it and follow me through the waypoints!
Follow Starbuck through the orange waypoints.%br%Accelerate by dragging the flashing slider up, or by scrolling your mouse wheel up.%br%
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_gun_acti: Frak! What was that?!%br%DRADIS shows a ship dead ahead of us, but get this: its signature isn't Colonial, but it's not Cylon either.%br%%br%Better get your guns ready!
Activate your two side guns by clicking the highlighted gun slots.
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_investig: That's all of them I can see. Lemme check DRADIS...%br%Good. We seem to've actually gotten them all. That's - wait. What in the...?%br%I've got a signal. Don't recognize it - it's coming from over there, in the asteroid field. %br%C'mon, let's check it out.
Head into the asteroid field to find the source of the unidentified signal.%br%Hint: Hold the SPACE bar to activate your booster.
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_lookat_w: Excellent! I’ve set a waypoint for you. Align your ship to it.
Turn your ship and get the orange diamond shaped waypoint in the center of the screen.%br%If the waypoint is outside the screen it will turn into an arrow at its edge.
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_maneuver: All right, Nugget - first thing is to make sure these birds are actually fully operational. That battle took a real toll on our Vipers, and Galactica's engineers are as sleep-deprived as we are. %br%%br%Check your avionics.
Click and hold your right mouse button anywhere in open space to turn your ship.
Not bad. Try to roll, now.
Roll your Viper using the 'Q' and 'E' keys.
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_post_fig: Lords of Kobol, Nugget, those were some top-tier fighting skills you just showed me. I'm half tempted to get you onto my squadron.

OK, that's bought us a minute's breathing room.%br%What WERE those things? The shape they're in, it looks like they've just been sitting here for centuries. And though they're definitely not Cylon, there's something ...Cylon-ish about them. The ship design is just a little too frakkin' similar.
Hint: While fighting, try and keep an eye on your health and energy display in the upper left-hand corner.%br%%br%Click OK.
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_saved_sc: Thanks, I guess. Obeying orders isn't one of your strengths, huh?%br%Anyway, I'm betting the Cylon cavalry is on its way. Let's get back to the Galactica ASAP.
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_saving_s: Nugget, I said get your ass back on board Galactica! That is an order!
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_scarbuck: You heard the Old Man, Nugget. We're heading back to Galactica.
They've opened fire! You're clear to attack - fire at will!
Click on the marked enemy. Your weapons will fire at it automatically, as long as your target is within their firing arc and within range.
Galactica, Starbuck. We've found a weird construct out here. Its energy signature just popped up on my DRADIS all of a sudden. And now it keeps getting stronger, like... like it's powering up.

You're in my wing now, Nugget, so behave - and keep your eyes peeled.%br%%br%Frak; feels like I haven't gotten a wink of sleep in two weeks. Ever since our attack on their Resurrection Ship, the damn Cylons are everywhere. I think they sent their whole fleet after us!
values.bgo.story_human_100_old.trigger_spawn_dr: Good shot, Nugget.%br%%br%...Watch out!! We've got more incoming, from our six!
Destroy the incoming enemy ships.%br%Hint: Press 'X' to automatically target the closest enemy.
More of those ships incoming. Frak - they look like they're in much better shape than the last ones! Ready, Nugget?
My DRADIS is showing another one. Take it out! %br%%br%Try using your missiles.
Destroy the enemy ship. %br%%br%Press '2' or the highlighted slot to launch a missile.%br%Note: Missile range is 200-1000 m.
values.bgo.story_human_100.Name: Human Tutorial #1
values.bgo.story_human_100.trigger_avoidance_ex: Good shot, Nugget.%br%%br%Keep in mind that though flying at low speeds makes it easier to aim at enemies, it also makes it far more likely that their projectiles will hit you, too. When you’re in combat, always fly as fast as you can.

Turn your ship until the orange diamond-shaped waypoint is in the center of your screen.%br%%br%If you can’t see the waypoint, look for an arrow at the screen’s edge and follow the direction it indicates.

values.bgo.story_human_101.Description: After jumping to an unknown sector, the Colonial Fleet is heavily damaged and in need of repairs. You have been assigned the task of locating vital resources to repair the fleet.
values.bgo.story_human_101.Name: Introduction to Battlespace
values.bgo.story_human_101.trigger_arrive_in_ba: Alright.  Initial reports indicate that there is a large planetoid in the middle of the asteroid field directly in front of you.  Scan the planetoid to determine if it contains any useful resources.
values.bgo.story_human_101.trigger_call_mining_: Mining ships gather resources such as water, tylium, and titanium that can be used to purchase upgrades and repair your ship.  Asteroids may also contain resources but you'll have to acquire them yourself by targeting them with your weapons.
values.bgo.story_human_101.trigger_defend_plane: I'm getting a distress signal from the mining ship you just dispatched.  There appears to be several weapons platforms firing on it.  Eliminate the threat or we'll lose that ship!
values.bgo.story_human_101.trigger_event_on_min: The reading wasn't clear. Scan the planetoid again!
You must order a mining ship to complete the mission.
values.bgo.story_human_101.trigger_mission_fail: We didn't get enough titanium from that planetoid.  Return to Galactica.
values.bgo.story_human_101.trigger_mission_succ: Well done. The Admiral would like to speak with you.
values.bgo.story_human_101.trigger_platforms_de: The mining ship is safe. Patrol the area until the mining ship has filled its hold.
Stay close to the Mining Ship
values.bgo.story_human_101.trigger_scan_planeto: Order a mining ship to begin earning resources.
values.bgo.story_human_101.trigger_scout_planet: Target the planetoid and analyize its composition with the Mineral Analysis Module.
Click on the planetiod to select it, then click the flashing icon to scan the planetoid.
Select the planetoid then use the Mineral Analysis Module.
values.bgo.story_human_103.Name: Story Mission 103
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_about_moon: Your DRADIS feed is showing more power signatures coming online in orbit around the small moon ahead, and what seems to be some kind of structure on the surface.  Check it out, %name%.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_debris3: %name%, Galactica. They seem to have been automated defense drones of some kind.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_debris4: We've analysed the images of the wreck, %name%. The ship appears Colonial in origin, but doesn't match anything in our registry.%br%%br%See if you can recover anything from the debris.%br%%br%
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_debris4.1: Click on the marked containers nearby. You must be within 750 meters to interact with the containers.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_drones_at_wa: %name%, Galactica. More defense drones. Whoever these people were, it looks like they were at war.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_drones_detec: %name%, Galactica. More power systems coming online in the asteroids ahead... you've got company!
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_enter: %name%, Galactica. This is a recon mission, so remember to keep your eyes open...
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_info_dradis: Icons on your DRADIS show the positions of nearby ships and objects.  Use your System Map for a wider view of the area.
For a wider view, click the System Map icon.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_info_drones1: %name%, Galactica. Watch out! Your DRADIS feed is showing power systems coming online in the wreckage.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_info_flyup: Move to the nav marker on the other side of the asteroid.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_info_map2: The System Map displays your location, along with the location of enemy units, asteroids, planetoids and other objects of note in the area.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_info_map2.1: Close the System Map by clicking on the Exit button.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_info_map3: You're picking up some unusual readings on the other side of the asteroid ahead. See if you can get us a visual, %name%.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_info_map3.1: Move to the nearby Nav Marker.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_info_proceed: %name%, Galactica. It looks like we're not the first people to visit this sector after all. We should know more once the Chief can take a look at the debris you collected. Proceed with caution.
Fly to the nearby Nav Marker.
Advance to the nav marker in the asteroid field.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_open_debris1: Looks like you found some useful components, %name%.  Good work!%br%
Collect salvage from the Items Window. Click 'Take All' to take every item.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_prep_map_tut: ...and make sure you check your DRADIS regularly for an overview of your situation. %br%%br%DRADIS stands for Direction, Range, And Distance In Space.%br%%br%
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_small_moon: This base could be a valuable source of supplies and resources to help us repair the fleet.%br%%br%The Pegasus has been dispatched to investigate further. Great job, %rank%. Come on home and report to the Admiral.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_stationary_a: %name%, Galactica. Analysis shows several fortified asteroids in orbit. You'll need to get closer to scan the surface structure, but the weapon platforms could be dangerous. Stand by.
The power levels on the nearest platform are weaker than the others. Sending targeting information and dispatching additional fighter support to your position.
values.bgo.story_human_103.trigger_stationary_d: %name%, Galactica. Nice work taking out the weapon platform.%br%%br%The structure looks like some kind of industrial complex. No life signs, but plenty of inactive power sources.
values.bgo.story_human_104.Name: Story Mission 104
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_all_mined: %name%, Galactica. That's all the test data we need. Both the Mineral Analysis and Gopher mining systems are performing even better than we'd hoped, and will be made available via the fleet stores.%br%%br%Great work, come on home.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_asteroid_min: Mined Resources will be automatically booked to your 'hold'.

%name%, Galactica. Gopher test successful. The data shows that the system is far more efficient at breaking up asteroids than normal cannon fire - and as it uses fragments of rock to do so, it'll save us valuable ammunition.

We'd like you to continue scanning and mining asteroids so we can monitor the performance of the systems. Your DRADIS feed indicates that the other asteroid field nearby contains larger asteroids, which could contain larger resource deposits.%br%%br%
Move to the second asteroid field and continue mining operations.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_briefing: %name%, Galactica. If the Chief is right, these systems could allow all our pilots to help find and recover the resources we need to repair the fleet.  Let's put them through their paces.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_briefing.1: Advance to the asteroid field ahead.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_disable_hint: Be sure to have your Gopher Mining Cannon disarmed before attempting to scan the asteroids. There's no point smashing rocks unless you know they contain something useful.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_drones: %name%, Galactica. Watch out, your DRADIS feed indicates defense drones powering up ahead of you! Recommend you use your Missiles to defend yourself - the Chief didn't think the Gopher would be effective in combat situations.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_drones_defea: Nicely done, %name%. It's strange, though. Your targeting data suggests that these drones were just as old as the ones you encountered defending the abandoned base in Delta Canopis, but they appear to be of a different type. They almost look like a Cylon design...
We'll try to do a more thorough analysis later. For now, keep testing the Mineral Analysis and Gopher systems.
Fly to the Nav Point. Mine Tylium, Water, and Titanium to complete the mission.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_drones.1: Use Missiles to destroy the drones. Missiles cannot launch with 200 meters. So, keep your distance!
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_info_asteroi: That should be close enough, %name%. Hold position and we'll give the Mineral Analysis Module a try.
Bring your Raptor to a stop.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_info_mining1: We show optimal HUD integration and full system function. Test successful! According to the Chief's notes, the color codes are as follows:%br%%br%Yellow indicates Tylium deposits, Blue indicates Water or Ice, Purple indicates Titanium Ore and Red indicates no useful resources.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_info_mining2: Once you find an asteroid with useful resources, move to close range and use the Gopher Mining Cannon to break it up and collect the resources it contains.%br%
Use your Mining Cannon on asteroids and collect the resources.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_info_scan1: Okay, %name%, target an asteroid and scan it with the Mineral Analysis Module. If it works, the system will color code the asteroid on your HUD and provide a full readout of any resources it contains.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_info_scan1.1: Click on an asteroid to target it, then click the Mineral Analysis icon.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_stop_moving: Come to a stop close to the asteroid field.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_titanium_min: Titanium is used to repair hull and system Durability.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_tylium_mined: Tylium is used as fuel by both Colonial and Cylon ships, making it a vital resource.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_use_mining_c: Use Gopher Mining Cannon on an asteroid
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_water_mined: Water is in short supply in the fleet, making it very valuable.
values.bgo.story_human_104.trigger_waypoint_rea: Mine <highlight>Water</highlight>, <highlight>Tylium</highlight>, and <highlight>Titanium</highlight> to complete the mission.
values.bgo.story_human_105.Name: Story Mission 105
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_briefing.1: Copy that, Recon Alpha-One. Start your sensor sweep, but be careful out there. %br%%br%%name%, escort Recon Alpha-One and keep your eyes open.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_continue_mis: Recon Alpha-One, Galactica. We have to know more about the nebula, so continue your mission.%br%%br%%name%, we're relying on you to keep Recon Alpha-One safe until they can finish their scans.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_first_attack: Galactica, Recon Alpha-One. We've encountered a Cylon Raider, probably a scout. Please advise.
Engage the Cylon and protect Recon Alpha-One.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_follow_frien: Click the <highlight>Follow Friendly Target icon</highlight> to follow Recon Alpha-One.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_info_kill: Engage the Cylon and protect Recon Alpha-One.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_info_kill2: Engage the Cylons and protect Recon Alpha-One.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_info_kill3: Protect Recon Alpha-One while they prepare to jump to safety.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_match_target: Click the <highlight>Match Target Speed icon</highlight> to match speed with your target.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_scans: Understood, Galactica. Coming into range now. Initiating scans.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_scans_comple: Galactica, Recon Alpha-One. Scans complete, relaying the data.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_scans2: Copy that, Recon Alpha-One. Looks like it's as we feared. Particle density and radiation levels appear to be too high for the fleet to jump safely inside the nebula.%br%%br%We'll continue the analysis, but you've got us what we needed. Come on home.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_second_attac: Frak! Cylon Raiders inbound, %name%. Cover me!
Thanks for the assist, %name%. Looks like the toasters know we're here. We just need a little longer to finish our scans.
Engage the Cylons and protect Recon Alpha-One.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_start: Galactica, Recon Alpha-One. We have arrived at the survey location and can see the nebula up ahead. It's quite a sight.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_target_frien: Click the Target Friendly icon to target Recon Alpha-One.
values.bgo.story_human_105.trigger_third_attack: Galactica, Recon Alpha-One. We're in trouble. Multiple incoming contacts, and the radiation from the nebula is interfering with our FTL drive.%br%%br%Looks like we're going to have to fight our way out, %name%. Here they come!
Great job, %name%. We owe you one. Our FTL has finally spun up, and we're ready to jump. Let's get the frak out of here and back to the Galactica.
Protect Recon Alpha-One while they prepare to jump to safety.
values.bgo.story_human_2.Name: Story Mission 2
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_debris: What the... Hold position and stand by, %name%.
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_debris_tip: You must be within 750 range of a cargo container to open it
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_debris2: Come to a stop and turn towards the wreck
