values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_find_debris: %name%, Galactica. Your DRADIS feed is showing some unusual readings on the other side of the asteroid ahead. Can you get us a visual?
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_galactica: %name%, Galactica. More power systems coming online in the asteroids ahead!
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_galactica2: %name%, Galactica. More defense drones. Whoever these people were, it looks like they were at war.
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_galactica3: Your DRADIS feed is showing more power signatures coming online in orbit around the small moon ahead, and what seems to be some kind of structure on the surface.
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_info_debris: Return to the wreck and click on all three blue cargo containers nearby to collect salvage
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_info_dradis: Icons on your DRADIS show the positions of nearby ships and objects
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_info_drones1: %name%, Galactica. Watch out! Your DRADIS feed is showing power systems coming online in the wreckage.
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_info_drones2: Engage and destroy the unknown targets
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_info_flyup: Move to the nav marker on the other side of the asteroid
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_info_map: For a wider view, click the System Map icon
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_info_map2: The System Map displays an overview of the current star system
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_info_map3: Close the System Map by clicking on the Exit button
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_info_proceed: Advance to the nav marker in the asteroid field
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_info_usemouse: Left-click and drag the mouse to look around your ship
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_info_zoom: Use [SHIFT] + mouse wheel to zoom in and out
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_open_debris: Good work, %name%. It looks like we're not the first people to visit this sector after all. We should know more once the Chief can take a look at the debris you collected.%br%%br%Continue your recon sweep, but proceed with caution.
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_small_moon: This base could be a valuable source of supplies and resources to help us repair the fleet.%br%%br%The Pegasus has been dispatched to investigate further. Great job, %rank%. Come on home and report to the Admiral.%br%%br%[Mission Complete]
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_speed_tip2: Keep moving - if you slow down or stop, you'll be easier to hit
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_stationary_anc: %name%, Galactica. Analysis shows several fortified asteroids in orbit. You'll need to get closer to scan the surface structure, but the weapon platforms could be dangerous. Stand by.
The power levels on the nearest platform are weaker than the others. Sending targeting information and dispatching additional fighter support to your position.
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_stationary_def: %name%, Galactica. Nice work taking out the weapon platform.%br%%br%The structure looks like some kind of industrial complex. No life signs, but plenty of inactive power sources.
values.bgo.story_human_2.trigger_system_map: ...and make sure you check your DRADIS regularly for an overview of your situation. %br%%br%DRADIS stands for Direction, Range, and Distance in space.
values.bgo.story_human_200_editor.Name: Akhlys's Fury
values.bgo.story_human_200.Name: Akhlys's Fury
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_miningship_h: What are you doing? The ship has sustained critical damage - we can't take much more!
We need backup now - we're getting hammered!
If you don't step in now, we're goners!
Anybody out there? Our ship is under heavy fire!
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s1_1_dialogu: Dagger Lead to Dancer: jump complete. Situation report.
Dancer: This is Dagger One. Jump complete. Daggers two through eight report jump complete.
Beginning patrol. All Daggers, fall into formation on me.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s1_2_dialogu: Dancer: Dagger Lead, this is Dancer. Picking up radio signatures! This nebula’s wreaking havoc on my wireless – trying to clear it up.
Captain Floros: Mayday, mayday – this is Thasos. We've lost our escort and we’re under heavy fire. All Colonial units respond!
Roger that, Thasos. This is Dagger Lead – rendering assistance at Zero-Nine-Five carom Two-Three-Five, stand by!
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s1_4_dialogu: Captain Floros: Thanks for your help! Our escort got dragged away - sending you the coordinates where we lost contact.
Safety first. We need you to get out of here. Prepare for immediate departure!
Captain Floros: Negative, Dagger Lead. Our mining drill is stuck! Can you buy us some minutes to get off this planetoid?

Seems we don't have a choice, Thasos. %br%%br%Daggers 3 through 8, stay here and defend the mining ship. %br%%br%Dagger 1 and 2, fall into formation on me – let’s see if we can bring some of these guys home.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s1_4_new_obj: Move to position where contact with the mining ships escort broke down.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s2_1_dialogu: Dancer: Dagger Lead, picking up faint radio signatures.
Roger, Dancer. Give us the waypoints to those signatures.
Dancer: Copy, Dagger Lead. We’ve got to do a sweep to find them – visibility is low and DRADIS readings will be spotty in this nebula.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s2_1_new_obj: Check the signals for possible survivors.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s2_2_dialog1: That was the last signal. Seems the other pilots were out of luck. Let's head back to the mining ship.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s2_2_start: s2_2 started - ALL SIGNALS HAVE BEEN CHECKED
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s2_waypoint1: Watchdog 1: Affirmative, affirmative! I’m here! I managed to shake them off my tail, but I lost contact with my wing!
Dancer: 6 Signals closing in on our position!
Understood. Let’s get rid of them so we can check if we find the other dogs.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s2_waypoint2: Do you see any survivors out there?
Dancer: Negative. Seems this guy was out of luck...
Ok. We can mourn about him later, now we need to move on.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s2_waypoint3: This is Dagger Lead, pilot, can you hear me?
I repeat, this is Dagger Lead, can anybody hear me?
Watchdog 3: Dagger Lead, this is Watchdog 3, my oxygen is running low... requesting...
Roger that, get this guy on board immediately.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s2_waypoint4: Dancer: Enemy ahead! Seems they haven't noticed us yet. If we stay out of sight we should be safe. Never thought this nebula would do us any good...
Ok, let’s keep it like that.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s2_waypoint5: Dagger Lead here, can you hear me pilot?
Watchdog 5: Thank the gods! I thought I had to die in this frakking soup of a nebula!
Seems you got lucky today. Hang on while we reel you in.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s2_waypoint6: Dancer: One Viper, looks ok from the outside but seems to be powered down.
Dagger Lead here, are you still alive?
Watchdog 6: Copy Dagger Lead, this is Watchdog 6. We got dispersed, I had to hide...
No time to hide Watchdog, you are now under my command. Follow me, let's see if we can find some of your wingmen.
Watchdog 6: Roger that, I'm ready to go.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s2_waypoint7: Dagger Lead here, anybody here for a ride?
Watchdog 5: This is Watchdog 5, I'd like to have a ticket for Cloud 9.
We got plenty of free seats back here. Wait a second and we're good to go.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s3_1_dialogu: Owl: Heads up – I'm picking up an inbound signal. Looks like it’s heading for the mining ship.
Roger that, heading back to your position! Captain Floros, whats your status?
Captain Floros: Drill Extraction completed, taking off in 3... 2... 1!
Understood. Dagger 3 through 8 engage – keep the heat off the Thasos.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s4_1_dialogu: Captain Floros: Setting course to the jump coordinates, ETA 2 minutes!
Fend off the attackers until the Thasos jumps out of the system.
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s5_1_dialogu: Owl: Gods dammit – either I need to get my eyes checked or that's a Cylon Carrier…
Everybody stay calm! We've got to defend the Thasos until she reaches the jump point!%br%%br%Focus on the strikes, we won't be able to kill the big one!
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s5_1_setup_w: Ghost: Come on, is this everything you got?!
Owl: Is that what your date said last night?
Dancer: Picking up new signals, more enemies incoming!
Owl: Carrier is launching another wave!
Bring it on you frakking Bastards, I've plenty of rounds left for you!
values.bgo.story_human_200.trigger_s5_2_dialogu: Captain Floros: Jump sequence initiated, jumping in 10 seconds!
All units initiate jump, let’s get the hell out of here!
values.bgo.story_human_3.Name: Story Mission 3
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_first_attack_d: Galactica, Recon Alpha-One. We've encountered a Cylon Raider, probably a scout. Please advise.
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_galactica1: Copy that, Recon Alpha-One. Start your sensor sweep, but be careful out there.%br%%br%%name%, escort Recon Alpha-One and keep your eyes open.
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_galactica3: Understood, Galactica. Coming into range now. Initiating scans.
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_galactica4: Copy that, Recon Alpha-One. Looks like it's as we feared. Particle density and radiation levels appear to be too high for the fleet to jump safely inside the nebula.%br%%br%We'll continue the analysis, but you've got us what we needed. Come on home.
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_info_follow: Click the Target Friendly icon to target Recon Alpha-One
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_info_follow2: Click the Match Target Speed icon to match speed with your target
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_info_follow3: Click the Follow Friendly Target icon to follow Recon Alpha-One
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_info_kill: Engage the hostile target and protect Recon Alpha-One
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_info_kill2: Engage the Cylons and protect Recon Alpha-One
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_info_kill3: Engage the Cylons and protect Recon Alpha-One
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_raptor1: Recon Alpha-One, Galactica. We have to know more about the nebula, so continue your mission.%br%%br%%name%, we're relying on you to keep Recon Alpha-One safe until they can finish their scans.
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_raptor3: Galactica, Recon Alpha-One. Scans complete, relaying the data.
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_second_attack: Frak! Cylon Raiders incoming. Cover me, %name%!
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_second_attack_: Thanks for the assist, %name%. Looks like the toasters know we're here. We just need a little longer to finish our scans.
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_start: Galactica, Recon Alpha-One. We have arrived at the survey location and can see the nebula up ahead. It's quite a sight.
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_third_attack: Galactica, Recon Alpha-One. We're in trouble. Multiple incoming contacts, and the radiation from the nebula is interfering with our FTL drive.%br%%br%Looks like we're going to have to fight it out, %name%. Here they come!
values.bgo.story_human_3.trigger_third_attack_d: Great job, %name%. We owe you one. Our FTL has finally spun up, and we're ready to jump. Let's get the frak out of here and back to the Galactica.%br%%br%[Mission Complete]
values.bgo.story_human_4.Name: Story Mission 4
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_all_mined: %name%, Galactica. That's all the test data we need. Both the Mineral Analysis and Gopher mining systems are performing even better than we'd hoped, and will be made available via the fleet stores.%br%%br%Great work, come on home.%br%%br%[Mission Complete]
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_asteroid_mined: Collect Mined Resources in the Items Window by clicking 'Take All'.

%name%, Galactica. Gopher test successful. The data shows that the system is far more efficient at breaking up asteroids than normal cannon fire - and as it uses fragments of rock to do so, it'll save us valuable ammunition.

We'd like you to continue scanning and mining asteroids so we can monitor the performance of the systems. Your DRADIS feed indicates that the other asteroid field nearby contains larger asteroids, which could contain larger resource deposits.%br%%br%> Move to the second asteroid field and continue mining operations.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_briefing: %name%, Galactica. If the Chief is right, these systems could allow all our pilots to help find and recover the resources we need to repair the fleet.  Let's put them through their paces.%br%%br%> Advance to the asteroid field ahead.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_disable_hint: Be sure to disarm your Gopher Mining Cannon before attempting to scan the asteroids. There's no point smashing rocks unless you know they contain something useful.%br%%br%> Click on the Mining Cannon to deactivate it.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_disable_mining: Click on the Gopher Mining Cannon to deactivate it.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_drones: %name%, Galactica. Watch out, your DRADIS feed indicates defense drones powering up ahead of you! Recommend you use your Missiles to defend yourself - the Chief didn't think the Gopher would be effective in combat situations.%br%%br%> Use Missiles to destroy the drones.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_drones_defeate: Nicely done, %name%. It's strange, though. Your targeting data suggests that these drones were just as old as the ones you encountered defending the abandoned base in Delta Canopis, but they appear to be of a different type. They almost look like a Cylon design...
We'll try to do a more thorough analysis later. For now, keep testing the Mineral Analysis and Gopher systems.%br%%br%> Continue mining operations.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_goto_next_aste: Move to the second asteroid field and continue mining operations.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_info_advance2: Move to the second asteroid field and continue mining operations.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_info_asteroids: That should be close enough, %name%. Hold position and we'll give the Mineral Analysis Module a try.%br%%br%> Bring your Raptor to a stop.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_info_drones: Engage the drones with your Missiles.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_info_mining1: We show optimal HUD integration and full system function. Test successful! According to the Chief's notes, the color codes are as follows:%br%%br%Yellow indicates Tylium deposits, Blue indicates Water or Ice, Purple indicates Titanium Ore and Red indicates no useful resources.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_info_mining2: Once you find an asteroid with useful resources, move to close range and use the Gopher Mining Cannon to break it up and collect the resources it contains.%br%%br%> Use your Mining Cannon on asteroids and collect the resources.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_info_scan1: Okay, %name%, target an asteroid and scan it with the Mineral Analysis Module. If it works, the system will color code the asteroid on your HUD and provide a full readout of any resources it contains.%br%%br%> Click on an asteroid to target it, then click the Mineral Analysis icon.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_missile_range: Remember - Missiles cannot launch below Range 200, so keep your distance!
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_scan_asteroid_: Click on an asteroid to target it, then click the Mineral Analysis icon.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_stop_moving: Come to a stop close to the asteroid field.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_titanium_mined: Titanium is used to repair hull and system Durability.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_tylium_mined: Tylium is used as fuel by both Colonial and Cylon ships, making it a vital resource.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_use_mining_can: Use the Gopher Mining Cannon to break up asteroids containing resources.
values.bgo.story_human_4.trigger_water_mined: Water is in short supply in the fleet, making it very valuable.
values.bgo.story_human_5.Name: Story Mission 5
values.bgo.story_human_5.trigger_finished: Looks like those were the only ships the Cylons had nearby, %rank%. Your mission is complete, return to the Galactica.
values.bgo.story_human_5.trigger_info_map: Mining ships can be called in to extract resources from planetoids - massive asteroids that are too large to break up with mining cannons.
values.bgo.story_human_5.trigger_map: Planetoids are indicated by grey hexagons on the System Map.
values.bgo.story_human_5.trigger_move: Advance towards the cluster of planetoids.
values.bgo.story_human_5.trigger_scan: Locate a resource-rich Planetoid and call in a Mining Ship.
values.bgo.story_human_5.trigger_ship_enter: Mining ships are unarmed, which makes them tempting targets for enemy forces. You will need to guard the ship while it extracts resources for you.
values.bgo.story_human_5.trigger_ship_enter2: Guard the Mining Ship while it extracts resources.
values.bgo.story_human_5.trigger_start: %name%, Galactica. The Rhino's toughness should make it ideal for defending larger, slower allies and civilian vessels, like mining ships.
values.bgo.story_human_5.trigger_trigger_planet: Planetoids can be scanned for resources just like asteroids. If resources are detected, you will be given the option to call in a mining ship to extract them.  Your Rhino has been equipped with a Mineral Analysis Module; test it out now.
Use the Mineral Anaylsis Module to scan planetoids.
values.bgo.story_human_5.trigger_victory_1: That Heavy Raider managed to get a signal off before you destroyed it, %name%. Stay sharp!
values.bgo.story_human_5.trigger_victory_2: Nice work, %rank%. The Rhino seems to be performing well.
values.bgo.story_human_5.trigger_victory_3: Those weren't Raiders, %name%. Either the Cylons have come up with something new, or they've also found abandoned ships in this sector that they can use.
values.bgo.story_human_6.Name: Story Mission 6
values.bgo.story_human_6.trigger_enemy_movement: Power systems coming online near your position! Looks like the same kind of drones we've encountered before.%br%
values.bgo.story_human_6.trigger_escape: Avoid the enemy while your FTL drive spins up.
values.bgo.story_human_6.trigger_jumpready: Jump drive ready. Intiating jump in five seconds.
values.bgo.story_human_6.trigger_recon: With so many Cylons around, you may not be able to avoid contact, so your Raptor has been equipped with a Damage Control system.%br%%br%If you get in trouble, you can activate Damage Control to repair your ship, but be careful - it consumes a lot of power and a DC Pack every time you use it.
values.bgo.story_human_6.trigger_start: %name%, Galactica. The Cylons seem very interested in this area, and we need to know why.
values.bgo.story_human_6.trigger_wave1_defeated: Nice job taking out that patrol, %rank%. It's strange, though. We're not detecting as many Cylon ships in the area as we'd expected.%br%
values.bgo.story_human_6.trigger_wave2_defeated: There must have been a lot of drones to take out all those Cylons. But what were they doing out here, so close to the Nebula? %br%
values.bgo.story_human_6.trigger_wave3_defeated: That drone was a lot larger and more powerful than the ones we've encountered before. Proceed with caution, %rank%.
values.bgo.story_human_6.trigger_waypoint_reach: Looks like the Cylons bit off more than they could chew. But what were they fighting?
values.bgo.story_human_6.trigger_waypoint2_reac: Good work, %rank%! Your sensor feed is showing what looks like a break in the nebula ahead. That must be what the Cylons have been investigating.
If the passage extends all the way through the nebula, you may just have found us a way out of this Sector, %rank%. Try to get closer so your sensors can give us more information.
values.bgo.story_human_6.trigger_waypoint3_reac: Frak! Multiple enemy contatcs detected! You need to get out of there right now, %rank%!%br%%br%Your FTL drive is being degraded by interference from the nebula - avoid the Cylon fleet until it can spin up!
Stay alive until you can jump to safety.
values.bgo.story_human_7.Name: Story Mission 7
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_halt: %name%, Galactica. We're picking up a lot of Cylon activity around the entrance to the nebula passage. The recon team will hold position here while you clear them a path.%br%%br%Be careful... These sensor readings indicate that the Cylons may have Escort class ships of their own.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_halt.1: Clear the entrance point of enemy patrols.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_kill_patrols: Clear the entrance point of enemy patrols.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_lore_chat: Escort ships are large enough to mount weapon batteries with longer range and wider firing arcs than Strikes, and their side-mounted weapons allow them to fire at targets almost anywhere around them.%br%%br%The combination makes them very effective at protecting other ships from enemy Strikes.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_proceed1: Escort the recon team to the entrance point
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_proceed2: Escort the recon team to the entrance point.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_proceed3: Escort the recon team to the entrance point.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_proceed4: Escort the recon team to the entrance point.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_report: %name%, Recon Alpha-One. We've entered the passage. It seems to be large enough for the fleet to navigate. Relaying sensor data and proceeding further inside.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_report2: %name%, Recon Alpha-One. Picking up some strange readings ahead... What the frak! Massive energy spikes detected! Initiating ev... m.. vers... Arggh!
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_report3: %name%, Galactica. We've lost communication with the recon team, and are showing Cylon reinforcements incoming to your position! Get out of there now, there's nothing more you can do.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_start: %name%, Galactica. Your job is to protect the recon team and punch a hole through the Cylon patrols so that they can enter the passage into the Nebula.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_tier2: Once the recon team enters the nebula passage, they'll suffer a lot of interference from the radiation. You are to remain on station to relay their sensor data and communications back to Galactica.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_tier2.1: Escort the recon team to the passage.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_wait: %name%, Galactica. Good work. Hold position while the recon team enters the nebula passage and prepare to relay their signals.%br%
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_wait.1: Hold position at the entry point.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_wait2: Hold position at the entrance point.
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_wave1_defeated: Nice work, %rank%. Stick close to the recon team and expect heavier Cylon patrols as you get proceed.%br%
values.bgo.story_human_7.trigger_zone_enter: Route entered, orders ignored, mission failed
values.bgo.story_human_8.Name: Story Mission 8
values.bgo.story_human_8.trigger_ambush: We're picking up enemy contacts, %name%! Take those toasters out before they can warn the convoy!%br%
values.bgo.story_human_8.trigger_ambush_defeate: Hold position and wait for the enemy convoy to arrive.
values.bgo.story_human_8.trigger_freighter_dest: Nice job, %name%. Without those supplies the Cylons won't be able to set up a permanent base at the entrance to the nebula passage. Come on home.
values.bgo.story_human_8.trigger_hold_position: Hold position and wait for the enemy convoy to arrive.
values.bgo.story_human_8.trigger_start: %name%, Galactica. According to our recon reports, the Cylon supply convoy should arrive in this area shortly. Get ready to intercept it as soon as it appears.
values.bgo.story_human_8.trigger_start.1: Hold position and wait for the enemy convoy.
values.bgo.story_human_8.trigger_time_nearly_up: Destroy the convoy before it escapes!
values.bgo.story_human_8.trigger_timeup: Frak! The convoy has reached its jump coordinates and escaped, %rank%! Mission failed.
values.bgo.story_human_9.Name: Story Mission 9
values.bgo.story_human_9.trigger_recon: Proceed with caution to the first waypoint
values.bgo.story_human_9.trigger_start: [The player is informed about the scouting mission]
values.bgo.story_human_9.trigger_waypoint1b: [The player is told that everything seems quiet so far]
values.bgo.story_human_9.trigger_waypoint3b: [The player is informed that reinforcements will arrive]
values.bgo.story_human_9.trigger_waypoint4: [The player is made aware that something huge is up ahead]
values.bgo.story_human_tutorial_1_editor.Name: Human Tutorial #1
values.bgo.story_indicator_test.Name: 46 Graeae Alpha
values.bgo.story_indicator_test.trigger_enter_s: Attention %name%, the cylons are using this region as a core supply route. Interdict and destroy any vessels you encounter. Act quickly, If they make it to their nav points, they will escape.
values.bgo.story_rescue_mission_colonial.Descri: The Resue Mission%br%%br%1. Player is on routine patrol%br%2. Emergency Call%br%3. Player goes for rescue mission%br%3. Player gets attacked by drones%br%4. After defeat, player finds the stranded ship (colonial)%br%5. The player gets locked (can not move) by a trap device%br%6. player destroys the trap device%br%7. player gets attacked by accomplices%br%8. ploayer hunts and kills the false bird trap master %br%9. end
values.bgo.story_rescue_mission_colonial.Name: The Rescue Mission
values.bgo.story_rescue_mission_colonial.trigge: You fool! Don't you dare to attack the freighter! %br%My rogue squad will shoot you down, now!
Galactica here. We received a distress signal from your sector. %rank%, please investigate. We've send a waypoint to your system that will lead you to the origin of the signal.
Fly to the waypoint and investigate
Good work, %Rank%. The surviving rogues will be brought before court. This revolt is over. Mission accomplished.
Hello, my firend ... welcome to my little trap.
I have just disabled your engines with a device on this  freighter. Since you are debilitated by the drones and surround by several of my rogues, your only option is to surrender.
values.bgo.story_uknown_editor.Name: Akhlys's Fury
values.bgo.story_uknownc_editor.Name: Akhlys's Fury
values.bgo.story_wave_alpha_colonial.Name: 46 Graeae Alpha
values.bgo.story_wave_alpha_colonial.trigger_en: Attention %name%, the cylons are using this region as a core supply route. Interdict and destroy any vessels you encounter. Act quickly, If they make it to their nav points, they will escape.
values.bgo.story_wave_alpha_colonial.trigger_ev: Frak! They got away. They'll certainly alert their fleet about our presence.
Splash one toaster! Keep up the good work, %name%.
Survive the Ambush%br%
Frak! It's an ambush. Engage targets, waste those toasters!
That was close. I'm happy we didn't lose you there. Stay on alert for more Cylons.
Destroy the Disabled Ship
Cylon distress signal detected. Move to the nav point and destroy the disabled ship.
That was close %name%. Good flying, %name%.
That freighter is spinning up it's FTL Drive, destroy it before it gets away.
Destroy the Freighter before it jumps away
Frak! The freighter got away. They'll certainly alert their fleet about our presence.
Frak! That freighter got away. They'll certainly alert their fleet about our presence.
Destroy the Freighter
New signals detected. Move to the nav point and engage the targets.
Looks like you ruined that toaster's day! Keep up the good work, %name%.
Destroy the remaining Enemy Patrol
Gods Damn it! They got away. If we don't get these convoys, the Cylons will be able to wipe us out.
Destroy the Enemy Patrol
More toasters, %name%. That Heavy Raider is a support ship. Take it out first!
Those toasters didn't see that coming! More Cylons inbound.
For frak's sake! They got away.
Scouts have detected a Cylon mining fleet. Smash those toasters, %name%!
Destroy the Mining Ship and the Escort Ships
Those toasters are going feel that loss. Good work, %name%.
Destroy the Drones in less than 4 minutes
That's odd. We've detected drone activity in this area. They appear to be examining something. Investigate and destroy them before they get away.
Frak! Now we'll never know what the drones were after.
Wait, there is something unusual here ...
Wait, there is something unusual here ...
Wait, there is something unusual here ...
Not sure what those drones were up to, but we'll look over that wreck they were so curious about.
Frak! They got away. This area is too hot right now. Return to the Galactica.
Destroy the Command Ship and the Escort Ships
Fangs out, %name%. The Cylons are making a final push on this sector. Take them out!
Good job. We've secured this sector. Return to the Galactica.
Do not interact, human. Initialize reinforcements.
Frak! They got away. This area is too hot right now. Return to the Galactica.
Destroy the Enemy Carrier
Looks the like Cylons aren't frakking around anymore. Take out that Carrier.
Good job. We've secured this sector. Return to the Galactica.
Frak! They got away. This area is too hot right now. Return to the Galactica
Fangs out, %name%. The Cylons are making a final push on this sector. Take them out!
Destroy the ECM Ship and the Escort Ships
Good job. We've secured this sector. Return to the Galactica.
The convoy escaped. We've detected more Cylon signals. Don't let these toasters get away.
Destroy the Freighter and the Escort Ships
Great shooting, %name%. Those chromejobs never saw it coming. We've detected another convoy. Move to engage.
Destroy the Enemy Patrol
We've detected another convoy. Move to engage.
values.bgo.story_wave_alpha_cylon.Name: 46 Graeae Alpha
values.bgo.story_wave_alpha_cylon.trigger_enter: Attention %name%, the colonials are using this region as a core supply route. Interdict and destroy any vessels you encounter. Act quickly, If they make it to their nav points, they will escape.
values.bgo.story_wave_alpha_cylon.trigger_event: Failure is not acceptable. If you are unable to meet your programming, your line will be boxed!
It appears your line is worth something after all. Prepare for another convoy, %rank%
Survive the Ambush%br%
A ruse? It appears the humans are more creative than we expected. Wipe them out.
Your continued failure has set our plans back significantly. Ineptitude will not be tolerated.
Destroy the Disabled Ship
Colonial distress signal detected. Move to the nav point and destroy the disabled ship.
The humans' arrogance was their undoing.
That freighter is spinning up it's FTL Drive, destroy it before it gets away.
Destroy the Freighter before it jumps away
Failure is not acceptable. If you are unable to meet your programming, then your line will be boxed!
Failure is not acceptable. If you are unable to meet your programming, then your line will be boxed!
Destroy the Freighter
New signals detected. Move to the nav point and engage the targets.
The humans thought they could get away. Excellent work. Prepare for another convoy, %rank%
Destroy the remaining Enemy Patrol
Failures like these will not be tolerated. More Colonials have arrived. Do not fail this time.
Destroy the Enemy Patrol
Another Human patrol is inbound. The Raptor is providing support. Destroy it first.
Your programming has evolved beyond specifications. Excellent work. More humans ships have arrived in the system.
What malfunction is creating such failures? We may need to discuss boxing your line.
A human mining fleet has arrived. Destroy them.
Destroy the Mining Ship and the Escort Ships
The loss of that mining ship will hinder the Humans.
Destroy the Drones in less than 4 minutes
We have detected unusual drone activity in the area. Investigate and engage the targets.
The drones were interested in this wreck, but due to your failure we will never know why.

values.bgo.strikes_npc_raider_infected.Descript: Sleek and deadly, the Raider is the primary Interceptor of the Cylon fleet, designed to use its speed and agility to perform rapid strikes and chase down slower, less maneuverable targets. Like all Cylon vessels, it is a biomechanical construct commanded by a 'pilot mind' that literally becomes the ship.%br% %br%As an Interceptor, the Raider can be equipped with more engine systems than other strike craft, increasing its already impressive performance.

A specially engineered and precision-tuned Raider hull that incorporates the latest upgrades and refinements based on comprehensive analysis of combat performance since the attack on the Colonies. The Advanced Raider is normally reserved for use by the most experienced and effective pilot minds.%br% %br%The Advanced Raider's hull is stronger and more durable than the standard version, and it can mount additional weapon and engine systems.

values.bgo.system_avionics_assault_basic.Descri: The Basic Avionics Maneuvering System (BAMS) is a basic system designed for training purposes that limits the basic movements of a vessel. This system provides a pilot with basic manual control system that reflects traditional terrestrial and atmospheric flight behavior. This system is familiar and understandable for pilots mastering movement and combat maneuvering in a three dimensional combat environment.
values.bgo.system_avionics_assault_basic.Name: Basic Avionics Maneuvering System (BAMS) - Rhino
values.bgo.system_avionics_assault_basic.ShortD: The Basic Avionics Maneuvering System provides pilots with basic flight controls.
values.bgo.system_avionics_assault_combat.Descr: The Combat Avionics Maneuvering system is fly-by-wire system designed for advanced maneuvers in a three-dimensional environment. The fly-by-wire system replaces the analog maneuvering systems providing full Reaction Control Systems (RCS) for pilots experienced in advanced spacial orientation and maneuvering. These complex thruster systems lose effectiveness and maneuverability in standard atmospheric environments.

values.bgo.system_avionics_multi_combat.Descrip: The Combat Avionics Maneuvering system is fly-by-wire system designed for advanced maneuvers in a three-dimensional environment. The fly-by-wire system replaces the analog maneuvering systems providing full Reaction Control Systems (RCS) for pilots experienced in advanced spacial orientation and maneuvering. These complex thruster systems lose effectiveness and maneuverability in standard atmospheric environments.

values.bgo.system_avionics_recon_basic.Descript: The Basic Avionics Maneuvering System (BAMS) is a basic system designed for training purposes that limits the basic movements of a vessel. This system is familiar and understandable for pilots mastering movement and combat maneuvering in a three dimensional combat environment.

values.bgo.tip_popup_cylon.case1_body: Here in the Command Center you can talk to Number One to learn more about the current situation and see if he has any missions for you, or explore the rest of the Basestar. {1} Click on the characters with a golden icon above their heads to start a conversation. {2} Move around by holding down the right mouse button or using [W][A] and [D] - you can run by holding down [SPACE] while moving. {2} Click on the glowing doors with the revolving icons to go to a different area of the Basestar.
values.bgo.tip_popup_cylon.case12_body: While you are still new to our fleet, we can send you to Battlespace: a remote sector with a single resource-rich planetoid. {0} I guarantee there will be a contingent of hostiles, but it is a good opportunity to hone your skills against other pilots and bring us back badly needed materials. {1} Select the star button on the top right of your HUD at any time to open the Battlegrounds and join the Battlespace. Check the Battlegrounds for further challenges (e.g. tournaments) later on.
values.bgo.tip_popup_cylon.case2_body: Assignments are specific tasks allocated by the commanders of the Cylon Fleet. Completing Assignments earns you Experience Points (XP) and other rewards. {1} Click the Pilot log icon in the upper-right or press [I], then click on the Assignments tab to view details of your current Assignment. {0} To help you get started, you’ve been given a number of initial Assignments. You can get new Assignments each day by speaking to Number Two here in the Rec Room. {1} Speak to Number Two to receive your daily Assignments.
values.bgo.tip_popup_cylon.case3_body: This Basestar’s Hybrid grants audiences to certain pilots, giving them advice and rewards. You can receive one prophecy each day for free, and receive more by spending Cubits. {1} Speak to Number Six to learn more, and receive your first prophecy. {0} You can receive a wide variety of rewards from prophecies, so don’t forget to receive your free one each day.
values.bgo.tip_popup_cylon.case4_body: If you haven’t been to the Hangar yet, you should go there and speak to Number Eight. {1} Go to the Hangar and speak to Number Eight. {0} If you’ve already been to the Hangar, you should now be ready to leave the Basestar and start exploring the Veil Sector. {1} Transfer your mind to your ship and leave the Basestar by clicking the Undock button at the top of the screen
values.bgo.tip_popup_cylon.case5_body: Here in the Hangar you can access the Equipment Archives to buy and sell equipment and ammunition, equip and upgrade ship systems and repair your ship. {0} All of these tasks are accomplished by speaking to Number Eight and selecting the appropriate dialogue options. {1} Speak to Number Eight to access the Equipment Archives.
values.bgo.tip_popup_cylon.case6_body: If you haven’t been to the Rec Room yet, you should go there and speak to Number Two. {1} Go to the Rec Room and speak to Number Two. {0} If you’ve already been to the Rec Room, you should now be ready to leave the Basestar and start exploring the Veil Sector. {1} Transfer your mind to your ship and leave the Basestar by clicking the Undock button at the top of the screen.
values.bgo.tip_popup_cylon.case7_body: The 242 Apollid system is the temporary home of the Cylon Fleet. Frequent patrols and the threat of the Basestar’s weapon systems keep this star system safe, so feel free to explore. {1} To return to the Basestar, simply click on it and then on the Dock button at the top of the screen. {0} To start exploring the rest of the Veil Sector, you’ll need to jump to a different star system. {1} To perform an FTL jump, open the Sector Navigation window by clicking on the globe icon beside the DRADIS at the bottom of the screen.
values.bgo.tip_popup_cylon.case8_body: To move to another star system in the Veil Sector, you must use your ship’s Faster Than Light (FTL) drive. {0} The red circle on the Sector Navigation map shows the maximum range of your FTL drive. {1} To jump to another star system within range, click on it and then on the Jump button. {0} Once your FTL drive ‘spins up’ to full power, you’ll travel instantly to your destination. Note that FTL drives take longer to spin up when you’re in combat.
values.bgo.tip_popup_cylon.case9_body: Congratulations, pilot. Your service to the Cylon is off to a solid start. Now it’s time to play your part in the final destruction of humanity. {1} Completing your daily Assignments is a good next step - and be sure to get new ones each day. {2} Check in with Number One to see if he has any missions for you as you progress. {2} You can find more information about many aspects of the game by clicking the Help button in the upper right or pressing [SHIFT]+[H]. {2} Don’t be afraid to ask your fellow pilots for help and advice. {2} Have fun!
values.bgo.tip_popup_human.case0_body: Welcome aboard the Galactica, pilot! {0} The Galactica is the flagship of the Colonial Fleet. Following the Cylon attack you have been called to the Combat Information Center (CIC), where Admiral Adama has a mission for you. {1} Click on the dialogue options to learn more about the mission. {0} (Playing the first few missions is recommended, as they will introduce you to some of the basics of the game, but if you wish you can come back to them later.)
values.bgo.tip_popup_human.case1_body: Here in the CIC you can talk to Admiral Adama to learn more about the current situation and see if he has any more missions for you, or explore the rest if the Galactica. {1} Click on the characters with a golden icon above their heads to start a conversation. {2} Move around by holding down the right mouse button or using [W][A] and [D] - you can run by holding down [SPACE] while moving. {2} Click on the glowing doors with the revolving icons to go to a different area of the Galactica.
values.bgo.tip_popup_human.case12_body: While you are still new to our fleet, we can send you to Battlespace: a remote sector with a single resource-rich planetoid. {0} I guarantee there will be a contingent of hostiles, but it is a good opportunity to hone your skills against other pilots and bring us back badly needed materials. {1} Select the star button on the top right of your HUD at any time to open the Battlegrounds and join the Battlespace. Check the Battlegrounds for further challenges (e.g. tournaments) later on.
values.bgo.tip_popup_human.case2_body: Assignments are specific tasks allocated by the commanders of the Colonial Fleet. Completing Assignments earns you experience Points (XP) and other rewards. {1} Click the Pilot log icon in the upper-right or press [I], then click on the Assignments tab to view details of your current Assignment. {0} To help you get started, you’ve been given a number of initial Assignments. You can get new Assignments each day by speaking to Captain Adama here in the Galactica’s Rec Room. {1} Speak to Captain Adama to receive your daily Assignments.
values.bgo.tip_popup_human.case3_body: Triad is a card game played by many Colonial pilots to pass the time when they’re off-duty. You can play one hand each day for free, and play more by spending Cubits. {1} Speak to Starbuck to learn more about Triad, and play a hand. {0} You can win a wide variety of rewards by playing Triad, so don’t forget to play your free hand each day.
values.bgo.tip_popup_human.case4_body: If you haven’t been to the Hangar Deck yet, you should go there and speak to Acting Chief Edison. {1} Go to the Hangar Deck and speak to the Acting Chief. {0} If you’ve already been to the Hangar Deck, you should now be ready to leave the Galactica and start exploring the Veil Sector. {0} Enter your ship and leave the Galactica by clicking the Undock button at the top of the screen.
values.bgo.tip_popup_human.case5_body: Here on the Hangar Deck you can access the Fleet Stores to buy and sell equipment and ammunition, equip and upgrade ship systems and repair your ship. {0} All of these tasks are accomplished by speaking to Acting Chief Edison and selecting the appropriate dialogue options. {1} Speak to the Acting Chief to access the Fleet Stores.
values.bgo.tip_popup_human.case6_body: If you haven’t been to the Rec Room yet, you should go there and speak to Captain Adama. {1} Go to the Rec Room and speak to Captain Adama. {0} If you’ve already been to the Rec Room, you should now be ready to leave the Galactica and start exploring the Veil Sector. {1} Enter your ship and leave the Galactica by clicking the Undock button at the top of the screen.
values.bgo.tip_popup_human.case7_body: The Alpha Ceti system is the temporary home of the Colonial Fleet. Frequent patrols and the threat of the Galactica’s weapon systems keep this star system safe, so feel free to explore. {1} To return to the Galactica, simply click on it and then on the Dock button at the top of the screen. {0} To start exploring the rest of the Veil Sector, you’ll need to jump to a different star system. {1} To perform an FTL jump, open the Sector Navigation window by clicking on the globe icon beside the DRADIS at the bottom of the screen.
values.bgo.tip_popup_human.case8_body: To move to another star system in the Veil Sector, you must use your ship’s Faster Than Light (FTL) drive. {0} The red circle on the Sector Navigation map shows the maximum range of your FTL drive. {1} To jump to another star system within range, click on it and then on the Jump button. {0} Once your FTL drive ‘spins up’ to full power, you’ll travel instantly to your destination. Note that FTL drives take longer to spin up when you’re in combat.
values.bgo.tip_popup_human.case9_body: Congratulations, pilot. Your career in the Colonial military is off to a solid start. Now it’s time to play your part in humanity’s struggle to survive. {1} Completing your daily Assignments is a good next step - and be sure to get new ones each day. {2} Check in with Admiral Adama to see if he has any missions for you as you progress. {2} You can find more information about many aspects of the game by clicking the Help button in the upper right or pressing [SHIFT]+[H]. {2} Don’t be afraid to ask your fellow pilots for help and advice. {2} Have fun!
values.bgo.tips.1: The uncontrolled jump throws both fleets far beyond the red line...
values.bgo.tips.10: Visit Chief Tyrol in the Galactica's CIC or the Quartermaster on an outpost to acquire new ships.
values.bgo.tips.11: Talk to Chief Tyrol in the Galactica's CIC or the Quartermaster on an outpost to customize your ships equipment.
values.bgo.tips.12: To have the ground crew repair your ship, talk to Chief Tyrol in the Galactica's CIC or the Quartermaster on an outpost.
values.bgo.tips.13: Select which of your ships to command by talking with Chief Tyrol in the Galactica's CIC or the Quartermaster on an outpost.
values.bgo.tips.14: Talk to Apollo in the Galactica's CIC to get new assignments each day.
values.bgo.tips.15: Completed assignments can be turned in via the pilot log.
values.bgo.tips.16: Activated cannons will fire automatically when your target is within their firing arc and range.
values.bgo.tips.17: Press SPACE to use your Boosters in combat.
values.bgo.tips.18: Explore the Galactica's CIC to meet new characters and get missions and assignments.
values.bgo.tips.19: The Galactica is the flagship of the Colonial fleet.
values.bgo.tips.2: After ejecting, search and rescue will take you to the nearest outpost or base.
values.bgo.tips.20: Talk to Number One in the Basestar's command center to get new missions.
values.bgo.tips.21: The command center is the heart of the Cylon fleet.
values.bgo.tips.22: Number One was the first model of humanoid Cylon created.
values.bgo.tips.23: Learn more about the story by talking to Number One in the command center.
values.bgo.tips.24: Number One commands the Cylon fleet from the Basestar's command center.
values.bgo.tips.25: Visit a Number 8 in the Basestar's command center or on an outpost to acquire new ships.
values.bgo.tips.26: Talk to a Number 8 in the Basestar's command center or on an outpost to customize your ships equipment.
values.bgo.tips.27: To have the ground crew repair your ship, talk to a Number 8 in the Basestar's command center or on an outpost.
values.bgo.tips.28: Select which of your ships to command by talking with a Number 8 in the Basestar's command center  or on an outpost.
values.bgo.tips.29: Talk to Number Two in the Basestar's command center to get new assignments each day.
values.bgo.tips.3: Learning the hotkeys can help in combat.
values.bgo.tips.30: Use your DRADIS to target enemies, making them easier to track in combat.
values.bgo.tips.31: Explore the Basestar's command center to meet new characters and get missions and assignments.
values.bgo.tips.32: Basestars are the capital ships of the Cylon fleet.
values.bgo.tips.33: The top four players in the tournament are marked with crossed swords.
values.bgo.tips.34: DPS stands for Damage Per Second and represents the average damage a weapon can cause over time.
values.bgo.tips.4: At flagships and outposts you can buy and sell items as well as acquire, change, customize and repair your ships.
values.bgo.tips.5: Adama is affectionately nicknamed 'The Old Man' by his crew.
values.bgo.tips.6: Talk to Admiral Adama in the Galactica's CIC to get new missions.
values.bgo.tips.7: The Combat Information Center, or CIC, is the nerve center of a Battlestar.
values.bgo.tips.8: Learn more about the story by talking to Admiral Adama in the Galactica's CIC.
values.bgo.tips.9: Admiral Adama commands the Colonial fleet from the Galactica's CIC.
